attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Production schedules require approved risk assessments before execution per mining safety regulations. Critical for demonstrating due diligence and regulatory compliance in production planning.

attributes.name: rom_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Run of Mine (ROM) stockpile pad designated to receive ore from this scheduled extraction. Links to the ROM pad master record for inventory and feed management to the processing plant.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; ROM Pad (Run of Mine Stockpile Pad) Standard

attributes.name: royalty_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.royalty_agreement. Business justification: Production schedules drive royalty payment forecasting. The royalty agreement terms (rate, basis, commodity, payment frequency) are needed to forecast royalty cash flows for each scheduled production

attributes.name: royalty_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.royalty_obligation. Business justification: Production schedules drive royalty payment forecasts; scheduled ore tonnes and grades are used to calculate royalty accruals by period. Finance teams use production schedule data to accrue royalty obl

attributes.name: shutdown_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.shutdown_plan. Business justification: Production scheduling must account for planned maintenance shutdowns — shutdown windows directly constrain mineable periods and planned ore tonnes. Production planners reference shutdown_plan when bui

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Mine scheduling teams plan ore extraction to meet specific product specification targets (e.g., 62% Fe lump spec). The production schedule drives ore quality management decisions. Domain experts expec

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Production schedules must track source tenement for state/private royalty calculations, expenditure commitment substantiation, and regulatory production reporting. Essential for quarterly compliance r

attributes.name: waste_dump_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.waste_dump. Business justification: A production schedule plans waste material movement to a designated waste dump. This FK links the schedule to the target waste dump facility, enabling capacity planning and waste routing. No bidirecti

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the production schedule was formally approved by the mine planning or operations management team. Required for governance and audit trail of schedule sign-off.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS; JORC Code 2012; ISO 45001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: cutoff_grade
attributes.description: The minimum economic grade threshold applied to classify material as ore versus waste in this schedule. Material below this grade is treated as waste. A fundamental mine planning parameter that determines ore tonnes and reserve classification.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; CIM NI 43-101; SAMREC; Cut-off Grade (Minimum Economic Grade) Standard

attributes.name: is_lom_schedule
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Life of Mine (LOM) Schedule Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule record is part of the long-range Life of Mine (LOM) plan (True) or a short-to-medium term operational schedule (False). Used to filter LOM planning records from operational scheduling records in analytics.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; LOM (Life of Mine) Planning Standards

attributes.name: mining_method
attributes.description: Primary extraction method applicable to this schedule. 'open_cut' refers to open-pit surface mining; 'underground' refers to sub-surface methods such as Sub-Level Caving (SLC) or longwall; 'open_cut_underground' indicates a combined operation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; SLC (Sub-Level Caving) Standards

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the scheduled production period ends. Defines the end boundary of the planning horizon for this schedule record.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the scheduled production period begins. Defines the start boundary of the planning horizon for this schedule record (e.g., first day of the week, month, or quarter).

attributes.name: planned_blast_count
attributes.description: The number of planned blast events scheduled within the production period. Used for explosives procurement planning, blast crew scheduling, and regulatory notification compliance.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; MSHA Blasting Regulations; IsoMetrix HSE

attributes.name: planned_capex_usd
attributes.description: The planned Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) in USD allocated to this production schedule period, covering equipment, infrastructure, and development costs. Used for LOM capital planning and NPV/IRR analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) Standard; NPV (Net Present Value) Standard; IFRS 6

attributes.name: planned_dilution_pct
attributes.description: The planned percentage of waste material mixed with ore during the extraction process (Dilution = waste mixed with ore during mining). Expressed as a percentage. Used to adjust head grade targets and assess ore quality at the ROM pad.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; Dilution (Waste Mixed with Ore During Mining) Standard

attributes.name: planned_drill_metres
attributes.description: The total planned drilling metres for blast hole drilling associated with this schedule period. A key drill-and-blast planning metric used to size drilling equipment requirements and schedule blast events.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; Drilling and Blasting Operations Standards

attributes.name: planned_haulage_cycles
attributes.description: The planned number of truck haulage cycles required to move the scheduled ore and waste tonnes during the period. Used for fleet utilisation planning and fuel consumption estimation in the Fleet Management System (FMS).
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: planned_opex_usd
attributes.description: The planned Operating Expenditure (OPEX) in USD associated with executing this production schedule for the period. Includes mining, haulage, and processing costs. Used for budget tracking and AISC (All-In Sustaining Cost) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; OPEX (Operating Expenditure) Standard; AISC (All-In Sustaining Cost) Standard; IFRS

attributes.name: planned_ore_tonnes
attributes.description: The scheduled quantity of ore (in dry metric tonnes) to be extracted from the mining block or stope during the schedule period. Represents the primary production target and is the principal quantitative fact of this schedule record. Excludes waste and overburden.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: planned_recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: The planned percentage of the valuable mineral expected to be recovered from the ore during mineral processing and beneficiation. Expressed as a percentage. Drives concentrate production targets and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Recovery Rate (Percentage of Valuable Mineral Extracted) Standard; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: planned_strip_ratio
attributes.description: The planned ratio of waste tonnes to ore tonnes (waste:ore) for the schedule period. A key economic indicator in open-cut mining used to assess mining cost efficiency. Calculated as planned_waste_tonnes / planned_ore_tonnes but stored as a scheduled target value from the mine plan.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; Strip Ratio (Overburden to Ore Ratio) Standard

attributes.name: planned_total_material_tonnes
attributes.description: Total planned material movement (ore plus waste, in dry metric tonnes) for the schedule period. Used for equipment allocation, fleet sizing, and haulage planning via the Fleet Management System (FMS).
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: planned_waste_tonnes
attributes.description: The scheduled quantity of waste rock and overburden (in dry metric tonnes) to be moved during the schedule period. Used to calculate the planned strip ratio and assess haulage and equipment requirements.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; Strip Ratio Standards

attributes.name: resource_classification
attributes.description: The JORC/CIM resource or reserve classification of the ore scheduled for extraction. Values align with JORC Code categories: 'measured' (Measured Resource), 'indicated' (Indicated Resource), 'inferred' (Inferred Resource), 'probable_reserve' (Probable Reserve), 'proved_reserve' (Proved Reserve — highest confidence).
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; CIM NI 43-101; SAMREC; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: schedule_basis
attributes.description: Indicates the planning basis of this schedule record. 'budget' is the approved annual plan; 'forecast' is a revised in-period estimate; 'actual_reconciled' is a schedule updated with actual production data; 'scenario' is a what-if planning scenario.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Deswik Mine Planning; ICMM Reporting Standards

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this production schedule record as sourced from Deswik or Hexagon MinePlan (e.g., PS-2024-Q3-001). Used for cross-system reference and operational reporting.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the production schedule (e.g., 'North Pit Q3 2024 Monthly Schedule'). Used for identification in planning dashboards and operational reports.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the production schedule. 'draft' indicates under preparation; 'approved' indicates sign-off by mine planning; 'active' indicates currently being executed; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a revised version; 'cancelled' indicates no longer valid.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Temporal horizon classification of the schedule. 'weekly' covers 7-day operational targets; 'monthly' covers 4-week periods; 'quarterly' covers 13-week periods; 'annual' covers full-year plans; 'lom' refers to Life of Mine (LOM) long-range planning schedules.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; LOM (Life of Mine) Planning Standards

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Incremental version number of the production schedule, incremented each time the schedule is revised and re-approved. Enables tracking of schedule revisions and comparison between versions for variance analysis.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this production schedule record was sourced. 'DESWIK' indicates Deswik mine planning software; 'HEXAGON_MINEPLAN' indicates Hexagon MinePlan; 'MANUAL' indicates a manually entered schedule.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: target_head_grade
attributes.description: The planned average grade of the primary commodity (e.g., % Fe for iron ore, % Cu for copper, g/t Au for gold) in the ore scheduled for extraction. Expressed as a decimal fraction or percentage per commodity convention. Drives mill feed quality targets and recovery rate planning.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012; Cut-off Grade Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production schedule record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.

products.name: mining_block
products.description: Spatial mining block representing a discrete volumetric unit of ore or waste material scheduled for extraction. Captures block centroid coordinates, elevation, bench number (open-cut) or level/drive (underground), estimated tonnes, in-situ grade by element, density, dilution factor, recovery factor, and extraction sequence priority. Sourced from Geovia GEMS and Hexagon MinePlan block models. The fundamental spatial unit linking the geological resource model to mine production scheduling, grade control, and reconciliation.

attributes.name: mining_block_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the mining block record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this spatial volumetric unit.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Block Model

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mine_area. Business justification: A mining block is spatially located within a mine area. This FK enables grouping of mining blocks by operational mine area for scheduling, reporting, and resource allocation. No bidirectional conflict

attributes.name: bench_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.bench. Business justification: mining_block has bench_number (INT) but no FK to bench table. Adding bench_id FK normalizes bench reference and removes redundant bench_number column. The bench table contains sequence_number which se

attributes.name: block_model_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent geological block model from which this block originates. Links the block to its resource estimation model in Geovia GEMS or Hexagon MinePlan.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Mining blocks are classified by commodity (iron ore, copper, coal) driving cutoff grade, scheduling priority, and LOM planning. Grade control and reserve classification reports require commodity linka

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site or operation where this block is located. Enables multi-site enterprise reporting and LOM planning aggregation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: Mining blocks inherit geological domain classification for resource reporting. Required for JORC/NI 43-101 compliance, reserve classification, and ensuring mining units align with estimation domains.

attributes.name: grade_control_drill_hole_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Grade Control Drill Hole Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.drill_hole. Business justification: Mining blocks are grade-estimated from drill hole assays. Grade control and F1/F2/F3 reconciliation reports trace block grades back to the defining drill hole. Role prefix 'grade_control_' distinguish

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.lom_plan. Business justification: Mining blocks are scheduled within LOM plan. N:1 relationship (many blocks in one LOM plan). No bidirectional conflict. Valid planning link.

attributes.name: ore_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.ore_reserve. Business justification: Mining blocks are classified against ore reserves. Reserve classification (proved/probable) is assigned to mining blocks for production reporting, reserve depletion tracking, and regulatory compliance

attributes.name: pit_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.pit_design. Business justification: Mining blocks are spatially located within pit designs. N:1 relationship (many blocks in one pit design). No bidirectional conflict. Valid spatial link.

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: Reference to the open-cut pit or underground level/drive to which this block is assigned for extraction planning and scheduling.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: Mining blocks are spatial subdivisions of prospects being extracted. Grade control and reconciliation require linking mined blocks back to the exploration prospect for variance analysis, resource mode

attributes.name: resource_estimate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.resource_estimate. Business justification: Mining blocks inherit tonnage and grade from resource estimates. Block models are derived from resource estimates for mine planning and grade control. Essential for tracing mining blocks back to the s

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Resource blocks must be attributed to tenements for JORC/NI 43-101 reserve reporting, royalty calculations on extracted ore, and compliance with mining lease resource classification requirements.

attributes.name: wireframe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.wireframe. Business justification: Mining blocks are spatially constrained by wireframe boundaries. Required for determining which blocks are inside ore zones, calculating ore/waste classification, and spatial queries.

attributes.name: actual_extraction_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which extraction of this block commenced. Populated post-extraction from FMS (Fleet Management System) or SCADA records. Used for schedule variance analysis and production reconciliation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; OSIsoft PI System SCADA Integration

attributes.name: block_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the mining block within the source geological block model (Geovia GEMS or Hexagon MinePlan). Used for cross-system reconciliation and grade control referencing.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: block_height_m
attributes.description: Height dimension of the mining block in metres (Z-direction / bench height). Corresponds to the bench height in open-cut or the stope height in underground operations.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: block_length_m
attributes.description: Length dimension of the mining block in metres (Y-direction in the block model). Used with width and height to compute block volume and in-situ tonnage.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: block_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name or label for the mining block, typically incorporating bench, drive, or stope identifiers for operational reference.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: block_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mining block within the production workflow. Tracks progression from resource model through scheduling, active extraction, and post-extraction reconciliation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Mine Planning; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: block_width_m
attributes.description: Width dimension of the mining block in metres (X-direction in the block model). Together with height and length defines the block volume used for tonnage estimation.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: centroid_easting_m
attributes.description: Easting coordinate (X-axis) of the block centroid in metres, referenced to the mine grid or UTM coordinate system. Used for spatial analysis, GIS integration, and block model visualisation.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; GIS Standards; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: centroid_elevation_m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Block Centroid Elevation (metres above sea level)
attributes.description: Elevation (Z-axis) of the block centroid in metres above sea level (mRL). Defines the vertical position of the block within the orebody and bench/level structure.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: centroid_northing_m
attributes.description: Northing coordinate (Y-axis) of the block centroid in metres, referenced to the mine grid or UTM coordinate system. Used for spatial analysis, GIS integration, and block model visualisation.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; GIS Standards; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: cutoff_grade
attributes.description: Minimum economic grade threshold applied to classify this block as ore or waste at the time of scheduling. Blocks with primary_grade below this value are classified as waste. Expressed in the same unit as primary_grade. Drives ore/waste classification and strip ratio calculations.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Grade Control; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: Estimated proportion of waste material mixed with ore during extraction, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.05 = 5% dilution). Accounts for planned and unplanned dilution from adjacent waste rock. Used to adjust mined grade and tonnage estimates for production scheduling.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Grade Control; Deswik Mine Planning; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: extraction_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence or priority order in which this block is scheduled for extraction within the mine plan. Lower values indicate earlier extraction. Drives the production schedule and LOM (Life of Mine) plan sequencing in Deswik and Hexagon MinePlan.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Scheduling; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: hardness_index
attributes.description: Measure of rock hardness or grindability, typically expressed as Bond Work Index (BWi) in kWh/t. Used to estimate comminution energy requirements for SAG mill and HPGR circuit design and throughput forecasting.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; LabWare LIMS; SAG/HPGR Comminution Standards

attributes.name: insitu_density
attributes.description: Estimated in-situ bulk density of the block material in tonnes per cubic metre (t/m³). Derived from geological sampling and used to convert block volume to tonnage. Critical input to resource estimation.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; JORC Code 2012; LabWare LIMS Assay Results

attributes.name: insitu_tonnes
attributes.description: Estimated in-situ (undisturbed) mass of the block in dry metric tonnes, calculated from block volume and in-situ density. The primary tonnage measure used in resource estimation and LOM scheduling.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC Code

attributes.name: level_or_drive
attributes.description: Underground level designation or drive name to which this block is assigned (e.g., '4200L', 'North Drive'). Applicable for underground mining methods only; null for open-cut blocks.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Stope Optimization

attributes.name: lom_period
attributes.description: Life of Mine (LOM) planning period to which this block is assigned, expressed as a year (e.g., '2027') or year-quarter (e.g., '2027-Q3'). Enables aggregation of block-level data to LOM schedule periods for strategic planning and NPV/IRR analysis.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Scheduling; Deswik Mine Planning; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the block material as ore, waste, low-grade, marginal ore, or overburden. Determines routing to processing plant, ROM pad, or waste dump. Directly impacts strip ratio calculations and cut-off grade decisions.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Grade Control; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: mining_method
attributes.description: Extraction method applied to this block. Distinguishes open-cut from underground methods including Sub-Level Caving (SLC), longwall, room-and-pillar, cut-and-fill, and stoping. Drives drill-and-blast design and equipment selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open_cut|underground_sublevel_caving|underground_longwall|underground_room_and_pillar|underground_cut_and_fill|underground_stoping|underground_block_caving — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Stope Optimization; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: model_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this block's attributes in the source geological block model. Supports data lineage tracking, reconciliation workflows, and audit trail requirements under JORC and regulatory reporting frameworks.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; JORC Code 2012; IFRS 6; ISO 14001

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the geological block model from which this block's attributes were sourced (e.g., 'v3.2.1'). Enables traceability of resource estimates to specific model iterations for JORC/NI 43-101 compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: oxidation_state
attributes.description: Weathering and oxidation classification of the block material. Fresh rock is unweathered; transitional is partially weathered; oxidised is fully weathered. Determines metallurgical processing route (e.g., oxide ore may require heap leaching vs. fresh ore flotation).
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; LabWare LIMS Assay Results

attributes.name: primary_grade
attributes.description: Estimated in-situ grade of the primary target element or commodity in the block, expressed as percentage (%) for base metals and iron ore, or grams per tonne (g/t) for precious metals. The principal economic value indicator for the block. Unit of measure is defined in primary_grade_unit.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; LabWare LIMS Assay Results

attributes.name: primary_grade_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the primary element grade value. Percentage (pct) is used for iron ore, copper, and coal; grams per tonne (g/t) for gold and silver; parts per million (ppm) for trace elements.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; JORC Code 2012; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: recovery_factor
attributes.description: Estimated proportion of the target mineral that will be successfully extracted and recovered through the processing circuit, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.88 = 88% recovery). Incorporates both mining recovery and metallurgical recovery. Used to calculate payable metal from the block.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101

attributes.name: resource_classification
attributes.description: JORC/NI 43-101/SAMREC mineral resource or ore reserve classification assigned to this block. Measured Resource is the highest confidence category; Inferred Resource is the lowest. Proved Reserve and Probable Reserve are ore reserve categories derived from resource estimates. Critical for regulatory reporting and investor disclosure.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC Code; SEC S-K 1300; IFRS 6

attributes.name: rock_type
attributes.description: Lithological rock type classification for the block (e.g., 'GRANITE', 'BASALT', 'SHALE', 'MAGNETITE_QUARTZITE'). Influences blast design parameters, comminution energy requirements, and processing circuit selection.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: scheduled_extraction_date
attributes.description: Planned calendar date on which extraction of this block is scheduled to commence, as defined in the current mine production schedule. Used for LOM planning, fleet scheduling, and processing plant feed forecasting.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Scheduling; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: strip_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of waste/overburden tonnes to ore tonnes associated with this block's extraction context. Expressed as waste:ore (e.g., 3.5 means 3.5 tonnes of waste per tonne of ore). Key economic indicator for open-cut mine viability and OPEX estimation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Mine Planning; JORC Code 2012

products.name: blast_execution
products.description: Complete drill-and-blast lifecycle record covering the planned design (hole pattern, spacing, burden, depth, explosive type, powder factor, fragmentation targets, initiation sequence) and actual execution outcomes (blast date/time, location, explosive consumption, detonation sequence, misfires, exclusion zone compliance, vibration/airblast monitoring, post-blast fragmentation assessment). Includes pattern compliance metrics and links to target mining blocks. Sourced from Hexagon MinePlan, blast management systems (BME, Orica SHOTPlus), and IsoMetrix. The SSOT for the full drill-and-blast cycle from design through execution to quality assessment.

attributes.name: blast_execution_id
attributes.description: Primary key for blast_execution

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mine_area. Business justification: Blasts occur within defined mine areas. This FK provides geographic/operational context for blast execution records and enables area-level reporting and analysis. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: bench_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.bench. Business justification: blast_execution has bench_elevation_m (DECIMAL) but no FK to bench table. Adding bench_id FK normalizes bench reference and removes redundant elevation column. The bench table contains elevation_rl_m,

attributes.name: blast_pattern_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.blast_pattern. Business justification: blast_execution has blast_pattern_type (STRING) but no FK to blast_pattern table. Adding blast_pattern_id FK allows normalization of blast pattern details and removes redundant string column. The blas

attributes.name: blast_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Blasting is high-risk activity requiring documented risk assessment before execution. Regulatory requirement in all mining jurisdictions. Complements existing incident link by capturing preventive con

attributes.name: chemical_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.chemical_register. Business justification: Explosives are regulated dangerous goods requiring chemical registration with SDS and handling procedures. Links blast to chemical register for regulatory compliance and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Blast events are costed to specific cost centres for drill-and-blast cost tracking, explosive cost allocation, and AISC calculation. Direct operational cost link for mining activities.

attributes.name: drill_rig_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Blast operations require tracking which drill rig prepared the blast pattern for compliance verification, equipment performance analysis, and blast design optimization. Mining operations must trace bl

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.emergency_response_plan. Business justification: Blast executions reference the emergency response plan for misfire procedures, exclusion zone management, and re-entry protocols. Blast controllers must confirm the applicable ERP before initiating a

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site where the blast was executed. Enables multi-site reporting and site-level production reconciliation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Caterpillar MineStar FMS; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: Blast events are tracked by geological domain for fragmentation and recovery analysis. Required for optimizing blast designs by rock type and understanding domain-specific mining performance.

attributes.name: heritage_clearance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.heritage_clearance. Business justification: Blasting in any area requires a valid heritage clearance before work can proceed — a hard regulatory requirement in Australian and other jurisdictions. The blast execution record must reference the he

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident ID
attributes.description: Reference to an associated HSE incident record in IsoMetrix if a safety or environmental event (e.g., flyrock, misfire, dust, vibration exceedance) occurred during or as a result of this blast. Null if no incident was recorded.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix; ISO 45001; MSHA 30 CFR Part 57; ISO 14001

attributes.name: mining_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the target mining block(s) associated with this blast event, linking blast execution to the geological block model and production schedule.

attributes.name: opex_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.opex_budget. Business justification: Blast execution costs (explosives, drilling, labour) are tracked against OPEX budgets for variance reporting. Mine controllers compare actual blast costs to OPEX budget by period — a standard mine cos

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Blast events occur within orebody boundaries. Essential for ore recovery tracking, dilution analysis, fragmentation assessment, and reconciliation of blasted material against geological models.

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific open-cut pit or underground level where the blast was executed. Supports spatial analysis and strip ratio tracking by pit.

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.production_schedule. Business justification: Blast events are executed as part of a production schedule. N:1 relationship (many blasts per schedule). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: Blasts occur within prospect boundaries. Blast reporting and reconciliation track which prospect is being mined for production accounting, grade control, and resource depletion tracking. Required for

attributes.name: regulatory_condition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.regulatory_condition. Business justification: Blasting operations must comply with specific regulatory conditions (ground vibration limits, airblast overpressure, timing restrictions). The blast execution record must reference the applicable regu

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.shift_report. Business justification: Blast events occur during a shift and are reported in shift report. N:1 relationship (many blasts per shift). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: stope_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.stope_design. Business justification: For underground mining operations, a blast execution is performed against a specific stope design. This FK links the blast event to the stope design it is executing, enabling design-vs-actual comparis

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_master. Business justification: Blast execution consumes explosives managed in material master. Critical for: explosive inventory tracking, blast cost accounting, regulatory compliance (explosives usage reporting), procurement plann

attributes.name: target_commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Blasts target specific commodity zones (ore vs waste, different ore types). Critical for blast design optimization, fragmentation targets, and downstream processing requirements. New attribute needed

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Blast events tracked by tenement for expenditure commitment reporting, environmental compliance monitoring (noise/vibration limits per tenement conditions), and regulatory audit trails for explosives

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.warehouse_location. Business justification: Blast execution draws explosives from licensed explosive magazines (warehouse_location). Critical for: explosive inventory tracking, magazine stock reconciliation, regulatory compliance (explosive mov

attributes.name: actual_explosive_mass_kg
attributes.description: Total mass of explosive in kilograms actually consumed during loading and detonation. Compared against planned to compute consumption variance and update explosive inventory in SAP MM.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; Orica SHOTPlus; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: actual_hole_count
attributes.description: Number of blast holes actually drilled and loaded at the time of detonation. Compared against planned_hole_count to compute pattern compliance and identify deviations.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Orica SHOTPlus; ICMM Blasting Guidelines

attributes.name: airblast_overpressure_db
attributes.description: Peak airblast overpressure in decibels (dB) measured at the nearest sensitive receiver. Used to assess compliance with community noise and airblast limits specified in the mine's Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) and operating licence.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; AS 2187.2; IsoMetrix; OSIsoft PI System; ISO 14001

attributes.name: blast_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the blast design and loading plan received formal approval from the authorised blast engineer or mine manager. Required for regulatory compliance and audit trail under MSHA and state mining regulations.
attributes.references: MSHA 30 CFR Part 57; ISO 45001; IsoMetrix; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: blast_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the blast event by the blast management system (e.g., SHOTPlus or BME). Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to the blast ID in Hexagon MinePlan and IsoMetrix incident linkage.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Orica SHOTPlus; ICMM Blasting Guidelines

attributes.name: blast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the blast event, tracking progression from design through execution and post-blast clearance. Drives exclusion zone management and shift handover communications.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; IsoMetrix HSE Workflow; ISO 45001

attributes.name: blasted_rock_mass_t
attributes.description: Estimated total mass of rock in tonnes broken by the blast, derived from the blast volume and in-situ rock density. Used for powder factor calculation, production reconciliation, and haulage planning.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Geovia GEMS; ICMM Blasting Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the blast execution record was first created in the source blast management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: detonation_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time at which the blast was detonated. The principal real-world event timestamp for the blast execution lifecycle. Recorded to millisecond precision for vibration and airblast monitoring correlation.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; IsoMetrix; Orica SHOTPlus

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of waste material mixed with ore during the blast, expressed as a percentage of total blasted material. High dilution reduces head grade and processing efficiency. A key blast quality KPI tracked against the LOM plan.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Blasting Guidelines

attributes.name: exclusion_zone_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exclusion zone was fully established and verified clear of personnel and equipment prior to detonation. Non-compliance triggers mandatory IsoMetrix HSE incident reporting.

attributes.name: exclusion_zone_radius_m
attributes.description: Radius in metres of the mandatory exclusion zone established around the blast area prior to detonation. Determined by blast design and regulatory requirements to protect personnel and equipment from flyrock.
attributes.references: MSHA 30 CFR Part 57; ISO 45001; ICMM Blasting Guidelines; IsoMetrix

attributes.name: fragmentation_p80_mm
attributes.description: Post-blast fragmentation size at the 80th percentile in millimetres, assessed via photogrammetry or image analysis (e.g., Split-Desktop, WipFrag). Indicates whether the blast achieved the target fragmentation for downstream crusher and mill feed requirements.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; Orica SHOTPlus; BME Blast Management System

attributes.name: fragmentation_target_p80_mm
attributes.description: Planned target fragmentation size at the 80th percentile in millimetres as specified in the blast design. Compared against actual fragmentation_p80_mm to assess blast quality and optimise future designs.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; Hexagon MinePlan; Orica SHOTPlus

attributes.name: initiation_system_type
attributes.description: Type of detonation initiation system used (e.g., electronic, non-electric NONEL, shock tube). Electronic systems (e.g., Orica i-kon, Dyno Nobel DigiShot) provide precise timing control for vibration management.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; Orica SHOTPlus; MSHA 30 CFR Part 57

attributes.name: mining_method
attributes.description: Mining method applicable to this blast event. Distinguishes open-cut bench blasting from underground methods such as Sub-Level Caving (SLC) or longhole stoping, which have different design and safety requirements.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; ICMM Blasting Guidelines

attributes.name: misfire_count
attributes.description: Number of holes that failed to detonate as planned during the blast event. Misfires are a critical safety hazard requiring mandatory reporting under MSHA and state mining regulations and must be managed per IsoMetrix HSE incident workflow.
attributes.references: MSHA 30 CFR Part 57.6800; ISO 45001; IsoMetrix; ICMM Blasting Guidelines

attributes.name: misfire_resolved
attributes.description: Indicates whether all misfires identified during this blast event have been safely resolved and cleared. A value of False triggers a mandatory hold on re-entry and follow-up IsoMetrix HSE action.

attributes.name: ore_tonnes_blasted
attributes.description: Estimated mass of ore-grade material in tonnes broken by the blast, based on the geological block model classification. Used for production reconciliation, dilution tracking, and ROM pad inventory updates.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012; CIM Standards

attributes.name: peak_particle_velocity_mms
attributes.description: Maximum ground vibration measured in millimetres per second (mm/s) at the nearest sensitive receiver during the blast. Compared against regulatory and community limits to assess vibration compliance. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System seismograph integration.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; ISO 4866; AS 2187.2; IsoMetrix; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: planned_burden_m
attributes.description: Designed distance in metres between the blast hole and the free face (burden). A critical blast design parameter controlling fragmentation, flyrock risk, and ground vibration.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; Orica SHOTPlus; BME Blast Management System

attributes.name: planned_explosive_mass_kg
attributes.description: Total mass of explosive in kilograms specified in the approved blast design across all holes. Used for powder factor calculation and explosive inventory planning.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; Orica SHOTPlus; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: planned_hole_count
attributes.description: Number of blast holes specified in the approved blast design. Used as the baseline for pattern compliance assessment against actual drilled and loaded holes.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Orica SHOTPlus; ICMM Blasting Guidelines

attributes.name: planned_hole_depth_m
attributes.description: Designed depth of each blast hole in metres as specified in the blast design. Includes sub-drill allowance below the bench floor to ensure complete fragmentation at the toe.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; Hexagon MinePlan; Orica SHOTPlus

attributes.name: planned_spacing_m
attributes.description: Designed distance in metres between adjacent blast holes within a row. Together with burden, determines the powder factor and fragmentation distribution.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; Orica SHOTPlus; BME Blast Management System

attributes.name: powder_factor_kg_per_t
attributes.description: Ratio of actual explosive mass consumed (kg) to the total mass of rock blasted (tonnes). A key blast efficiency metric used to optimise fragmentation, digging rates, and explosive costs. Calculated as actual_explosive_mass_kg / blasted_rock_mass_t.
attributes.references: ICMM Blasting Guidelines; Orica SHOTPlus; BME Blast Management System

attributes.name: re_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the exclusion zone was lifted and personnel were authorised to re-enter the blast area following post-blast inspection and fume clearance. Critical for shift productivity and safety compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the blast execution record, capturing design revisions, status transitions, or post-blast assessment updates.

attributes.name: waste_tonnes_blasted
attributes.description: Estimated mass of waste rock in tonnes broken by the blast. Used for strip ratio calculation, waste dump scheduling, and overburden haulage planning.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012

products.name: material_movement
products.description: Transactional record of all material movement from source (bench, stope, ROM pad, stockpile) to destination (crusher, stockpile, processing plant, waste dump). Captures tonnes moved, source location, destination location, material type (ore, waste, low-grade), estimated grade, truck/conveyor ID, shift, operator, and dispatch instruction reference. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar FMS and dispatch systems. The SSOT for ore, waste, and material flow tracking across the mine.

attributes.name: material_movement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for material_movement

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mine_area. Business justification: A material movement event occurs within a specific mine area. This FK enables aggregation of material movements by mine area for production reporting and operational analysis. No bidirectional conflic

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the haul truck, conveyor, or other equipment unit that performed this material movement. Sourced from the Fleet Management System (FMS) equipment registry.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Equipment Registry; Infor EAM — Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: bench_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.bench. Business justification: material_movement has source_bench_elevation_m (DECIMAL) but no FK to bench table. Adding bench_id FK normalizes bench reference and removes redundant elevation column. The bench table contains elevat

attributes.name: blast_execution_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the drill-and-blast event that fragmented the material prior to this movement. Links material movement to the blast design and execution record for fragmentation quality and dilution analysis.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan — Drill and Blast; Deswik — Blast Design

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Material movement records track ore movement by commodity — a core mine production KPI. Commodity-level movement reporting drives royalty calculations and production reporting. 'commodity_code' plain

attributes.name: destination_location_functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination location to which material was delivered, such as a crusher, processing plant, stockpile, or waste dump. Sourced from the mine location registry.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan — Mine Design; Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Location Registry

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: Material movements record geological domain for downstream processing optimization. Required for metallurgical blending, understanding domain-specific recovery rates, and plant feed quality control.

attributes.name: haulage_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.haulage_cycle. Business justification: A material movement record can be linked to the specific haulage cycle that physically executed the movement. This FK enables traceability from the material movement transaction to the individual truc

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Material movement operations frequently involved in incidents (collisions, spills, rollovers). Links specific movement records to incident investigations for root cause analysis and equipment/location

attributes.name: mining_block_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the geological block model cell or polygon from which the moved material originated. Enables grade reconciliation between the geological model and actual production, supporting JORC resource reporting.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS — Geological Block Model; JORC Code 2012 — Resource Estimation

attributes.name: movement_cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Material movements are costed to cost centres for haulage cost allocation, unit cost calculation, and mining cost tracking. Core operational finance link. Reusing cost_centre_code as denormalized fiel

attributes.name: opex_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.opex_budget. Business justification: Material movement (haulage, loading) is the largest OPEX line in open-cut mining. Linking movements to OPEX budgets enables unit cost ($/t moved) variance analysis against budget — a core mine cost co

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Material movements track which orebody material originated from. Critical for production reconciliation, stockpile grade management, and validating resource model predictions against actual mined mate

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.pit_or_level. Business justification: material_movement has source_pit_name (STRING) but no FK to pit_or_level table. Adding pit_or_level_id FK normalizes pit/level reference and removes redundant name column. The pit_or_level table conta

attributes.name: primary_material_functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source location from which material was extracted or loaded, such as a bench, stope, ROM pad, or stockpile. Sourced from the mine location registry.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan — Mine Design; Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Location Registry

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the short-term or long-term production schedule plan against which this material movement is reconciled. Enables actual vs. planned production variance analysis and LOM (Life of Mine) schedule tracking.
attributes.references: Deswik — Mine Scheduling; Hexagon MinePlan — Scheduling; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: Ore movements originate from specific prospects. Material tracking and grade reconciliation require prospect-level attribution for metallurgical accounting, blending decisions, and production reportin

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Material movement operations (rehandle, ROM delivery, waste placement) require pre-task risk assessments covering traffic management, ground conditions, and proximity hazards. Supervisors reference th

attributes.name: rom_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.rom_stockpile. Business justification: Material movements can be dispatched TO ROM stockpiles as destination. N:1 relationship (many movements to one stockpile). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: safety_observation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.safety_observation. Business justification: Material movement operations are primary focus of safety observations for at-risk behaviors and conditions. Links movement records to leading indicator program for proactive risk management.

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.shift_report. Business justification: Material movements occur during a shift and roll up to shift report. N:1 relationship (many movements per shift). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: source_tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Ore movements must track source tenement for accurate royalty calculations (rates vary by tenement/state), production reporting by license area, and expenditure commitment substantiation for regulator

attributes.name: stope_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.stope_design. Business justification: For underground operations, material movement originates from a specific stope. This FK links the movement transaction to the stope design from which material was extracted, enabling design-vs-actual

attributes.name: waste_dump_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.waste_dump. Business justification: Waste material movements are dispatched to waste dumps as destination. N:1 relationship (many movements to one dump). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this material movement record was first captured and persisted in the data platform. Distinct from the business event start timestamp.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standard

attributes.name: cycle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes for the complete material movement cycle, from loading at the source to dumping at the destination and returning to queue. Key input for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) and fleet productivity analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Cycle Time Tracking; OEE Standard

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that generated this material movement record. Supports data lineage, quality assessment, and reconciliation between FMS, SCADA, and manual entry sources.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System — SCADA Integration; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: destination_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the destination facility or location, such as the crusher name, processing plant name, stockpile identifier, ROM pad name, or waste dump name. Complements destination_location_id for operational reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Location Registry; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of waste or gangue material mixed with ore during extraction and loading, expressed as a percentage of total tonnes moved. Dilution reduces the effective head grade and impacts mineral processing recovery. Sourced from geological model and blast design.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 — Dilution; Geovia GEMS — Resource Estimation; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: dry_tonnes
attributes.description: Weight of material in metric dry tonnes, calculated by adjusting tonnes_delivered for moisture content. Dry tonnes is the standard unit for commodity sales contracts, JORC resource reporting, and revenue recognition under CIF/FOB terms.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 — Dry Metric Tonne; CIF/FOB Contract Standards; IFRS 15

attributes.name: estimated_grade_pct
attributes.description: Estimated head grade of the primary commodity in the moved material, expressed as a percentage (e.g., % Fe for iron ore, % Cu for copper). Derived from the geological block model at the source location. Used for ore quality tracking and production reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 — Grade Estimation; Geovia GEMS — Resource Estimation; Hexagon MinePlan — Geology Modeling

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material movement record has been reconciled against the production plan, weighbridge data, and geological model as part of the mine production reconciliation process. True = reconciled; False = pending reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 — Production Reconciliation; Hexagon MinePlan — Reconciliation

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the material being moved, providing additional context beyond the material type classification, such as lithology, ore zone name, or specific waste rock type.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS — Geological Modeling; Hexagon MinePlan — Mine Design

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material being moved. Distinguishes between ore (economic mineral-bearing rock), waste (non-economic rock), low-grade ore, overburden (material above the ore body), and Run of Mine (ROM) material. Critical for strip ratio and production reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 — Resource Classification; Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Material Classification

attributes.name: mining_method
attributes.description: The mining method used to extract the material at the source location. Distinguishes between open-cut (surface) and underground methods including Sub-Level Caving (SLC), longwall, and room-and-pillar. Drives operational reporting and cost allocation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Hexagon MinePlan — Mine Design; Deswik — Stope Optimization

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Estimated moisture content of the moved material expressed as a percentage of total weight. Moisture affects the dry tonne calculation, commodity grade reporting, and processing plant feed quality. Sourced from geological sampling or SCADA sensors.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS — Sample Management; OSIsoft PI System — SCADA Integration; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: movement_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when the material movement was completed, i.e., when the haul truck or conveyor finished dumping or delivering material at the destination location.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Cycle Time Tracking; OSIsoft PI System — SCADA Integration

attributes.name: movement_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this material movement transaction, formatted as MM-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Used for cross-system reconciliation between FMS, SCADA, and ERP.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Dispatch Transaction Reference

attributes.name: movement_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when the material movement commenced, i.e., when the haul truck or conveyor began loading or transporting material at the source location. Principal business event time for this transaction.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Cycle Time Tracking; OSIsoft PI System — SCADA Integration

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material movement transaction as tracked by the Fleet Management System (FMS). Drives production reporting and dispatch reconciliation.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the movement activity type. Primary haul is direct extraction to destination; rehandle is movement of previously stockpiled material; stockpile reclaim is feeding from a stockpile to the plant; ROM feed is delivery to the Run of Mine (ROM) pad; waste dump is disposal of waste rock.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Movement Classification; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: payload_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual payload weight in metric tonnes as measured by the truck's on-board payload management system (TPMS) at the point of loading. Distinct from tonnes_loaded (weighbridge) and tonnes_delivered (destination). Used for truck utilisation and overloading compliance.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Truck Payload Management System (TPMS)

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The calendar date of the production shift during which this material movement occurred. Used as the primary date dimension for daily production reporting, shift-based reconciliation, and operational dashboards.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Shift Record; SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Centre Reporting

attributes.name: strip_ratio_contribution
attributes.description: The incremental contribution of this movement to the strip ratio calculation, expressed as the ratio of waste tonnes to ore tonnes moved in this transaction. Aggregated to compute the overall strip ratio (overburden to ore ratio) for the pit or mining area.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Hexagon MinePlan — Mine Planning; Deswik — Mine Scheduling

attributes.name: tonnes_delivered
attributes.description: Net weight in metric tonnes of material delivered and confirmed at the destination location, as recorded by the FMS or weighbridge at the crusher or stockpile. May differ from tonnes_loaded due to spillage or measurement variance.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Payload Management System; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: tonnes_loaded
attributes.description: Gross weight in metric tonnes of material loaded onto the haul truck or conveyor at the source location, as measured by the on-board payload management system or weighbridge.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Payload Management System; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The mode of transport used to move material from source to destination. Distinguishes between haul truck, conveyor belt, rail, front-end loader (FEL), and underground truck, enabling mode-specific cost and productivity analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS — Equipment Classification; Infor EAM — Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this material movement record was last modified in the data platform, such as after a correction or status update from the FMS.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standard

products.name: rom_stockpile
products.description: Master record of Run of Mine (ROM) stockpile areas including stockpile name, location, design capacity, ore type classification, and reclaim priority. Includes time-series inventory snapshots capturing current tonnes on pad, estimated head grade by element, ore type split, moisture content, and reconciliation variance against production schedule. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar, survey data, and OSIsoft PI. The SSOT for ROM pad configuration, inventory state, and grade management for processing plant feed quality.

attributes.name: rom_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the ROM stockpile master record. Primary key for this entity. MASTER_RESOURCE role — serves as the globally unique reference for all ROM pad configuration, inventory, and grade management records.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.area. Business justification: A ROM stockpile is a physical facility located within a specific mine area. The area table is the spatial reference for mine zones, and all other physical mine facilities (waste_dump, blast_execution,

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: ROM stockpiles are commodity-specific (iron ore ROM pad, copper ROM pad). Inventory reporting, ore routing to processing, and stockpile quality management all require commodity linkage. No existing co

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: ROM stockpiles are managed under specific cost centres for inventory valuation, ore handling cost tracking, and stockpile management cost allocation. Asset-based costing for mining operations.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.environmental_permit. Business justification: ROM stockpiles may require permits for dust emissions and stormwater runoff management. Links stockpile operations to environmental compliance obligations and monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: ROM stockpiles (pads, infrastructure) are capitalized as fixed assets for depreciation, asset register management, and balance sheet reporting. Asset accounting link for mining infrastructure.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.functional_location. Business justification: ROM stockpiles are physical infrastructure (reclaim conveyors, dust suppression, dozer pads) requiring scheduled maintenance. They map to functional locations in the maintenance hierarchy for PM sched

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: ROM stockpiles are segregated by geological domain for metallurgical performance. Required for blending strategies, recovery optimization, and managing domain-specific processing characteristics.

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Life of Mine (LOM) plan under which this ROM stockpile is designed and scheduled. Links stockpile configuration to the governing mine plan for long-term production scheduling and capital planning.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: mine_site_id
attributes.description: FK to mine.mine_site

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.pit_or_level. Business justification: A ROM stockpile is operationally associated with a specific pit (open-cut) or level (underground) that it serves as the primary receiving point for mined ore. This relationship enables production trac

attributes.name: primary_tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: ROM stockpiles often blend ore from multiple tenements; tracking primary source tenement enables royalty allocation, grade reconciliation by license area, and accurate production reporting for regulat

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: ROM stockpiles accumulate ore from specific prospects. Stockpile management tracks source prospect for blending decisions, metallurgical planning, and grade reconciliation. Critical for managing ore q

attributes.name: rehabilitation_provision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.rehabilitation_provision. Business justification: ROM stockpile pads are disturbed land requiring rehabilitation at closure. Each stockpile pad has a specific rehabilitation provision for pad removal and revegetation — required under environmental pe

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: ROM stockpile operations (stacking, reclaim) require geotechnical stability and operational risk assessments. Stockpile engineers reference the governing risk assessment for safe stacking height limit

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: ROM stockpiles feed processing plants producing specific saleable products. Ore routing decisions and stockpile quality management are made against saleable product specifications. Domain experts trac

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: ROM stockpile quality (head grade, moisture, impurities) is managed against product specification limits. ROM pad managers use spec limits to make ore routing and blending decisions. This is a core or

attributes.name: surface_right_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.surface_right. Business justification: ROM stockpiles occupy land surface and require a surface right agreement. The stockpile record must reference the surface right authorising that land use for legal compliance, land access management,

attributes.name: bulk_density_t_m3
attributes.description: Estimated bulk density of the ROM stockpile material in tonnes per cubic metre. Used to convert survey-derived volume measurements to tonne estimates for inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ROM stockpile pad was formally commissioned and made available for ore dumping operations. Marks the start of the operational lifecycle for this pad.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Infor EAM; Mine Planning Standards

attributes.name: current_inventory_t
attributes.description: Current estimated tonnes of ore on the ROM stockpile pad at the time of the last survey or inventory snapshot. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar truck dispatch data and periodic survey reconciliation.

attributes.name: cut_off_grade_pct
attributes.description: Minimum economic grade threshold applied to classify material as ore (vs waste) for this stockpile. Material below cut-off grade is directed to waste dumps. Determined by LOM economic parameters.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; CIM Standards; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ROM stockpile pad was formally decommissioned and removed from active operations. Null for currently active pads. Supports LOM planning and mine rehabilitation scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Infor EAM; ISO 14001

attributes.name: design_capacity_t
attributes.description: Maximum engineered storage capacity of the ROM stockpile pad in dry metric tonnes (DMT) as per mine design specifications. Used for capacity planning, haulage scheduling, and LOM planning.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Planning Standards

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of waste rock (gangue) mixed with ore in the ROM stockpile due to mining dilution. High dilution reduces head grade and processing plant recovery. Tracked against mine design dilution targets.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: easting_m
attributes.description: Easting coordinate of the ROM stockpile pad centroid in metres, referenced to the mine site local grid or MGA/UTM coordinate system. Used for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; GIS Standards; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation of the ROM stockpile pad base in metres above sea level (mAHD or equivalent datum). Used for drainage design, geotechnical assessment, and survey volume calculations.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the environmental permit or approval governing the operation of this ROM stockpile pad, including conditions related to dust suppression, drainage, and contamination prevention.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS Requirements; IsoMetrix; ICMM Principles

attributes.name: fms_zone_code
attributes.description: Zone code assigned to this ROM stockpile in the Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System (FMS). Used to track haul truck dump assignments, cycle times, and tonne delivery records to this pad.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations Standards

attributes.name: geotechnical_zone
attributes.description: Geotechnical classification zone of the stockpile pad foundation and surrounding area. Informs structural stability assessments, load-bearing capacity, and safe stacking height limits for the ROM pad.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Mine Geotechnical Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: head_grade_cu_pct
attributes.description: Estimated head grade of copper (Cu) content in the ROM stockpile expressed as a percentage. Applicable for copper operations; null for non-copper commodities. Sourced from LabWare LIMS assay results.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: head_grade_fe_pct
attributes.description: Estimated head grade of iron (Fe) content in the ROM stockpile expressed as a percentage. Derived from assay data and geological block model estimates. Used for processing plant feed quality management.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: head_grade_primary_pct
attributes.description: Estimated head grade of the primary valuable element in the ROM stockpile expressed as a percentage, applicable to the commodity type (e.g., Li2O for lithium, Ni for nickel, ash content for coal). Sourced from LabWare LIMS assay results and geological model.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: inventory_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the current inventory estimate was last updated or surveyed. Critical for understanding the currency of the inventory figure and scheduling reclaim operations.

attributes.name: max_stack_height_m
attributes.description: Maximum permitted stacking height of ore on the ROM stockpile pad in metres, as determined by geotechnical assessment and mine design. Exceeding this limit creates slope stability and safety risks.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Mine Geotechnical Standards; ISO 45001

attributes.name: mining_method
attributes.description: Primary mining method used to extract ore delivered to this ROM stockpile. Determines operational characteristics, dilution profiles, and equipment types associated with the material.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Planning Standards

attributes.name: moisture_content_pct
attributes.description: Estimated moisture content of the ROM stockpile material expressed as a percentage. Critical for accurate tonne reconciliation (wet vs dry), processing plant feed management, and transport logistics (weight limits).
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; OSIsoft PI System; ISO 3087 (Coal Moisture)

attributes.name: northing_m
attributes.description: Northing coordinate of the ROM stockpile pad centroid in metres, referenced to the mine site local grid or MGA/UTM coordinate system. Used for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; GIS Standards; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or contextual information about the ROM stockpile pad not captured in structured fields (e.g., temporary access restrictions, blending instructions, survey anomalies).

attributes.name: ore_recovery_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of in-situ ore successfully extracted and delivered to the ROM stockpile relative to the geological resource model estimate. Tracks ore loss during mining operations.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: pad_area_m2
attributes.description: Total surface area of the ROM stockpile pad in square metres as per mine design. Used for capacity calculations, survey volume estimation, and infrastructure planning.

attributes.name: reconciliation_variance_t
attributes.description: Difference between scheduled tonnes and actual surveyed inventory tonnes for the current period. Positive value indicates over-delivery; negative indicates under-delivery. Key metric for production schedule adherence and ore loss/dilution tracking.

attributes.name: scada_tag_code
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI System tag identifier associated with this ROM stockpile for real-time process data monitoring (e.g., belt scale feed rate, moisture sensor readings). Enables integration between the master record and time-series operational data.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SCADA Integration Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_tonnes_t
attributes.description: Planned tonnes to be delivered to this ROM stockpile in the current production scheduling period as per the mine production schedule. Used for reconciliation variance calculation against actual inventory.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: stockpile_code
