attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the ROM stockpile pad, used across operational systems including Caterpillar MineStar, OSIsoft PI, and mine planning tools. Unique within the mine site.

attributes.name: stockpile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the ROM stockpile pad (e.g., 'North ROM Pad 1', 'Crusher Feed Stockpile A'). Used in operational reporting and mine planning communications.

attributes.name: stockpile_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the ROM stockpile pad. Active = receiving material; Reclaiming = material being drawn down to processing plant; Full = at design capacity; Depleted = empty; On Hold = temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: stockpile_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the stockpile's operational role within the ore flow: ROM Pad (direct dump from haul trucks), Crusher Feed, Blend Stockpile, Low-Grade, High-Grade, or Waste. Drives processing plant feed sequencing.

attributes.name: surveyed_volume_m3
attributes.description: Volume of material on the ROM stockpile pad as measured by the most recent survey (drone, LiDAR, or conventional survey). Combined with bulk density to derive tonne inventory estimate.

products.name: haulage_cycle
products.description: Transactional record of an individual haul truck cycle from loading point to dump point, capturing truck ID, operator ID, loader/excavator ID, load origin (bench, stockpile), dump destination (crusher, stockpile, waste dump), payload tonnes, cycle time breakdown (spot, load, haul full, queue, dump, haul empty), distance travelled, fuel consumption, and road segment. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar FMS GPS telemetry. Enables truck-shovel match analysis, OEE calculation, and haulage route optimization.

attributes.name: haulage_cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual haul truck cycle record in the Silver layer. Primary key generated by the Databricks lakehouse ingestion pipeline from Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System (FMS) telemetry data.

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mine_area. Business justification: A haulage cycle operates within a specific mine area. This FK enables aggregation of haulage performance metrics by mine area, supporting fleet management and operational reporting. No bidirectional c

attributes.name: bench_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the mining bench or level from which the material was extracted for this cycle. Aligns with the mine design bench nomenclature in Hexagon MinePlan. Used for grade control, production scheduling, and geological reconciliation.

attributes.name: blast_execution_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.blast_execution. Business justification: A haulage cycle often directly follows a blast execution, hauling the blasted material from the blast area to ROM pad or waste dump. This FK links the haulage cycle to the originating blast event, ena

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Individual haulage cycles contribute to cost centre actuals for fleet cost tracking, fuel cost allocation, and productivity analysis. Operational cost allocation for mining haulage.

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: Haulage cycles track geological domain of source material for blending control. Required for real-time stockpile management, ensuring plant feed meets metallurgical specifications.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Haulage cycles that result in incidents (collision, near-miss, overloading injury) must be linked to the incident record for investigation and root cause analysis. Fleet management systems record the

attributes.name: mining_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mining_block. Business justification: Haulage cycles load from mining blocks. N:1 relationship (many cycles from one block). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Haulage cycles transport material from specific orebodies to destinations. Required for ore tracking, stockpile blending decisions, and linking equipment productivity to geological sources.

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.pit_or_level. Business justification: Haulage cycles originate from pits or underground levels. This FK provides source location context for material movement tracking. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: primary_haulage_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the haul truck asset that performed this cycle. Links to the equipment/fleet master record in the Fleet Management System (FMS) and Infor EAM asset registry.

attributes.name: primary_haulage_load_location_functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the spatial location (bench, pit, stope, or ROM pad) from which the truck was loaded. Links to the mine location/spatial master for origin-based production and grade tracking.

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.production_schedule. Business justification: Haulage cycles are executed against a production schedule. N:1 relationship (many cycles per schedule). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Haulage operations require pre-task risk assessments covering road conditions, load limits, and traffic management. Fleet management systems reference the active risk assessment for each haulage route

attributes.name: rom_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.rom_stockpile. Business justification: Haulage cycles can dump to ROM stockpiles. N:1 relationship (many cycles to one stockpile). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.shift_report. Business justification: Haulage cycles occur during a shift and roll up to shift report. N:1 relationship (many cycles per shift). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: tertiary_haulage_functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary haul road segment traversed during this cycle. Used for road condition monitoring, fuel consumption benchmarking by route, and haulage route optimisation.

attributes.name: waste_dump_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.waste_dump. Business justification: Haulage cycles can dump waste to waste dumps. N:1 relationship (many cycles to one dump). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: cycle_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when the haul truck completed the empty return haul and the cycle was closed. Used to calculate total cycle time and production throughput per shift.

attributes.name: cycle_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the haulage cycle as assigned by Caterpillar MineStar FMS. Used for cross-system traceability and operational reporting. Format: CYC-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX.

attributes.name: cycle_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when the haul truck arrived at the loading point and the cycle commenced (spot time begins). Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar GPS telemetry. Principal business event timestamp for the cycle.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the haulage cycle record. 'completed' indicates a full cycle was recorded; 'aborted' indicates the cycle was interrupted; 'partial' indicates incomplete telemetry data; 'under_review' indicates data quality investigation is in progress.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this cycle record was sourced. Primarily 'minestar' (Caterpillar MineStar FMS GPS telemetry), but may be 'manual' for dispatcher-entered corrections, 'scada' for SCADA-integrated sites, or 'pi_system' for OSIsoft PI System integrations.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: Estimated proportion (0.0 to 1.0) of waste or gangue material mixed with ore in this truck load, as assessed by the grade control model. Dilution (waste mixed with ore during mining) directly impacts mill feed grade and recovery rate. Key metric for mine planning reconciliation.

attributes.name: dump_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds from when the truck arrived at the dump point to when it departed after discharging its load. Includes tipping and body lowering time. Used in cycle time analysis and dump point throughput modelling.

attributes.name: dump_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the dump destination for this cycle. Values: crusher (primary crusher feed), rom_pad (Run of Mine stockpile pad), stockpile (grade-segregated stockpile), waste_dump (permanent waste rock dump), tsf (Tailings Storage Facility). Drives material flow reconciliation.

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_litres
attributes.description: Total diesel fuel consumed in litres during this haulage cycle as recorded by the truck's on-board fuel monitoring system integrated with Caterpillar MineStar. Used for C1 (C1 Cash Cost) per tonne calculation, OPEX tracking, and GHG emissions reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; ISO 14001

attributes.name: haul_empty_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds for the empty (return) haul from the dump destination back to the loading point. Compared against haul full time to assess road grade asymmetry and return route efficiency.

attributes.name: haul_full_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds for the loaded (full) haul from the loading point to the dump destination. Reflects haul road conditions, grade, distance, and truck speed. Key input for haulage route optimisation and fuel modelling.

attributes.name: is_overloaded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the truck payload exceeded the nominal rated payload capacity for this cycle (True = overloaded). Overloading causes accelerated tyre and suspension wear, increases maintenance costs, and may breach equipment warranty conditions. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar TPMS.

attributes.name: is_rehandle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle involved rehandling of previously stockpiled material (True = rehandle). Rehandle cycles are tracked separately from primary extraction cycles for accurate OPEX (Operating Expenditure) per tonne reporting and production efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: load_pass_count
attributes.description: Number of bucket/dipper passes made by the loading unit (excavator or shovel) to fill the haul truck to its payload target. Used in truck-shovel match factor analysis and loader bucket fill factor assessment.

attributes.name: load_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds from when loading commenced to when the truck departed the loading point with a full load. Reflects loader productivity and number of passes required. Used in truck-shovel match factor analysis.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material hauled during this cycle. Distinguishes ore (economic mineral-bearing rock) from waste (gangue and overburden) for strip ratio calculation, grade control, and production reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ore|waste|low_grade_ore|overburden|topsoil|tailings — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: nominal_payload_tonnes
attributes.description: The rated/design payload capacity of the haul truck model in metric tonnes as specified by the manufacturer. Used as the denominator for payload utilisation percentage calculation and overload detection.

attributes.name: ore_grade_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated head grade of the material in the truck load as assigned by the grade control model at the time of loading (e.g., % Fe for iron ore, % Cu for copper). Nullable for waste loads. Used for production grade reconciliation against JORC resource model.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: payload_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual measured payload weight of the truck load in metric tonnes, as recorded by the on-board payload monitoring system (TPMS) integrated with Caterpillar MineStar. Primary quantitative measure of material moved per cycle. Used for production reconciliation and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this haulage cycle occurred, derived from the cycle start timestamp. Used as the primary date dimension key for daily production reporting, shift reconciliation, and LOM (Life of Mine) plan vs actual tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: queue_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds the truck spent waiting in queue at the dump point before being able to discharge its load. Indicates crusher or dump point congestion. Used for bottleneck analysis and production scheduling optimisation.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this haulage cycle record was first ingested and created in the Databricks Silver layer. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of the FMS telemetry pipeline.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this haulage cycle record was last modified in the Databricks Silver layer, including dispatcher corrections, payload adjustments, or data quality remediation. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: spot_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds from when the truck arrived at the loading point to when loading commenced. Measures truck positioning efficiency. A key component of the cycle time breakdown used in truck-shovel match factor analysis.

attributes.name: total_cycle_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds for the complete haulage cycle from spot to end of empty return haul. Sum of spot, load, haul full, queue, dump, and haul empty times. Primary KPI input for truck productivity and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) reporting.

products.name: shift_report
products.description: Shift-level production performance record and the consolidated SSOT for all mine production actuals. Captures actual ore tonnes mined, waste tonnes moved, metres advanced (drill and development), blasts fired, equipment operating hours and utilisation rates versus scheduled targets, crew supervisor, significant events (breakdowns, safety incidents, weather delays), and handover notes. Includes daily rollup capability for management reporting. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar FMS, OSIsoft PI, and crew reporting systems. Feeds production reconciliation, KPI dashboards, regulatory production returns, and management reporting.

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the shift report record. Primary key for the shift_report data product in the mine domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mine_area. Business justification: A shift report covers production activities within a specific mine area. This FK enables shift performance reporting and analysis at the mine area level, supporting operational management. No bidirect

attributes.name: bench_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.bench. Business justification: A shift report is often associated with a specific bench where mining activities occurred during that shift. This FK enables bench-level production tracking and shift performance analysis. No bidirect

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Shift-level costs are allocated to cost centres for daily cost tracking, reconciliation against budget, and operational cost reporting. Standard shift-to-finance integration for mining operations.

attributes.name: cost_performance_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_performance_report. Business justification: Shift reports are the primary source data for period cost performance reports. Linking shift reports to the cost performance report they contribute to enables drill-down from period CPR to individual

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Shift reports document incidents that occurred during the shift for handover and management reporting. Standard mining operational practice to reference incidents in shift documentation.

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.lom_plan. Business justification: Shift reports track progress against LOM plan. N:1 relationship (many shifts in one LOM plan). No bidirectional conflict. Valid planning link.

attributes.name: mine_site_id
attributes.description: FK to mine.mine_site

attributes.name: opex_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.opex_budget. Business justification: Shift actuals are reconciled against opex budgets for daily cost control, forecast accuracy, and operational budget tracking. Real-time budget variance monitoring for mining operations.

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: FK to mine.pit_or_level

attributes.name: primary_commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Shift reports track which commodity was primarily mined during the shift. Required for daily production reporting, reconciliation against plan, and operational performance tracking. New attribute need

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine production schedule record that defines the targets for this shift. Links actuals to the scheduled plan for variance analysis and LOM planning reconciliation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Shift supervisors confirm the active risk assessment (SWMS/JSA) governing work activities before commencing each shift. The shift report references this document as evidence of pre-shift risk manageme

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Daily shift reports track production by tenement for expenditure commitment substantiation, quarterly regulatory reporting, and operational performance analysis by license area. Required for annual co

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.warehouse_location. Business justification: Shift reports track consumables usage from site warehouses (explosives, fuel, ground support). Business need: shift-level consumables reconciliation, warehouse demand forecasting, inventory replenishm

attributes.name: blasts_fired_count
attributes.description: Number of blast events executed during the shift. Used for drill-and-blast productivity tracking, explosive consumption reconciliation, and regulatory blast notification compliance.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP; MSHA; ISO 45001

attributes.name: breakdown_delay_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of production lost during the shift due to unplanned equipment breakdowns and mechanical failures. Used for Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) analysis and maintenance planning.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Infor EAM; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift report record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; ISO 14001; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: crew_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of personnel (operators, technicians, supervisors) who worked during the shift. Used for workforce productivity analysis, labour cost allocation, and safety compliance (persons on site).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; Caterpillar MineStar FMS; ISO 45001; MSHA

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of waste material mixed with ore during mining operations for the shift, expressed as a decimal. Dilution control is a critical operational metric impacting ore quality and processing recovery rates.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; Mine Operations SOP; JORC 2012

attributes.name: equipment_operating_hours
attributes.description: Total aggregate operating hours across all production equipment (trucks, excavators, drills) during the shift. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar FMS engine hours. Used for OEE calculation and maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Infor EAM; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: equipment_scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total aggregate scheduled operating hours for all production equipment during the shift as per the mine production schedule. Used as the denominator for equipment utilisation rate calculation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Hexagon MinePlan; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: equipment_utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Actual equipment utilisation rate for the shift expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.8500 = 85%). Calculated as equipment operating hours divided by equipment scheduled hours. Key input to Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP; OEE Industry Standard

attributes.name: handover_notes
attributes.description: Free-text handover communication from the outgoing shift supervisor to the incoming shift supervisor. Captures outstanding tasks, equipment status, safety hazards, and operational priorities for continuity of operations.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; ISO 45001; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: is_daily_rollup_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift report has been included in the daily production rollup for management reporting. True when the shift data has been aggregated into the daily summary; False when pending rollup.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift report record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; ISO 14001; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: lost_time_injury_count
attributes.description: Number of Lost Time Injuries (LTIs) recorded during the shift — injuries resulting in at least one full shift of lost work time. Key input to Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix; ISO 45001; MSHA; ICMM; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: metres_developed
attributes.description: Total metres of underground development advance (drives, declines, crosscuts) completed during the shift. Applicable to underground mining operations. Used for development schedule tracking.
attributes.references: Deswik; Hexagon MinePlan; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: metres_drilled
attributes.description: Total metres of drilling completed during the shift across all drill rigs, including blast hole drilling and development drilling. Used for drill-and-blast performance tracking and production scheduling.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: metres_drilled_target
attributes.description: Scheduled target metres of drilling for the shift as per the mine production schedule. Used for drill performance variance analysis.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: mining_method
attributes.description: The primary mining extraction method employed during this shift. Distinguishes open-cut from underground methods and specific underground techniques such as Sub-Level Caving (SLC), longwall, or cut-and-fill. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open_cut|underground_sublevel_caving|underground_longwall|underground_room_and_pillar|underground_cut_and_fill|underground_block_caving|surface_strip — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: ore_grade_fe_pct
attributes.description: Average head grade of iron (Fe) content in ore mined during the shift, expressed as a decimal percentage. Sourced from assay results and grade control data. Used for production reconciliation and mineral resource reporting.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS; JORC 2012; SEC S-K 1300; CIM Standards

attributes.name: ore_mined_target_tonnes
attributes.description: Scheduled target ore tonnes to be mined during the shift as per the mine production schedule. Used for variance analysis and production reconciliation against actuals.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: ore_mined_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual tonnes of ore material mined and dispatched to the Run of Mine (ROM) pad or stockpile during the shift. Core production KPI. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar FMS truck payload data and OSIsoft PI belt weigher integration.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System; JORC 2012; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: planned_maintenance_delay_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of production lost during the shift due to scheduled preventive maintenance activities. Distinguishes planned downtime from unplanned breakdowns for OEE and availability reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Infor EAM; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: safety_incident_count
attributes.description: Total number of safety incidents (including near misses, first aid, medical treatment, and lost time injuries) recorded during the shift. Used for LTIFR and TRIFR calculation and regulatory HSE reporting.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix; ISO 45001; MSHA; ICMM; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The calendar date to which this shift report is attributed for daily rollup and management reporting purposes. Aligns with the mine site operational day boundary (which may differ from midnight). Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: shift_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the shift concluded at the mine site. Used in conjunction with shift_start_timestamp to calculate shift duration and for production period boundary alignment.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: shift_report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the shift report, typically formatted as SR-YYYY-MM-DD-SHF-NNN (e.g., SR-2024-07-15-DAY-001). Used for cross-system reference, regulatory production returns, and management reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: shift_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the shift commenced at the mine site. Principal business event timestamp for the shift. Used for production reconciliation, KPI dashboards, and regulatory production returns. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System; JORC 2012

attributes.name: shift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shift report record. Draft indicates data entry in progress; submitted indicates supervisor sign-off; approved indicates management review complete; closed indicates period locked; voided indicates record cancelled.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift period within the 24-hour operational cycle. Typical values: day (e.g., 06:00–18:00), night (e.g., 18:00–06:00), afternoon, or extended for non-standard shift patterns.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: significant_events_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing significant events during the shift including major breakdowns, safety incidents, geotechnical events, blast misfires, environmental exceedances, or other notable occurrences. Critical for shift handover and management reporting.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; IsoMetrix; ISO 45001; ISO 14001

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this shift report data was sourced. Values: MINESTAR (Caterpillar MineStar FMS), OSI_PI (OSIsoft PI System), CREW_REPORT (crew reporting system), MANUAL (manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: strip_ratio_actual
attributes.description: Actual strip ratio for the shift, calculated as waste tonnes moved divided by ore tonnes mined (overburden to ore ratio). A key economic indicator for open-cut mining operations used in OPEX and LOM planning.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP; JORC 2012

attributes.name: waste_moved_target_tonnes
attributes.description: Scheduled target waste tonnes to be moved during the shift as per the mine production schedule. Used for strip ratio variance analysis and LOM planning reconciliation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: waste_moved_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual tonnes of waste rock (overburden and interburden) moved to waste dumps during the shift. Used to calculate the strip ratio and track overburden removal progress against the Life of Mine (LOM) plan.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the mine site during the shift. Used to contextualise production performance, explain delays, and support environmental and safety compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|storm|fog|dust_storm|snow|extreme_heat|hail — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: weather_delay_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of production lost during the shift due to adverse weather conditions (e.g., lightning stand-down, heavy rain, dust storm). Used for delay analysis and production variance reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP; ISO 14001

products.name: waste_dump
products.description: Master record of waste rock dump facilities including dump name, location coordinates, design capacity (tonnes/BCM), current fill volume, geotechnical classification, liner type, leachate management status, and rehabilitation plan reference. Sourced from mine planning systems and IsoMetrix. The SSOT for waste dump inventory and geotechnical compliance.

attributes.name: waste_dump_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the waste rock dump facility record. Primary key for the waste_dump master data product.

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mine_area. Business justification: A waste dump facility is located within a mine area. This FK enables spatial grouping of waste dump facilities by operational mine area for environmental management and capacity planning. No bidirecti

attributes.name: capex_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capex_budget. Business justification: Waste dump construction (earthworks, drainage, liner installation) is capital expenditure tracked against CAPEX budgets. Mine capital teams track waste dump construction spend vs approved CAPEX budget

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Waste dumps are managed under cost centres for waste handling cost tracking, rehabilitation provision calculation, and environmental cost management. Core environmental accounting link.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_id

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Waste dump infrastructure (liner systems, drainage, access roads) is capitalised as a fixed asset and depreciated over the mine life. Finance teams maintain fixed asset registers for waste dump infras

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.functional_location. Business justification: Waste dumps are physical facilities requiring ongoing maintenance including drainage systems, geotechnical monitoring infrastructure, and haul road maintenance. They map to functional locations for PM

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.lom_plan. Business justification: Waste dumps are planned as part of LOM plan. N:1 relationship (many dumps in one LOM plan). No bidirectional conflict. Valid planning link.

attributes.name: mine_site_id
attributes.description: FK to mine.mine_site

attributes.name: pit_design_id
attributes.description: Reference to the open-cut pit or underground mining area that primarily generates the waste material deposited in this dump. Supports strip ratio and waste tracking by source area.

attributes.name: rehabilitation_provision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.rehabilitation_provision. Core environmental accounting link for mining closure oblig

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id

Sourced from LabWare LIMS, Caterpillar MineStar, and Geovia GEMS. Critical for JORC compliance and resource model confidence.

The royalty calculation run references reconciled figures; linking producti

Business justification: Reconciled production volumes (actual tonnes and grades) are the basis for royalty calculations and payments. Finance teams use production reconciliation data to calculate royalty obligations — a dire

attributes.name: stope_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.stope_design. Business justification: For underground mining reconciliation, linking to stope_design provides access to design parameters for comparison with actuals. This is essential for underground production reconciliation. No redunda

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Production reconciliation must track planned vs actual by tenement for reserve reporting updates, royalty calculation verification, and expenditure commitment substantiation. Required for annual reser

attributes.name: actual_grade
attributes.description: Actual head grade (percentage or grams per tonne) of the primary commodity as determined by assay results from LabWare LIMS for the reconciliation period. Used as the numerator in F2 (grade reconciliation factor) calculation.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Assay Results; JORC Code 2012; SAMREC Code 2016

attributes.name: actual_metal_content
attributes.description: Actual contained metal or mineral content (tonnes of metal) for the reconciliation period, derived from actual_tonnes and actual_grade assay data from LabWare LIMS. Used as the numerator in F3 (metal content reconciliation factor) calculation.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; SAMREC Code 2016

attributes.name: actual_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual ore tonnes mined and delivered to the ROM pad or processing plant during the reconciliation period, as measured by Caterpillar MineStar FMS payload data and survey. Used as the numerator in F1 (tonnes reconciliation factor) calculation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; JORC Code 2012; CIM Definition Standards 2014

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reconciliation record received final sign-off approval from the authorised approver. Null if reconciliation_status is not yet approved. Provides audit trail for JORC compliance and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ISO 45001; SAP S/4HANA workflow

attributes.name: assay_sample_count
attributes.description: Number of assay samples collected and analysed in LabWare LIMS to determine the actual_grade for this reconciliation period. Higher sample counts increase grade confidence. Used to assess statistical reliability of the F2 grade reconciliation factor.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Sample Management; JORC Code 2012 Table 1

attributes.name: bench_elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation in metres above sea level (mRL) of the mining bench or stope level from which the reconciled ore was extracted. Used to spatially locate the reconciliation within the mine design and correlate with the geological block model in Geovia GEMS.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; GIS spatial reference

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the production reconciliation record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and compliance with JORC documentation requirements.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ISO 14001; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of waste rock (gangue) mixed with ore during the mining process, contributing to grade reduction relative to the geological model. Calculated from blast movement monitoring and survey data. High dilution is a primary driver of negative F2 factors.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; Caterpillar MineStar; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: f1_factor
attributes.description: F1 reconciliation factor representing the ratio of actual mined tonnes to geological model tonnes (actual_tonnes / model_tonnes). A value of 1.0 indicates perfect tonnes reconciliation. Values significantly above or below 1.0 indicate geological model uncertainty or mining dilution issues. Critical JORC resource model confidence metric.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; CIM Definition Standards 2014; Geovia GEMS Reconciliation

attributes.name: f2_factor
attributes.description: F2 reconciliation factor representing the ratio of actual mined grade to geological model grade (actual_grade / model_grade). A value of 1.0 indicates perfect grade reconciliation. Deviations indicate geological estimation error, sampling bias, or dilution effects. Critical for resource model confidence and JORC compliance.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; SAMREC Code 2016; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: f3_factor
attributes.description: F3 reconciliation factor representing the ratio of actual metal content to geological model metal content (actual_metal_content / model_metal_content). Combines the effect of both F1 and F2 (F3 = F1 × F2). The primary indicator of overall geological model performance and resource model confidence for JORC and NI 43-101 reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101 Section 14; CIM Definition Standards 2014

attributes.name: grade_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for model_grade and actual_grade fields. Percentage (pct) is used for base metals such as copper and iron ore; grams per tonne (g_per_t) for gold and silver; parts per million (ppm) for trace elements.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; LabWare LIMS; SAMREC Code 2016

attributes.name: grade_variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage variance between actual mined grade and geological model grade, expressed as ((actual_grade - model_grade) / model_grade) × 100. Positive values indicate higher-than-predicted grade; negative values indicate grade underperformance. Drives cut-off grade and ore/waste classification reviews.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: model_grade
attributes.description: Predicted head grade (percentage or grams per tonne) of the primary commodity for the reconciliation period as estimated in the geological block model. Used as the denominator in F2 (grade reconciliation factor) calculation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; Geovia GEMS Resource Estimation; NI 43-101 Section 14

attributes.name: model_metal_content
attributes.description: Predicted contained metal or mineral content (tonnes of metal) for the reconciliation period, calculated as model_tonnes multiplied by model_grade. Represents the geological model's expected metal inventory. Used in F3 (metal content reconciliation factor) calculation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS; NI 43-101 Section 14

attributes.name: model_tonnes
attributes.description: Predicted ore tonnes for the reconciliation period as derived from the geological block model in Geovia GEMS or Hexagon MinePlan. Represents the mine plan scheduled tonnes before actual mining. Used as the denominator in F1 (tonnes reconciliation factor) calculation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS Block Model; NI 43-101 Section 14

attributes.name: model_update_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reconciliation results have triggered a requirement to update the geological block model in Geovia GEMS. Set to True when F1, F2, or F3 factors fall outside acceptable tolerance thresholds, indicating the resource model requires re-estimation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS; NI 43-101 Section 14

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, caveats, or contextual information related to the reconciliation record that do not fit into structured fields. May include references to specific blast events, equipment downtime, or exceptional geological conditions observed during the period.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: ore_recovery_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the geological model ore tonnes that were successfully extracted and delivered to the ROM pad or processing plant, accounting for ore losses to waste dumps or misclassification. Distinct from metallurgical recovery rate in the processing plant.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: ore_source_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific ore source (e.g., pit bench, stope, ore block, or mining block) from which the reconciled tonnes were extracted. Sourced from Geovia GEMS block model and Hexagon MinePlan scheduling.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; Hexagon MinePlan Scheduling; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: ore_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ore source by mining method or material origin. Distinguishes between open-cut bench, underground stope, ROM pad stockpile, or blended feed to the processing plant. Critical for strip ratio and dilution analysis.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012 Table 1

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the reconciliation period. Determines the reporting cadence and is used to aggregate or disaggregate reconciliation factors (F1/F2/F3) for LOM planning and JORC resource model confidence assessments.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS Reconciliation Module

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the production period covered by this reconciliation. Together with reconciliation_period_start defines the temporal scope of the comparison between geological model and actual production.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the production period covered by this reconciliation. Typically aligned to shift, daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly reporting cycles.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: reconciliation_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the reconciliation run, typically formatted as REC-<SITE>-<YEAR>-<PERIOD>. Used for cross-system traceability across Geovia GEMS, LabWare LIMS, and Caterpillar MineStar.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; Geovia GEMS Reconciliation Module

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the reconciliation record. Tracks progression from initial draft through geologist and mine manager review to final approval or rejection. Superseded indicates a newer reconciliation has replaced this record.

attributes.name: resource_classification
attributes.description: JORC resource or reserve classification of the ore source being reconciled. Measured and Proved Reserve classifications carry the highest geological confidence; Inferred carries the lowest. Reconciliation factors are tracked by classification to assess model confidence at each JORC category level. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: measured|indicated|inferred|proved_reserve|probable_reserve — promote to reference product if additional classifications such as SAMREC or NI 43-101 equivalents are required]
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC Code 2016; CIM Definition Standards 2014

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which the reconciliation data was primarily sourced. Geovia GEMS provides geological model data; Caterpillar MineStar provides actual tonnes via FMS; LabWare LIMS provides assay grade data. Manual indicates data was entered directly without system integration.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Caterpillar MineStar; LabWare LIMS; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: survey_method
attributes.description: Method used to measure actual mined tonnes for the reconciliation period. Drone survey and laser scan provide volumetric measurements; GPS RTK and total station provide traditional survey data; truck payload uses Caterpillar MineStar FMS payload data. Affects accuracy confidence of actual_tonnes.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; Hexagon MinePlan Survey

attributes.name: tonnes_variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage variance between actual mined tonnes and geological model tonnes, expressed as ((actual_tonnes - model_tonnes) / model_tonnes) × 100. Positive values indicate over-mining relative to model; negative values indicate under-mining. Used for production scheduling variance reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik Scheduling

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the production reconciliation record was most recently modified. Tracks revisions to reconciliation factors, variance explanations, or approval status. Essential for data lineage in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Databricks Delta Lake audit; ISO 14001

attributes.name: variance_category
attributes.description: Primary categorical classification of the reconciliation variance cause. Used for trend analysis and systematic identification of recurring model or operational issues. Supports resource model update prioritisation and mine planning improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: geological_model|dilution|ore_loss|sampling_bias|survey_error|blast_movement|equipment_error|classification_error — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: variance_explanation
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the primary causes of variance between geological model predictions and actual production results. Documents factors such as geological model uncertainty, blast movement, dilution, ore loss, sampling bias, or survey error. Required for JORC compliance documentation and resource model update decisions.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; SAMREC Code 2016; CIM Definition Standards 2014

attributes.description: Perpendicular distance in meters from the blast hole to the free face. Primary design parameter controlling rock movement and fragmentation.

attributes.description: Total length of the explosive column in meters within the blast hole.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this blast pattern record was first created in the system.

attributes.description: Total mass of explosive loaded into each blast hole in kilograms.

attributes.description: Target fragmentation size in millimeters where 80% of the blasted material passes through (P80 metric). Drives crusher feed requirements and downstream processing efficiency.

attributes.name: hole_depth_m
attributes.description: Total depth of the blast hole in meters, including sub-drill below the bench floor to ensure complete breakage.

attributes.name: hole_diameter_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the blast holes in millimeters. Determines explosive charge capacity and influences fragmentation and powder factor.

attributes.name: initiation_system_type
attributes.description: Type of detonation initiation system used in the blast pattern. Electronic systems offer precise timing; non-electric and shock tube systems are cost-effective alternatives.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a standard, repeatable blast pattern (true) or a custom, one-off design (false).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this blast pattern record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: number_of_holes
attributes.description: Total count of blast holes in the pattern design.

attributes.name: number_of_rows
attributes.description: Number of rows of blast holes in the pattern, measured perpendicular to the free face.

attributes.name: pattern_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code identifying the blast pattern design, used in operational communications and drill-and-blast planning systems.

attributes.name: pattern_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the blast pattern, typically describing the geometry or application context.

attributes.name: pattern_type
attributes.description: Classification of the blast pattern geometry. Square and rectangular patterns are common in open-cut operations; staggered patterns optimize energy distribution; echelon patterns suit angled benches; radial patterns are used in underground or specialized applications.

attributes.name: powder_factor_kg_per_m3
attributes.description: Mass of explosive in kilograms required to break one cubic meter of rock. Key performance indicator for blast efficiency and cost control.

attributes.name: rock_strength_mpa
attributes.description: Unconfined compressive strength of the target rock in megapascals. Influences explosive selection and powder factor requirements.

attributes.name: safety_exclusion_zone_m
attributes.description: Minimum safe distance in meters from the blast area within which all personnel and equipment must be evacuated prior to detonation.

attributes.name: spacing_m
attributes.description: Distance in meters between adjacent blast holes in the same row. Typically 1.0 to 1.5 times the burden distance.

attributes.name: stemming_length_m
attributes.description: Length of inert material (typically crushed rock or drill cuttings) placed at the top of the blast hole in meters to confine explosive gases and prevent premature venting.

attributes.name: sub_drill_m
attributes.description: Additional drilling depth below the bench floor in meters to ensure complete rock breakage at the toe of the blast.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the blast pattern design, incremented when modifications are made to an existing pattern.

domains.name: processing

SSOT for all processing facility master data. Parent entity for circuits, feed streams, and all operational records.

attributes.name: annual_capacity_mt

attributes.name: comminution_technology

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: The date on which the processing plant was formally commissioned and accepted into commercial production. Used for asset depreciation calculations (IFRS 16), LOM plan baseline, and regulatory reporting of production commencement.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Infor EAM

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the processing plant is located (e.g., 'AUS', 'CHL', 'ZAF', 'CAN'). Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, MSHA) and environmental reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: The date on which the plant was permanently decommissioned and removed from the active asset register. Null if the plant is still operational or on care-and-maintenance. Triggers mine rehabilitation and closure obligations.
attributes.references: ICMM Mine Closure Framework; ISO 14001; IFRS 6; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: design_capacity_tph
attributes.description: Nameplate design throughput capacity of the plant expressed in dry metric tonnes per hour (tph) of Run of Mine (ROM) feed. Represents the engineering-rated maximum throughput under optimal conditions. Used as the denominator for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculations.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ICMM Technical Guidelines; Infor EAM

attributes.name: elevation_masl
attributes.description: Elevation of the processing plant site in metres above sea level (mASL). Relevant for water balance modelling, slurry pipeline hydraulics design, and environmental impact assessments.

attributes.name: feed_grade_design_pct
attributes.description: Design ROM feed head grade (percentage of valuable mineral in the feed ore) for which the plant was engineered. Used as the baseline for metallurgical balance calculations, cut-off grade assessments, and LOM plan modelling.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude of the processing plant centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS (Geographic Information System) mapping, spatial analysis, and environmental impact zone delineation.

attributes.name: lims_plant_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Plant Code
attributes.description: The plant identifier used in the LabWare LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) for sample registration, assay result linkage, and metallurgical accounting. Enables traceability from plant feed to product assay.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude of the processing plant centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS mapping, spatial analysis, and environmental impact zone delineation.

attributes.name: nameplate_recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Design-rated metallurgical recovery rate expressed as a percentage (0–100). Represents the percentage of the target valuable mineral in the feed that is expected to report to the concentrate or product stream under nameplate conditions. Key input to LOM plan financial modelling and JORC/NI 43-101 resource estimation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC; CIM Standards

attributes.name: number_of_processing_lines
attributes.description: Total count of parallel processing lines (circuits) within the plant. Each line represents an independent processing train capable of treating ore from feed to product. Drives capacity planning, maintenance scheduling, and redundancy analysis.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the processing plant. 'active' = fully operational; 'care-and-maintenance' = temporarily idle but preserved; 'decommissioned' = permanently closed; 'commissioning' = in start-up phase; 'suspended' = temporarily halted due to regulatory or operational reasons.
attributes.references: ICMM Mine Closure Framework; ISO 14001; Infor EAM

attributes.name: ore_type_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ore/commodity types this plant is designed and certified to process (e.g., 'iron ore, copper, gold, lithium, nickel, coal, diamonds'). Drives feed stream routing and LOM plan alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron ore|copper|gold|lithium|nickel|coal|diamonds|zinc|lead|manganese — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the processing plant, used across ERP, SCADA, and FMS systems (e.g., 'PP-PILBARA-01', 'PROC-CU-02'). Unique across the enterprise and referenced in operational reporting.

attributes.name: plant_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the processing plant including key design features, processing circuit configuration, historical context, and any notable operational characteristics. Supports regulatory submissions, investor reports, and technical documentation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; SEC S-K 1300; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: plant_name

attributes.name: plant_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the processing plant by metallurgical process family. 'concentrator' = physical separation to produce mineral concentrate; 'hydrometallurgical' = chemical leaching/SX-EW; 'pyrometallurgical' = smelting/roasting; 'beneficiation' = upgrading without full extraction; 'refinery' = final product refining; 'pelletising' = iron ore pellet production.

attributes.name: power_consumption_design_kw

attributes.name: primary_processing_method

Comminution includes SAG/HPGR milling; flotation covers froth flotation separation; leaching includes heap and tank leaching; SX-EW (Solvent Extraction Electrowinning) for copper cathode production; DMS (Dense Media Separation) for coal/diamonds; gravity and magnetic separation for iron ore. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: comminution|flotation|leaching|SX-EW|DMS|gravity|magnetic — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this processing plant master record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record-keeping obligations.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this processing plant master record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: sap_functional_location

attributes.name: scada_system_code

attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SCADA Integration Standards

attributes.name: state_province

attributes.name: tailings_generation_design_tph

attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS Regulatory Requirements; ICMM Water Stewardship

attributes.name: design_feed_size_p80_mm

attributes.name: design_ph_target
attributes.description: Design basis target pH value for the circuit process stream. Applicable to flotation (pH control for selectivity), leaching (acid/alkaline conditions), and SX-EW circuits. Drives lime/acid reagent consumption.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: design_product_size_p80_mm
attributes.description: Design basis P80 particle size of the product leaving this circuit in millimetres. Defines the target grind size for comminution circuits and classification efficiency for downstream separation circuits.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; ICMM Guidance

attributes.name: design_residence_time_min
attributes.description: Design basis residence time of material within the circuit expressed in minutes. Determines tank/vessel sizing and is a key parameter for leach kinetics, flotation recovery, and thickener design.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; ICMM Guidance

attributes.name: design_slurry_density_pct
attributes.description: Design basis slurry density expressed as percentage solids by weight for circuits handling slurry streams. Critical for pump sizing, pipe design, and process control setpoints.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: design_throughput_mtpa
attributes.description: Annualised nameplate design throughput capacity expressed in million dry metric tonnes per annum (Mtpa). Used for LOM plan alignment, capital project justification, and annual production reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code; SEC S-K 1300; LOM Plan Standards

attributes.name: design_throughput_tph
attributes.description: Nameplate design throughput capacity of the circuit expressed in dry metric tonnes per hour (tph). Represents the engineering design basis used for LOM plan benchmarking and OEE calculations.

attributes.name: design_utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Design basis utilisation rate of the circuit expressed as a percentage of available hours actually used for production. Combined with availability to derive OEE. Accounts for planned feed interruptions and scheduled downtime.
attributes.references: ICMM Guidance; OEE Standards; LOM Plan Standards

attributes.name: design_water_consumption_m3pt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Water Consumption (Cubic Metres Per Tonne)

attributes.references: ISO 14001; ICMM Water Stewardship Protocol; GRI 303

attributes.name: effective_from_date

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which the current circuit configuration and design parameters are effective. Null for the current active version. Enables historical tracking of circuit design changes and target revisions over the LOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; IFRS; LOM Plan Standards

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number

attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS Requirements; GRI Mining and Metals Supplement; IsoMetrix

attributes.name: feed_material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary feed material entering this circuit (e.g., ROM Ore for primary comminution, slurry for flotation). attributes.name: flowsheet_sequence_order

attributes.name: installed_power_kw
attributes.description: Total installed electrical power capacity of the circuit in kilowatts (kW). Used for energy consumption benchmarking, OPEX modelling, and specific energy intensity calculations (kWh/t).

attributes.name: is_primary_circuit

attributes.name: number_of_units

attributes.name: reagent_scheme_code

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: ore_reserve_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Feed streams originate from specific orebodies. Mine-to-mill optimization and metallurgical reconciliation require tracking which orebody supplies each feed stream to correlate geological characterist

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the mineral processing plant or facility that this feed stream supplies. Supports multi-plant operations and mass balance reporting at plant level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: production_schedule_id

attributes.name: prospect_id

attributes.name: rom_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the specific physical source location (ROM pad, stockpile, crusher station) from which this feed stream originates. Links to the plant location or stockpile master.

attributes.name: sample_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.sample_program. Business justification: Feed streams are sampled under a defined sample program governing sampling protocol, frequency, and analytical suite for metallurgical accounting. Knowing which sample program applies to each feed str

attributes.name: source_tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Feed streams originate from ore extracted from specific tenements. Essential for royalty calculations, grade reconciliation against tenement reserves, and compliance with tenement-specific production

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Feed streams are configured to meet a target product specification (grade, particle size, moisture). Process engineers reference the specification when setting feed stream design parameters. Metallurg

attributes.name: abrasion_index
attributes.description: Bond Abrasion Index (Ai) of the ore in the feed stream, a dimensionless measure of ore abrasiveness. Drives liner and media wear rate predictions for SAG mills, ball mills, and HPGR (High Pressure Grinding Rolls), informing maintenance scheduling and OPEX forecasting.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Infor EAM; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: bond_work_index_kwh_t
attributes.description: Bond Ball Mill Work Index (BWi) of the ore expressed in kilowatt-hours per tonne (kWh/t). Measures ore hardness and grindability; used to predict mill power requirements, throughput, and energy consumption in comminution circuit design and optimisation.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: bulk_density_t_m3
attributes.description: Bulk density of the ore material in the feed stream expressed in tonnes per cubic metre (t/m³). Used to convert volumetric flow measurements to mass flow for mass balance calculations and stockpile volume reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: The date on which this feed stream was formally commissioned and accepted into operational service. Used for asset lifecycle tracking, warranty management, and CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) project closure reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PS; ISO 14001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this feed stream record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and record provenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; IFRS 6; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: cut_off_grade_pct
attributes.description: The minimum economic grade threshold (cut-off grade) applied to material entering this feed stream. Material below cut-off grade is classified as waste and diverted to the waste dump. Defined per LOM plan and commodity economics.

attributes.name: design_capacity_tph
attributes.description: Maximum rated throughput capacity of the feed stream infrastructure (conveyor, feeder, chute) in dry metric tonnes per hour. Used for bottleneck analysis and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculations.

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of waste material mixed with ore in the feed stream due to mining dilution. Dilution reduces the effective head grade and is tracked for reconciliation between geological resource model grades and actual plant feed grades.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Hexagon MinePlan; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this feed stream definition and its associated parameters (nominal rate, target grade, processing route) became operationally effective. Supports temporal versioning of feed stream configurations aligned to LOM plan revisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this feed stream definition ceases to be operationally effective. Null indicates the stream is currently active with no planned end date. Supports LOM plan stage transitions and plant reconfiguration tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature of the ore or slurry in the feed stream measured in degrees Celsius. Relevant for leaching circuits (SX-EW), autoclave operations, and cold-climate operations where freezing affects conveyor and crusher performance.

attributes.name: gangue_content_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of waste rock (gangue) minerals in the feed stream material. High gangue content increases dilution, reduces effective head grade, and impacts reagent consumption in flotation and leaching circuits.

attributes.name: head_grade_pct
attributes.description: The assay-determined grade of the primary valuable mineral in the feed stream expressed as a percentage (e.g., % Fe for iron ore, % Cu for copper). Head grade is the key input for recovery rate calculations and production reconciliation against the LOM plan.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the ore in the feed stream expressed as a percentage of total wet mass. Moisture affects conveyor performance, crusher throughput, mill power draw, and dry tonne calculations for mass balance and invoicing.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; ISO 3087 (Coal Moisture)

attributes.name: nominal_feed_rate_tph
attributes.description: The design or nameplate feed rate for this stream expressed in dry metric tonnes per hour (tph). Represents the target throughput capacity used in LOM (Life of Mine) plan scheduling and plant design. Distinct from actual measured feed rate.

attributes.name: ore_type
attributes.description: Geological ore type classification of the material in this feed stream (e.g., oxide, sulphide, transitional, fresh, weathered). Ore type drives processing route selection, reagent dosing, and expected recovery rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oxide|sulphide|transitional|fresh|weathered|mixed|high_grade|low_grade — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: p50_particle_size_mm
attributes.description: The 50th percentile (median) passing particle size of the feed stream material in millimetres. Complements P80 to characterise the full particle size distribution (PSD) shape, supporting comminution circuit modelling and screen efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: p80_particle_size_mm
attributes.description: The 80th percentile passing particle size of the feed stream material expressed in millimetres (mm). P80 is the industry-standard metric for characterising particle size distribution (PSD) in comminution circuits. Critical input for SAG mill and HPGR (High Pressure Grinding Rolls) performance modelling.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; OSIsoft PI System; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: pi_tag_feed_rate
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI System historian tag name for the real-time feed rate measurement instrument (belt scale or flow meter) associated with this feed stream. Enables direct linkage between the data product and the SCADA/PI process historian for real-time and historical data retrieval.

attributes.name: pi_tag_particle_size
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSIsoft PI Tag - Particle Size Analyser
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI System historian tag name for the online particle size analyser (PSA) instrument monitoring P80 for this feed stream. Supports real-time comminution circuit control and automated variance alerting.

attributes.name: processing_route
attributes.description: The designated mineral processing route for material in this feed stream (e.g., SAG/Ball Mill comminution, DMS (Dense Media Separation), flotation, leaching, SX-EW (Solvent Extraction Electrowinning)). Determines downstream circuit routing and reagent requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sag_ball_mill|hpgr|dms|flotation|leaching|sx_ew|gravity|magnetic_separation|cil|cip — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: slurry_density_t_m3
attributes.description: Density of the ore-water slurry mixture in the feed stream expressed in tonnes per cubic metre. Applicable to wet processing circuits (SAG mill discharge, flotation feed). Monitored via OSIsoft PI System for real-time process control.

attributes.name: slurry_solids_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of solids by mass in the slurry feed stream (percent solids). A key process control parameter for wet grinding and flotation circuits; directly affects mill power draw, pump performance, and flotation cell residence time.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical origin point from which ore material enters this feed stream. ROM (Run of Mine) pad indicates direct truck tip; stockpile indicates reclaimed material; crusher indicates post-comminution feed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rom_pad|primary_crusher|secondary_crusher|tertiary_crusher|stockpile|reclaim_conveyor|direct_tip|sag_discharge — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: stream_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the feed stream within the processing plant configuration (e.g., FS-ROM-001, FS-CRU-002). Used in mass balance reconciliation and plant P&ID references.

attributes.name: stream_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name of the feed stream (e.g., 'Primary ROM Feed', 'SAG Mill Discharge', 'Crusher Product Recirculating Load'). Used in operational dashboards and reporting.

attributes.name: stream_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the feed stream definition within the processing plant. Active streams are currently receiving material; suspended streams are temporarily offline; decommissioned streams are permanently retired from the circuit.

attributes.name: stream_type
attributes.description: Classification of the feed stream by its position and role in the comminution circuit. ROM (Run of Mine) feed is direct from the ROM pad; crushed feed is post-primary crusher; recirculating load is material returned for regrinding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rom_feed|crushed_feed|recirculating_load|classifier_overflow|classifier_underflow|screen_oversize|sag_discharge|ball_mill_discharge — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_feed_rate_tph
attributes.description: The planned or scheduled feed rate for this stream in dry metric tonnes per hour as defined in the current production schedule or LOM plan. Distinct from nominal (design) feed rate; used for shift-level production planning and variance reporting.
attributes.references: Deswik; Hexagon MinePlan; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: target_head_grade_pct
attributes.description: The planned head grade of the primary valuable mineral for this feed stream as per the current production schedule or LOM plan. Used for production reconciliation and variance analysis against actual assayed head grade.

attributes.name: target_p80_mm
attributes.description: The planned P80 particle size target for this feed stream in millimetres as specified in the processing plant design or LOM plan. Used to assess crusher and mill performance against design specifications.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: top_size_mm
attributes.description: Maximum lump size of material in the feed stream expressed in millimetres. Defines the upper bound of the particle size distribution and is critical for crusher gap settings, conveyor design, and mill liner protection.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this feed stream record was most recently modified. Supports incremental data loading, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; IFRS 6; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

products.name: shift_production_run
products.description: Transactional record of each processing plant production shift — the operational heartbeat of the processing domain. Captures shift date, shift number (day/night/afternoon), plant ID, crew ID, tonnes fed (ROM dry and wet), tonnes processed, circuit availability (%), plant utilisation (%), OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), feed grade (head grade by element), operating hours, calendar hours, actual throughput rate (tph), design throughput rate (tph), feed blend composition (ore type percentages), primary ore type, weather conditions affecting operations, and shift supervisor sign-off. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System historian and MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Serves as the single source of truth for shift and daily production reporting against LOM plan targets. All circuit-level process events, reagent consumption, utility consumption, and operational exception records link back to this shift record via FK. Supports daily production meetings, weekly/monthly reporting, and annual reconciliation.

attributes.name: shift_production_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shift production run record in the processing plant. Primary key for this transactional entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete operational shift event with a clear lifecycle in the mineral processing domain.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES (Manufacturing Execution System)
