attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Shift-level production costs (labour, consumables, utilities) are allocated to cost centres for unit cost calculation, AISC reporting, and budget variance analysis. Core mining cost accounting process

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: Shift reporting and metallurgical reconciliation require tracking which geological domain material was processed each shift. Shift supervisors record feed_blend_oxide_pct and primary_ore_type against

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.laboratory. Business justification: Shift samples are dispatched to specific laboratories for analysis. Essential for tracking sample turnaround times, metallurgical accounting, and reconciling lab results with production data for perfo

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Life of Mine (LOM) plan version against which this shift production run is being reconciled. Enables tracking of actual production performance versus the approved LOM plan targets for throughput, grade, and recovery.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Production runs frequently trigger corrective maintenance work orders when equipment issues or process deviations are detected during shift operations. Links shift performance problems to maintenance

attributes.name: metallurgical_balance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.metallurgical_balance. Business justification: Each shift production run contributes to a metallurgical accounting period. Linking shift_production_run to its metallurgical_balance period enables direct aggregation of shift-level production data i

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Shift production runs process ore from specific orebodies. Operational reporting, grade reconciliation, and metallurgical accounting require linking production shifts to source orebody to compare actu

attributes.description: Identifier of the mineral processing plant where this shift production run occurred. Links to the plant master reference. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category (resource reference to the processing facility). Used for plant-level production aggregation and benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Infor EAM; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.production_schedule. Business justification: Processing shift runs must align with mine production schedules for integrated mine-to-mill optimization, bottleneck analysis, and shift-level production reconciliation. Essential for real-time produc

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.rom_stockpile. Business justification: Processing shift runs track feed source from ROM stockpiles for inventory management, feed scheduling, and stockpile depletion tracking. Essential for real-time feed management and stockpile inventory

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Shifts produce specific saleable products (concentrate grades, cathodes). Essential for production reconciliation, inventory management, and linking shift output to sales contracts. Natural business r

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.shift_report. Business justification: Daily mine-plant shift reconciliation requires aligning the mine shift report (ore mined, tonnes moved) with the processing shift production run (ore processed, recovery) for the same shift period. Mi

attributes.name: shutdown_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.shutdown_plan. Business justification: Shift production runs that fall within a planned shutdown window must be attributed to the shutdown plan for production-loss accounting and schedule compliance reporting. Mining operations teams expli

attributes.name: source_tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Production runs process ore from specific tenements. Required for royalty payment calculations, tenement-specific statutory production reporting, and reconciliation of tenement reserves against actual

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Each shift production run targets a specific product specification. Shift supervisors and metallurgists assess whether the run met grade, moisture, and impurity limits. This drives shift quality repor

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tailings.tsf. Business justification: Every processing shift generates tailings sent to specific TSF. Required for material flow tracking, mass balance reconciliation, TSF capacity planning, and water balance closure. Fundamental operatio

attributes.name: actual_throughput_rate_tph
attributes.description: Actual average processing rate achieved during the shift, expressed in dry tonnes per hour (tph). Calculated as tonnes processed divided by operating hours. Compared against design throughput rate for performance gap analysis.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10)

attributes.name: calendar_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours in the shift period as defined by the site calendar (typically 12 hours for a standard shift). Used as the denominator for plant utilisation and OEE calculations. Expressed in decimal hours.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: circuit_availability_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of calendar hours during which the processing circuit was available for production, calculated as (calendar hours minus planned and unplanned downtime) divided by calendar hours, expressed as a percentage. Key KPI for processing plant performance against LOM plan targets.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: concentrate_produced_tonnes
attributes.description: Total dry tonnes of mineral concentrate or final processed product produced during the shift. Used for production accounting, inventory management, and sales dispatch planning. Sourced from product weighbridge or belt scale measurements.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; SAP S/4HANA MM; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift production run record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of data ingestion from OSIsoft PI System and MES. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; IFRS 6 Exploration Assets; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: design_throughput_rate_tph
attributes.description: Nameplate or design throughput rate of the processing plant circuit, expressed in dry tonnes per hour (tph), as specified in the LOM plan and plant design documentation. Used as the benchmark for actual throughput performance assessment.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; LOM Plan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_blend_oxide_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of oxide ore type in the ROM feed blend during the shift. Part of the feed blend composition tracking used to predict and explain metallurgical recovery variations and circuit performance. Sourced from grade control block data and ROM stockpile management.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_blend_sulphide_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of sulphide ore type in the ROM feed blend during the shift. Used alongside oxide percentage to characterise the feed blend composition for metallurgical performance analysis and reagent dosage optimisation.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_grade_element
attributes.description: Chemical element symbol for which the feed head grade is reported (e.g., Fe for iron ore, Cu for copper, Li for lithium). Enables multi-commodity processing plants to correctly attribute grade measurements to the target mineral. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Fe|Cu|Au|Ag|Li|Ni|Co|Zn|Pb|Mo — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; IUPAC Chemical Nomenclature

attributes.name: feed_head_grade_pct
attributes.description: Assayed head grade of the primary valuable element (e.g., Fe%, Cu%, Li%) in the ROM feed during the shift, expressed as a percentage. Sourced from LabWare LIMS composite sample assay results. Critical input for metallurgical recovery calculations and LOM plan reconciliation.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC; ISO 17025 Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: feed_moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the ROM feed expressed as a percentage of wet weight, measured by on-belt moisture analyser or laboratory sample. Used to convert wet tonnes to dry tonnes for metallurgical accounting and mass balance calculations.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code 2012; ISO 17025

attributes.name: metallurgical_recovery_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the valuable element in the ROM feed that is successfully recovered into the final concentrate or product during the shift. Calculated from feed grade, product grade, and mass balance. Core KPI for processing efficiency and LOM plan reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: oee_pct
attributes.description: Overall Equipment Effectiveness expressed as a percentage, combining availability, performance, and quality rate for the processing plant during the shift. Industry-standard KPI for processing plant productivity benchmarking against LOM plan targets. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Actual number of hours the processing plant was in productive operation during the shift, excluding planned and unplanned downtime. Used in OEE calculation and throughput rate derivation. Expressed in decimal hours.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: planned_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Hours of scheduled downtime during the shift for planned maintenance, inspections, or scheduled shutdowns. Used in circuit availability and OEE calculations. Sourced from Infor EAM work order schedules.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10)

attributes.name: plant_utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of available hours during which the plant was actively processing ore, calculated as operating hours divided by available hours. Reflects how effectively available plant time is being used for production. Reported in daily production meetings.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: primary_ore_type
attributes.description: Dominant ore type or lithological classification of the ROM feed processed during the shift (e.g., oxide, sulphide, mixed, transitional, fresh). Determines the applicable processing circuit configuration and expected metallurgical recovery. Sourced from Geovia GEMS geological model and grade control data.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC

attributes.name: product_grade_pct
attributes.description: Assayed grade of the primary valuable element in the final concentrate or product produced during the shift, expressed as a percentage. Sourced from LabWare LIMS product sample assay. Used for product quality certification, sales contract compliance, and metallurgical accounting.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; ISO 17025 Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: rom_feed_tonnes_dry
attributes.business_glossary_term: Run of Mine (ROM) Feed Tonnes Dry
attributes.description: Total dry tonnes of Run of Mine (ROM) ore fed to the processing plant during the shift, calculated by applying the measured moisture factor to wet tonnes. Dry tonnes are the standard basis for metallurgical accounting, resource reporting, and LOM plan reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework; NI 43-101

attributes.name: rom_feed_tonnes_wet
attributes.business_glossary_term: Run of Mine (ROM) Feed Tonnes Wet
attributes.description: Total wet tonnes of Run of Mine (ROM) ore fed to the processing plant during the shift, as measured at the feed conveyor belt scale. Wet weight includes moisture content. Used for mass balance and throughput reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shift production run record. 'open' indicates the shift is in progress; 'completed' indicates shift has ended and data is captured; 'under_review' indicates supervisor review pending; 'approved' indicates shift supervisor sign-off complete; 'cancelled' indicates the shift was voided. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: MES (Manufacturing Execution System); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the production shift commenced. Used as the primary date dimension for daily production reporting, reconciliation against LOM plan targets, and regulatory reporting. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category (date-level precision).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: shift_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the production shift concluded, sourced from the MES or OSIsoft PI System historian. Used for shift duration calculation, handover documentation, and OEE reporting. ISO 8601 format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; IEC 62541 OPC-UA; ISO 8601

attributes.name: shift_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by the shift supervisor covering significant events, process upsets, equipment issues, safety observations, or other contextual information relevant to the shift production run. Supports shift handover communication and exception reporting.

attributes.name: shift_number
attributes.description: Designates the shift rotation within the calendar day: 'day' (typically 06:00–18:00), 'night' (18:00–06:00), or 'afternoon' (14:00–22:00) depending on site roster configuration. Used for shift-based production reporting and crew scheduling.
attributes.references: MES (Manufacturing Execution System); ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: shift_run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the shift production run, used in daily production reports, shift handover documentation, and reconciliation against LOM plan targets. Format: SPR-YYYY-MM-DD-PLANTCODE-SEQ. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES (Manufacturing Execution System); JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: shift_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the production shift commenced, sourced from the MES or OSIsoft PI System historian. Used for accurate shift duration calculation, OEE computation, and integration with SCADA event logs. ISO 8601 format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; IEC 62541 OPC-UA; ISO 8601

attributes.name: supervisor_signoff_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shift supervisor formally approved and signed off the shift production run record. Marks the transition from 'under_review' to 'approved' status. Required for daily production reporting and audit compliance.

attributes.name: tonnes_processed
attributes.description: Total dry tonnes of ore that completed the primary processing circuit during the shift. May differ from ROM feed tonnes due to in-circuit inventory changes, spillage, or sampling losses. Used as the primary throughput metric for production reporting. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: unplanned_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Hours of unscheduled downtime during the shift due to equipment breakdowns, process upsets, or emergency stoppages. Key input for MTBF and MTTR analysis and OEE degradation reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift production run record was last modified, including supervisor sign-off, data corrections, or status transitions. Supports audit trail and change tracking in the Silver layer. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; IFRS 6 Exploration Assets; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the mine site during the shift that may have affected processing plant operations (e.g., extreme heat impacting reagent performance, rain increasing feed moisture, dust storms affecting conveyor operations). Used for operational exception reporting and HSE compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|storm|fog|high_wind|dust_storm|snow|extreme_heat — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IsoMetrix HSE; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; EIS (Environmental Impact Statement)

attributes.name: weather_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether adverse weather conditions materially impacted processing plant operations or throughput during the shift. Used to qualify production shortfalls in reporting and distinguish weather-related downtime from equipment or process failures.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix HSE; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; ICMM Reporting Framework

products.name: unit_operation_event
products.description: Unified transactional record of all mineral processing operations per shift per circuit, using a type discriminator to capture comminution (SAG, ball mill, HPGR, crusher), flotation (rougher, scavenger, cleaner), leaching (heap, tank, vat, CIL/CIP), SX-EW (solvent extraction, electrowinning), DMS (dense media separation), gravity separation (spirals, shaking tables, jigs), magnetic separation, and thickening/dewatering events. Common attributes: circuit ID, shift reference, feed tonnage, product tonnage, recovery (%), specific energy (kWh/t). Type-specific attribute groups capture process-specific parameters (e.g., P80 for comminution, froth depth for flotation, medium density for DMS, current density for SX-EW). Sourced from OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian and MES. Supports metallurgical accounting, process control, and LOM plan variance analysis.

attributes.name: unit_operation_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each unit operation event record in the mineral processing domain. Primary key for the silver-layer lakehouse table.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary processing equipment asset (e.g., SAG mill, ball mill, flotation cell, leach tank) involved in this unit operation event.
attributes.references: Infor EAM asset register; SAP S/4HANA PM equipment master

attributes.name: circuit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific processing circuit (e.g., SAG mill circuit, flotation circuit, leach circuit) where this unit operation event occurred. Links to the circuit master.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Asset Framework hierarchy; MES circuit configuration

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Unit operations (crushing, grinding, separation) process specific commodities. Required for metallurgical accounting by commodity type, recovery tracking, and operational performance analysis. Core to

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Individual unit operations (mills, flotation cells, leach tanks) are cost-tracked for activity-based costing, energy consumption analysis, and process optimization ROI. Standard process costing practi

attributes.name: feed_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.feed_stream. Business justification: Unit operations process specific feed streams. One event processes one feed stream; one feed stream has many events. This links the operation event to the feed stream being processed.

attributes.name: grade_parameter_id

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Unit operation events (comminution, separation) often generate maintenance work orders when equipment performance degrades or failures occur. Links operational events to maintenance response for equip

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.plant. Business justification: unit_operation_event is the unified transactional record for all mineral processing operations. While plant can be derived via circuit.plant_id or shift_production_run.plant_id, a direct plant_id FK i

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.production_schedule. Business justification: Comminution and processing unit operations track throughput and energy consumption against scheduled mine production for bottleneck analysis, cost allocation, and integrated mine-mill performance opti

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: Unit operations process ore from specific prospects. Required for metallurgical domain modeling, recovery prediction by ore type, and process optimization. Real business need: ore-specific comminution

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Unit operations (crushing, leaching, SXEW) require task-level risk assessments (HAZOP/JSA) under mining process safety regulations. A mining HSE manager expects each unit operation event to reference

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Unit operation events contribute to production of a specific saleable product. Production accounting and cost allocation per saleable product requires this link. commodity_id alone is insufficient — c

attributes.name: shift_production_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this unit operation event was recorded. Enables shift-level metallurgical accounting and performance reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System shift boundary configuration; SAP S/4HANA PP shift calendar

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tailings.tsf. Business justification: Comminution/grinding events produce tailings streams directed to specific TSF. Essential for metallurgical accounting, TSF deposition planning, and environmental compliance reporting. Tracks material

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for process operators or metallurgical accountants to record observations, abnormal conditions, equipment issues, or data quality notes associated with this unit operation event. Sourced from MES shift log entries.
attributes.references: MES (Manufacturing Execution System) shift log; OSIsoft PI System event frame annotations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit operation event record was first captured and written to the silver-layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer audit conventions; ISO 8601

attributes.name: current_density_a_per_m2
attributes.description: Electrical current density applied in electrowinning (EW) cells during SX-EW unit operations, expressed in A/m². Type-specific parameter for electrowinning operations. Controls cathode deposition rate, product purity, and specific energy consumption.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian; SME Mineral Processing Handbook SX-EW (Solvent Extraction Electrowinning) parameters

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this unit operation event data was sourced. Supports data lineage, quality assessment, and reconciliation between SCADA historian (OSIsoft PI System), MES, and LabWare LIMS.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES (Manufacturing Execution System); LabWare LIMS; Databricks data lineage standards

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when this unit operation event concluded, as recorded by the SCADA historian. Null if the event is still active. Used to calculate operating duration and throughput rates.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian; ISO 8601 timestamp standard

attributes.name: event_reference_number
attributes.description: Human-readable externally-known business identifier for this unit operation event, used in metallurgical reports, process control logs, and MES reconciliation. Format: UOE-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System event frame naming convention; MES event reference standard

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when this unit operation event commenced, as recorded by the SCADA historian (OSIsoft PI System). Used as the principal business event time for metallurgical accounting period alignment.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian; ISO 8601 timestamp standard

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the unit operation event record. 'active' indicates the shift event is in progress; 'completed' indicates normal shift closure; 'aborted' indicates unplanned stoppage; 'suspended' indicates planned hold; 'pending_review' indicates metallurgical accountant review required.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System event frame state model; MES workflow states

attributes.name: feed_grade_pct
attributes.description: Head grade of the valuable mineral in the feed material expressed as a percentage (e.g., % Cu, % Fe, % Li2O). Sourced from online analysers or composite assay samples. Critical for recovery calculation and LOM plan grade reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code resource/reserve reporting; LabWare LIMS assay results; ICMM metallurgical accounting guidelines

attributes.name: feed_tonnage_dry_t
attributes.description: Dry metric tonnes of ore or material fed to the unit operation during the event period. Core throughput metric for metallurgical accounting and LOM plan variance analysis. Sourced from belt scale or flow meter readings in OSIsoft PI System.
attributes.references: JORC Code metallurgical accounting standards; OSIsoft PI System process historian

attributes.name: froth_depth_mm
attributes.description: Depth of the froth layer in flotation cells, expressed in millimetres. Type-specific parameter for flotation unit operations (rougher, scavenger, cleaner). Controlled variable for concentrate grade and recovery optimisation. Sourced from ultrasonic level sensors via OSIsoft PI System.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian; SME Mineral Processing Handbook flotation parameters

attributes.name: is_lom_plan_period
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Life of Mine Plan Period Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this unit operation event falls within an active LOM (Life of Mine) plan period with defined targets, enabling filtering of events for plan vs actual variance reporting.
attributes.references: LOM (Life of Mine) plan; Deswik mine scheduling; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: leach_solution_grade_g_per_l
attributes.description: Concentration of the target metal in the pregnant leach solution (PLS), expressed in grams per litre. Type-specific parameter for heap, tank, vat, CIL, and CIP leaching operations. Used in leach circuit mass balance and SX-EW feed quality assessment.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian; LabWare LIMS solution assay; SME Mineral Processing Handbook leaching parameters

attributes.name: lom_plan_feed_tonnage_t
attributes.business_glossary_term: Life of Mine Plan Feed Tonnage Target (Dry Metric Tonnes)
attributes.description: LOM (Life of Mine) plan target for feed tonnage to this unit operation for the corresponding shift/period. Used for variance analysis between actual and planned throughput. Sourced from Deswik or Hexagon MinePlan scheduling outputs.
attributes.references: LOM (Life of Mine) plan; Deswik mine scheduling; Hexagon MinePlan production schedule

attributes.name: lom_plan_recovery_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Life of Mine Plan Recovery Percentage Target
attributes.description: LOM (Life of Mine) plan target metallurgical recovery percentage for this unit operation and period. Used for variance analysis between actual and planned recovery. Sourced from process design basis and LOM plan assumptions.
attributes.references: LOM (Life of Mine) plan; JORC Code resource/reserve reporting; Deswik mine scheduling

attributes.name: medium_density_kg_per_m3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dense Media Density (kg per cubic metre)
attributes.description: Density of the dense medium (ferrosilicon or magnetite suspension) used in Dense Media Separation (DMS) unit operations, expressed in kg/m³. Type-specific parameter for DMS operations. Controls separation cut-point and product quality.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian; SME Mineral Processing Handbook DMS (Dense Media Separation) parameters

attributes.name: metallurgical_account_period
attributes.description: The calendar month period (YYYY-MM) to which this unit operation event is assigned for metallurgical accounting and financial reporting purposes. Used to aggregate shift-level events into monthly mass balance reconciliation reports.
attributes.references: JORC Code metallurgical accounting; ICMM mineral accounting guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI period close

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the unit operation was in active production during the event period. Excludes planned and unplanned downtime. Used in OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation and availability reporting.
attributes.references: ICMM OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) standard; Infor EAM availability reporting

attributes.name: operation_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification of the unit operation within its type (e.g., SAG mill, ball mill, HPGR, crusher for comminution; rougher, scavenger, cleaner for flotation; heap, tank, vat, CIL, CIP for leaching; solvent extraction, electrowinning for SX-EW; spirals, shaking tables, jigs for gravity). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sag_mill|ball_mill|hpgr|crusher|rougher|scavenger|cleaner|heap_leach|tank_leach|vat_leach|cil|cip|solvent_extraction|electrowinning|spirals|shaking_tables|jigs|dense_media_separation|magnetic_separation|thickener|filter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System asset framework; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Type discriminator identifying the class of mineral processing unit operation for this event. Drives which type-specific attribute groups are populated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: comminution|flotation|leaching|sx_ew|dms|gravity_separation|magnetic_separation|thickening_dewatering — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICMM mineral processing taxonomy; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: p80_feed_microns
attributes.description: 80th percentile passing size of the feed material in microns (µm). Primary comminution circuit feed size parameter used to characterise ore hardness, set mill operating conditions, and benchmark against design P80. Applicable to comminution operation types (SAG, ball mill, HPGR, crusher).
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook comminution standards; OSIsoft PI System particle size analyser

attributes.name: p80_product_microns
attributes.description: 80th percentile passing size of the product material in microns (µm) exiting the comminution unit operation. Compared against target grind size to assess liberation efficiency and downstream flotation or leach performance.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; OSIsoft PI System particle size analyser historian

attributes.name: plant_area_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the physical plant area or section within the processing facility where this unit operation is located (e.g., COMM-01 for comminution area 1, FLOT-02 for flotation area 2). Aligns with P&ID area designations.
attributes.references: P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) area coding standard; SAP S/4HANA functional location hierarchy

attributes.name: power_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Total electrical energy consumed by the unit operation during the event period, expressed in kWh. Used in energy cost allocation, OPEX reporting, and carbon footprint calculations. Sourced from power meters via OSIsoft PI System.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System power historian; SAP S/4HANA CO cost allocation; ICMM energy reporting

attributes.name: product_grade_pct
attributes.description: Grade of the valuable mineral in the product or concentrate expressed as a percentage. For flotation concentrates this is the concentrate grade; for leach circuits this is the solution grade. Used in metallurgical accounting and concentrate quality reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code; LabWare LIMS assay results; ICMM metallurgical accounting guidelines

attributes.name: product_tonnage_dry_t
attributes.description: Dry metric tonnes of product (concentrate, leach solution, or processed material) produced by the unit operation during the event period. Used in metallurgical accounting mass balance calculations.
attributes.references: JORC Code metallurgical accounting standards; OSIsoft PI System process historian

attributes.name: reagent_dosage_g_per_t
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reagent Dosage (grams per Dry Metric Tonne)
attributes.description: Total reagent addition rate for the primary reagent in the unit operation, expressed in grams per dry metric tonne of feed. Covers collectors, frothers, depressants (flotation), or lixiviants (leaching). Used in reagent cost tracking and process optimisation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System reagent dosing historian; SAP S/4HANA MM reagent consumption; ICMM reagent management guidelines

attributes.name: recovery_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the valuable mineral in the feed that is recovered into the product stream during this unit operation event. Calculated as (product mass × product grade) / (feed mass × feed grade) × 100. Core KPI for process performance and LOM plan variance.
attributes.references: JORC Code metallurgical accounting; ICMM mineral processing performance standards; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: slurry_density_kg_per_m3
attributes.description: Density of the slurry (water and ore mixture) in the unit operation, expressed in kg/m³. Critical process control parameter for flotation, leaching, and thickening circuits. Sourced from nuclear density gauges or Coriolis meters via OSIsoft PI System.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian; SME Mineral Processing Handbook slurry characterisation

attributes.name: slurry_ph
attributes.description: pH value of the process slurry measured during the unit operation event. Critical for flotation reagent effectiveness, leach chemistry control, and environmental compliance. Sourced from inline pH probes via OSIsoft PI System.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian; ISO 10523 pH measurement standard; IsoMetrix environmental monitoring

attributes.name: specific_energy_kwh_per_t
attributes.business_glossary_term: Specific Energy Consumption (kWh per Dry Metric Tonne)
attributes.description: Energy consumed per dry metric tonne of feed processed by the unit operation, expressed in kWh/t. Key efficiency metric for comminution circuits (SAG, ball mill, HPGR) and electrowinning. Sourced from power meters via OSIsoft PI System. Used in OPEX analysis and LOM energy cost modelling.
attributes.references: ICMM energy efficiency reporting; OSIsoft PI System power historian; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: tailings_tonnage_dry_t
attributes.description: Dry metric tonnes of tailings (gangue and waste material) generated by the unit operation during the event period. Used in mass balance reconciliation, TSF (Tailings Storage Facility) capacity planning, and environmental reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code metallurgical accounting; ISO 14001; IsoMetrix tailings monitoring; TSF (Tailings Storage Facility) management standard

attributes.name: throughput_rate_tph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Throughput Rate (Dry Metric Tonnes per Hour)
attributes.description: Instantaneous or average throughput rate of the unit operation during the event period, expressed in dry metric tonnes per hour (t/h). Compared against design capacity and LOM plan targets for process control and production reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian; MES production reporting; LOM plan targets

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit operation event record was last modified, including metallurgical accountant adjustments, data quality corrections, or status transitions.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer audit conventions; ISO 8601

attributes.name: water_consumption_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of process water consumed by the unit operation during the event period, expressed in cubic metres. Used in water balance reporting, environmental compliance (EIS), and OPEX cost allocation. Sourced from flow meters via OSIsoft PI System.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; IsoMetrix environmental monitoring; EIS (Environmental Impact Statement) water reporting

products.name: flotation_event
products.description: Transactional record of flotation circuit performance per shift including rougher, scavenger, and cleaner stages. Captures feed grade, concentrate grade, tailings grade, mass pull (%), air flow rate (m³/min), froth depth (mm), reagent dosage rates, and circuit recovery (%). Supports metallurgical accounting and reagent optimisation.

attributes.name: flotation_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each flotation circuit performance record per shift. Primary key for this transactional entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Flotation events occur on specific flotation cell assets. Metallurgical engineers and maintenance teams track cell-level performance (recovery, froth depth, air flow) against asset OEE and maintenance

attributes.name: circuit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flotation circuit (e.g., rougher, scavenger, cleaner bank) where this event was recorded. Links to the processing circuit master resource. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE / resource reference category.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Flotation circuits target specific minerals/commodities (copper, nickel, zinc). Core to recovery tracking, circuit optimization, and metallurgical reporting. Domain experts expect commodity-specific f

attributes.name: feed_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.feed_stream. Business justification: Flotation events process specific feed streams. One event processes one feed stream; one feed stream has many events. This links the flotation event to the feed stream being processed.

attributes.name: grade_parameter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grade_parameter. Business justification: Flotation events record feed_grade_pct, concentrate_grade_pct, and tailings_grade_pct for a specific element. Linking to grade_parameter ensures correct parameter definition for metallurgical reportin

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Flotation involves chemical reagents (collectors, frothers, depressants) and mechanical hazards (impellers, agitators). Incidents during flotation operations (chemical spills, equipment failures, expo

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.laboratory. Business justification: Flotation circuit samples (feed, concentrate, tailings) are sent to designated labs for grade and recovery verification. Critical for process control, circuit optimization, and validating online analy

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Flotation cell mechanical issues (impeller wear, air system failures) during events trigger maintenance work orders. Links flotation performance problems to maintenance interventions for recovery opti

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral processing plant or concentrator facility where the flotation circuit operates. Enables plant-level aggregation and benchmarking across sites.

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.production_schedule. Business justification: Flotation events track recovery performance against scheduled mine production for metallurgical accounting, ore type performance analysis, and integrated mine-mill optimization. Essential for recovery

attributes.name: shift_production_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.shift_production_run. Business justification: Flotation events occur during a production shift run. One flotation event belongs to one shift run; one shift run has many flotation events. This links the event to the processing domain's shift entit

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational shift during which this flotation event was recorded. Enables shift-level metallurgical accounting and performance comparison across day, afternoon, and night shifts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Flotation circuit operators target a specific concentrate specification (grade, recovery, impurity limits). Linking enables automated conformance checking of concentrate_grade_target_pct and recovery_

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tailings.tsf. Business justification: Flotation circuits generate tailings streams deposited to specific TSF. Critical for metallurgical balance closure, TSF capacity management, and geochemical characterization. Tracks tailings_mass_t de

attributes.name: unit_operation_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.unit_operation_event. Business justification: unit_operation_event is described as the 'unified transactional record of all mineral processing operations per shift per circuit, using a type pattern' — it is the supertype record. flotation_event i

attributes.name: air_flow_rate_m3_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Air Flow Rate (Cubic Metres Per Minute)
attributes.description: Volumetric flow rate of air injected into the flotation cells, measured in cubic metres per minute (m³/min). Air flow is a primary control variable affecting bubble generation, froth stability, and mineral recovery. Monitored via OSIsoft PI SCADA integration.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: cell_count_operating
attributes.description: Number of flotation cells actively operating in the circuit during this event period. Cells may be taken offline for maintenance or cleaning. Operating cell count affects residence time and overall circuit capacity. Sourced from Infor EAM work order data.

attributes.name: cell_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total active volume of the flotation cells in operation during this event, measured in cubic metres (m³). Combined with feed rate, determines slurry residence time which is a key flotation kinetics parameter.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: circuit_availability_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the event period during which the flotation circuit was available and operating (not in planned or unplanned downtime). Calculated as operating hours divided by scheduled hours × 100. Contributes to Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; OSIsoft PI System; ICMM OEE Guidelines

attributes.name: circuit_recovery_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the valuable mineral in the feed that is recovered into the concentrate product for this flotation circuit stage. Calculated as: (concentrate mass × concentrate grade) / (feed mass × feed grade) × 100. Core metallurgical KPI for LOM plan tracking and reagent optimisation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category.
attributes.references: ICMM Metallurgical Accounting Guidelines; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: circuit_stage
attributes.description: The specific stage of the flotation circuit captured in this event record. Rougher is the primary separation stage; scavenger recovers minerals from rougher tailings; cleaner upgrades rougher concentrate grade; recleaner further upgrades cleaner concentrate. Critical for stage-by-stage metallurgical accounting.
attributes.references: ICMM Metallurgical Accounting Guidelines; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: collector_dosage_g_per_t
attributes.description: Dosage rate of the collector reagent (e.g., xanthate, dithiophosphate) added to the flotation circuit, expressed in grams per dry metric tonne of feed (g/t). Collector promotes hydrophobicity of target mineral surfaces to enable bubble attachment. Key reagent optimisation variable.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Pronto Xi Inventory; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: concentrate_grade_pct
attributes.description: Grade of the valuable mineral in the flotation concentrate product, expressed as a percentage (%). Measures the quality of the separation achieved. Higher concentrate grade reduces downstream smelting costs and improves payable metal. Sourced from LabWare LIMS.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Metallurgical Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: concentrate_grade_target_pct
attributes.description: The planned or contractually required concentrate grade for the valuable mineral, expressed as a percentage (%). Used to assess whether the flotation circuit is meeting product quality specifications for offtake agreements and smelter contracts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Hexagon MinePlan; ICMM Metallurgical Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: concentrate_mass_t
attributes.description: Total dry mass of concentrate produced by the flotation circuit during the event period, measured in dry metric tonnes (t). Used in metallurgical accounting mass balance and payable metal calculations.
attributes.references: ICMM Metallurgical Accounting Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flotation event record was first captured in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: depressant_dosage_g_per_t
attributes.description: Dosage rate of the depressant reagent (e.g., sodium cyanide, zinc sulphate, CMC) added to the flotation circuit, expressed in grams per dry metric tonne of feed (g/t). Depressants selectively prevent flotation of gangue minerals or penalty elements, improving concentrate grade and selectivity.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Pronto Xi Inventory; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: downtime_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason for any unplanned or planned downtime experienced by the flotation circuit during this event period (e.g., pump failure, cell maintenance, reagent outage, power interruption). Null if no downtime occurred. Used for reliability analysis and maintenance planning in Infor EAM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pump_failure|cell_maintenance|reagent_outage|power_interruption|planned_shutdown|instrumentation_fault — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp marking the end of the flotation measurement period (typically shift end). Combined with start timestamp to define the measurement window for throughput and reagent consumption calculations.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this flotation event record, formatted as FLT-YYYY-MM-DD-NNNN. Used for cross-system reference, metallurgical accounting reconciliation, and audit trail. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp marking the start of the flotation measurement period (typically shift start). Used for time-series alignment with OSIsoft PI historian data and SCADA records. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the flotation event record. Draft indicates data entry in progress; confirmed indicates shift data locked; reviewed indicates metallurgist sign-off; approved indicates inclusion in metallurgical balance; voided indicates record invalidated. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; ICMM Metallurgical Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: feed_grade_pct
attributes.description: Head grade of the valuable mineral (e.g., copper, lithium, nickel) in the flotation feed, expressed as a percentage (%). Derived from assay results and used as the denominator in circuit recovery calculations. Sourced from LabWare LIMS assay data.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: feed_particle_size_p80_um
attributes.description: The 80th percentile passing particle size (P80) of the flotation feed, measured in micrometres (µm). Particle size is a critical determinant of flotation performance — coarse particles are difficult to float while ultra-fine particles suffer from poor bubble attachment. Sourced from LabWare LIMS particle size analysis.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; SME Mineral Processing Handbook; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_rate_tph
attributes.description: Mass flow rate of ore slurry fed into the flotation circuit during the event period, measured in dry metric tonnes per hour (t/h). Key throughput metric for metallurgical accounting and LOM plan performance tracking.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ICMM Metallurgical Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: froth_depth_mm
attributes.description: Depth of the froth layer maintained in the flotation cell during the event period, measured in millimetres (mm). Froth depth is a critical control parameter influencing concentrate grade and recovery trade-off. Deeper froth generally improves grade at the expense of recovery.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: frother_dosage_g_per_t

attributes.name: impeller_speed_rpm

attributes.name: lime_dosage_kg_per_t

attributes.name: mass_pull_pct

attributes.name: mineral_type

attributes.name: ore_type

attributes.name: pulp_density_pct_solids

attributes.name: recovery_target_pct

attributes.name: sample_reference
attributes.description: The LabWare LIMS sample identifier for the assay samples collected during this flotation event (feed, concentrate, and tailings). Enables traceability between the flotation performance record and the underlying laboratory assay results supporting grade data.

attributes.name: slurry_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature of the flotation feed slurry during the event period, measured in degrees Celsius (°C). Slurry temperature affects reagent solubility, reaction kinetics, and froth stability. Particularly relevant in cold-climate operations and heated leach-flotation circuits.

attributes.name: tailings_grade_pct
