attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the SX-EW event record. 'draft' indicates data entry in progress; 'confirmed' indicates shift data locked; 'reviewed' indicates metallurgist review complete; 'approved' indicates management sign-off; 'voided' indicates record invalidated.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; JORC Code

attributes.name: extraction_efficiency_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of copper extracted from the aqueous feed (PLS) into the organic phase during the solvent extraction stage, calculated as (PLS grade – raffinate grade) / PLS grade × 100. A key metallurgical recovery indicator for the SX circuit.
attributes.references: ICMM Operational Guidance; LabWare LIMS; Internal Metallurgical KPI Standard

attributes.name: impurity_fe_mgl
attributes.description: Concentration of iron (Fe) impurity in the electrowinning electrolyte, measured in milligrams per litre (mg/L). Elevated iron levels reduce current efficiency and degrade cathode surface quality. Monitored via LabWare LIMS shift samples.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS – Assay Results; LME Grade A Copper Standard; ASTM B115

attributes.name: impurity_mn_mgl
attributes.description: Concentration of manganese (Mn) impurity in the electrowinning electrolyte, measured in milligrams per litre (mg/L). Manganese causes anode passivation and cathode surface defects. Tracked via LabWare LIMS for electrolyte bleed management.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS – Assay Results; LME Grade A Copper Standard

attributes.name: lom_plan_cathode_kg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Life of Mine (LOM) Plan Cathode Target (kg/shift)
attributes.description: Planned cathode copper production target for the shift as defined in the Life of Mine (LOM) plan or short-term production schedule. Used for variance analysis between actual and planned production, and for LOM plan tracking.
attributes.references: Deswik – Mine Scheduling; Hexagon MinePlan – Production Schedule; JORC Code

attributes.name: organic_cu_concentration_gl
attributes.description: Concentration of copper in the organic (solvent) phase of the solvent extraction circuit, measured in grams per litre (g/L). A key process control parameter indicating the loading efficiency of the organic extractant (e.g., LIX reagent). Sourced from OSIsoft PI System online analysers or LabWare LIMS shift samples.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Process Historian; LabWare LIMS; ICMM Operational Guidance

attributes.name: organic_flow_rate_m3h
attributes.description: Volumetric flow rate of the organic solvent phase circulating through the solvent extraction mixer-settlers, measured in cubic metres per hour (m³/h). Used to control the aqueous-to-organic (A:O) ratio and optimise copper extraction efficiency.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Flow Historian; P&ID Reference

attributes.name: pls_flow_rate_m3h
attributes.description: Volumetric flow rate of the pregnant leach solution (PLS) entering the solvent extraction circuit, measured in cubic metres per hour (m³/h). Controls the aqueous-to-organic (A:O) ratio and extraction circuit residence time.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Flow Historian; P&ID Reference

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the SX-EW production event occurred. Used for daily production reporting, reconciliation against Life of Mine (LOM) plan targets, and regulatory disclosure.

attributes.name: raffinate_grade_gl
attributes.description: Copper concentration in the raffinate (barren aqueous solution) exiting the solvent extraction circuit after copper has been extracted, measured in grams per litre (g/L). Used to calculate extraction efficiency and monitor copper losses to raffinate.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Process Historian; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: reagent_consumption_lm3
attributes.description: Volume of organic extractant reagent (e.g., LIX 984N or equivalent) consumed per cubic metre of pregnant leach solution processed, measured in litres per cubic metre (L/m³). Used for reagent cost tracking, OPEX reporting, and supply chain planning via Pronto Xi.
attributes.references: Pronto Xi – Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Consumption; ICMM

attributes.name: shift_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the operational shift ended for this SX-EW event. Used to calculate shift duration and align with production reporting periods.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Event Frame End Time; ISO 8601

attributes.name: shift_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the operational shift commenced for this SX-EW event. Principal business event timestamp used for time-series analysis, production scheduling alignment, and OSIsoft PI historian correlation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Event Frame Start Time; ISO 8601

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift period: day, afternoon, or night. Used for shift-pattern analysis, fatigue risk management, and production performance benchmarking across shift rotations.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 – Occupational Health and Safety; Internal Shift Schedule

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating operational system from which this SX-EW event record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation between systems, and data quality root cause analysis in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: specific_energy_kwh_t
attributes.description: Electrical energy consumed per tonne of copper cathode produced, measured in kilowatt-hours per tonne (kWh/t Cu). A key OPEX and sustainability metric for the electrowinning circuit, used for energy cost allocation and carbon footprint reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Energy Historian; SAP S/4HANA CO – Cost Centre; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; ISO 14001

attributes.name: spent_electrolyte_grade_gl
attributes.description: Copper concentration in the spent electrolyte returning from the electrowinning cells to the stripping circuit, measured in grams per litre (g/L). The difference between strip solution grade and spent electrolyte grade represents the copper deposited per pass.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Process Historian; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: strip_solution_grade_gl
attributes.description: Copper concentration in the electrolyte strip solution (advance electrolyte) fed to the electrowinning tankhouse, measured in grams per litre (g/L). Directly controls cathode deposition rate and current efficiency in the EW circuit.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Process Historian; LabWare LIMS; ICMM Operational Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SX-EW event record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and data quality monitoring in the Databricks silver layer.

products.name: reagent_consumption
products.description: Transactional record of reagent consumption per shift per circuit. Captures reagent type (collector, frother, flocculant, lime, cyanide, acid, solvent), dosage rate (g/t or kg/hr), total quantity consumed (kg), unit cost, batch lot number, and circuit applied. Supports reagent cost tracking (OPEX), optimisation, and environmental compliance reporting.

attributes.name: reagent_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reagent consumption record in the mineral processing circuit. Primary key for this transactional entity.

attributes.name: chemical_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.chemical_register. Business justification: Reagents consumed in processing must be registered chemicals with SDS, GHS classification, and handling procedures. Links consumption records to chemical hazard data for regulatory compliance (thresho

attributes.name: circuit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral processing circuit (e.g., flotation, leaching, SX-EW, DMS) where the reagent was applied. Enables circuit-level OPEX analysis.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Reagent costs are material opex components (often 10-30% of processing costs) allocated to cost centres for AISC calculation and budget control. reagent_consumption.cost_centre_code (plain attr) is de

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Reagent costs (cyanide, lime, collectors) are posted to specific GL accounts for AISC C1 cost reporting. reagent_consumption already has cost_centre but lacks GL account reference needed for automated

attributes.name: goods_issue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.goods_issue. Business justification: In mining ERP, reagent consumption triggers a goods issue (SAP movement type 201/261) from warehouse stock. Linking reagent_consumption to goods_issue enables material document reconciliation, invento

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.laboratory. Business justification: Reagent quality samples (collectors, frothers, flocculants) analyzed at specific labs for specification compliance and batch acceptance testing. Supply chain quality control requirement to ensure reag

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral processing plant or facility where the reagent was consumed. Supports multi-site OPEX reporting and benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Centre; Internal Asset Hierarchy

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Reagent handling activities (cyanide dosing, acid addition, xanthate use) require specific task-level risk assessments beyond the chemical register entry. Mining HSE systems link reagent consumption r

attributes.name: shift_production_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.shift_production_run. Business justification: Reagent consumption is recorded per shift run. One consumption record belongs to one shift run; one shift run has many consumption records. This links the consumption to the processing domain's shift

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational shift during which the reagent was consumed. Links to the shift master for date, crew, and time-of-day context.

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reagent master record identifying the specific chemical reagent (collector, frother, flocculant, lime, cyanide, acid, solvent, etc.) consumed.
attributes.references: Pronto Xi Inventory Master; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: unit_operation_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.unit_operation_event. Business justification: Reagent consumption occurs during specific unit operations (flotation, leaching, etc.). Linking reagent_consumption to unit_operation_event provides granular traceability of reagent use to the specifi

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Reagent consumption during maintenance activities (pump repairs, system flushes, reagent line maintenance) is costed against the work order for AISC and opex allocation. Mining cost accountants requir

attributes.name: batch_lot_number
attributes.description: Supplier batch or lot number of the reagent consumed. Enables traceability for quality incidents, reagent performance investigations, and environmental compliance audits.
attributes.references: Pronto Xi Inventory Batch Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: consumption_record_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this consumption record, formatted as RC-YYYY-MM-NNNNNN. Used for cross-referencing with SAP material documents, LIMS records, and environmental compliance reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Document; Internal Numbering Standard

attributes.name: consumption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reagent consumption record. Draft records are pending operator confirmation; confirmed records are locked for OPEX reporting; adjusted records have been corrected post-shift; cancelled records are voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement Status; Internal Process Control Standard

attributes.name: consumption_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world date and time at which the reagent consumption event occurred or was recorded by the process control system (OSIsoft PI / SCADA). Distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Process Historian; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reagent consumption record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit cost and total cost fields (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Required for multi-currency OPEX reporting and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin of the reagent consumption data: SCADA/OSIsoft PI automated reading, manual operator entry, LabWare LIMS import, SAP ERP goods issue, or estimated value. Critical for data quality assessment and audit trail.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; LabWare LIMS; SAP S/4HANA MM; Internal Data Quality Standard

attributes.name: dosage_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which the reagent was dosed into the circuit, expressed in grams per tonne (g/t) of ore processed or kilograms per hour (kg/hr) depending on the reagent type and circuit. Core metric for reagent optimisation and benchmarking against LOM plan targets.
attributes.references: ICMM Mineral Processing Best Practice; Internal Process Control Standard; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: dosage_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the reagent dosage rate field. Common units include grams per tonne (g/t) for solid reagents dosed relative to ore throughput, and kilograms per hour (kg/hr) for liquid reagents dosed by flow rate.
attributes.references: ICMM Mineral Processing Best Practice; Internal Process Control Standard

attributes.name: environmental_report_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reagent consumption event requires mandatory environmental compliance reporting (e.g., cyanide usage under ICMC, acid consumption under EIS conditions). Drives automated compliance workflow in IsoMetrix.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; IsoMetrix Environmental Monitoring; ICMM Cyanide Management Code

attributes.name: feed_grade_percent
attributes.description: Head grade (percentage) of the valuable mineral in the ore feed to the circuit during the shift. Contextualises reagent dosage decisions — higher feed grades may require adjusted reagent rates for optimal recovery.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Assay Results; JORC Code; Internal Grade Control Standard

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reagent is classified as hazardous under applicable environmental and safety regulations (e.g., cyanide, sulphuric acid). Triggers mandatory environmental compliance reporting and PPE requirements per ISO 14001 and ISO 45001.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; IsoMetrix HSE; MSHA Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or supervisor notes regarding the reagent consumption event, such as reasons for deviation from planned dosage, equipment issues affecting dosing, or reagent quality observations.

attributes.name: ore_throughput_t
attributes.description: Total dry metric tonnes of ore processed through the circuit during the shift. Used as the denominator for calculating specific reagent consumption (g/t) and benchmarking against LOM plan targets.
attributes.references: Internal Mineral Processing KPI Standard; JORC Code; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: plan_dosage_rate
attributes.description: Life of Mine (LOM) plan target dosage rate for this reagent in this circuit, in the same unit as dosage_rate. Enables variance analysis between actual and planned reagent consumption for process optimisation.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; Hexagon MinePlan; Internal LOM Plan Standard

attributes.name: plan_quantity_kg
attributes.description: Life of Mine (LOM) plan target quantity of reagent for this shift and circuit in kilograms. Used for budget variance reporting and OPEX performance management against the approved mine plan.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO Budget; Internal LOM Plan Standard

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP or Pronto Xi purchase order number under which the reagent batch was procured. Enables three-way matching (PO, goods receipt, invoice) and links consumption to procurement contracts for OPEX tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order; Pronto Xi Procurement; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: quantity_consumed_kg
attributes.description: Total mass of reagent consumed during the shift in kilograms. Primary quantity field for OPEX cost calculation, reagent inventory reconciliation, and environmental compliance reporting of chemical usage volumes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Issue; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity consumed field. Defaults to kilograms (kg) for solid reagents; litres (L) for liquid reagents. Enables multi-reagent reporting with consistent unit handling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; Internal Inventory Standard

attributes.name: recovery_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the valuable mineral recovered from the feed ore during the shift in this circuit. Key process performance indicator correlated with reagent dosage to assess reagent effectiveness and optimise consumption.
attributes.references: ICMM Mineral Processing Best Practice; Internal Processing KPI Standard; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the shift during which the reagent was consumed. Used for daily and monthly OPEX roll-up reporting and LOM plan variance analysis.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operational shift (day, night, or afternoon) during which the reagent was consumed. Supports shift-level performance analysis and reagent usage pattern identification.

attributes.name: slurry_density_g_per_cm3
attributes.description: Density of the slurry in grams per cubic centimetre at the time of reagent consumption. Influences reagent dispersion and effectiveness; monitored via OSIsoft PI System for process control and optimisation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA; Internal Process Control Standard

attributes.name: slurry_ph
attributes.description: pH level of the slurry (water and ore mixture) in the circuit at the time of reagent consumption. Critical process parameter for reagent effectiveness — lime and acid dosage directly controls pH for flotation and leaching circuits.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA; Internal Process Control Standard; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: specific_consumption_g_per_t
attributes.description: Reagent consumption normalised per dry metric tonne of ore processed (grams per tonne). Calculated as quantity_consumed_kg × 1000 / ore_throughput_t. Key OPEX optimisation metric and LOM plan variance indicator.
attributes.references: ICMM Mineral Processing Best Practice; Internal OPEX Reporting Standard

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the supplier who provided the reagent batch consumed. Used for supplier performance management, procurement analysis, and reagent quality investigations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Pronto Xi Procurement

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: Total Operating Expenditure (OPEX) cost of reagent consumed during the shift, calculated as quantity_consumed_kg multiplied by unit_cost. Primary financial metric for reagent OPEX tracking, budget variance, and All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Centre Accounting; IFRS IAS 2; World Gold Council AISC Standard

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per kilogram (or applicable unit) of the reagent at the time of consumption, sourced from the SAP purchase order or standard cost. Used for shift-level OPEX calculation and reagent cost variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Standard Cost; SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reagent consumption record was last modified (e.g., post-shift adjustment, supervisor confirmation). Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring in the Databricks Silver layer.

products.name: slurry_measurement
products.description: Time-series measurement record of slurry parameters at key process points captured from OSIsoft PI System via OPC-UA. Captures measurement point ID, timestamp, slurry density (t/m³), percent solids (%w/w), flow rate (m³/hr), pH, temperature (°C), viscosity (cP), data quality flag (good/suspect/bad/substituted), and sensor status code. Data quality flags enable detection of sensor faults, instrument drift, and substituted values for downstream metallurgical mass balance calculations. Enables real-time process control, historian trending, and automated alarm generation.

attributes.name: slurry_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each slurry measurement record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this time-series observation table. Entity role: EVENT_LOG — append-only stream of immutable slurry parameter observations captured from OSIsoft PI System via OPC-UA at key mineral processing points.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical instrument or sensor asset record in the asset management system (Infor EAM) that generated this measurement. Enables traceability from measurement data to instrument maintenance history, calibration records, and asset lifecycle management. Supports instrument drift detection and predictive maintenance analytics.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; ISA-5.1 Instrumentation Symbols; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: measurement_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process measurement point (instrument tag location) where the slurry parameters were captured. Corresponds to the PI tag source location in the OSIsoft PI System, identifying the physical sensor or instrument node in the mineral processing circuit (e.g., SAG mill discharge, flotation feed, leach feed).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-95 Equipment Hierarchy

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral processing plant or facility where the slurry measurement was recorded. Enables multi-site reporting and benchmarking across processing facilities within the mining operation.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Equipment Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Plant Master

attributes.name: process_circuit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific processing circuit (e.g., comminution, flotation, leaching, SX-EW) within the plant where the measurement was taken. Supports circuit-level mass balance and metallurgical accounting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-88 Batch Control Standard

attributes.name: shift_production_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.shift_production_run. Business justification: Slurry measurements are taken during a production shift run. One measurement belongs to one shift run; one shift run has many measurements. This links the measurement to the processing domain's shift

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational shift during which this slurry measurement was recorded. Enables shift-level aggregation and reporting of process performance, throughput, and data quality statistics. Links to the shift schedule maintained in SAP S/4HANA HR or the mine operations shift management system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; Mine Operations Shift Management; ISA-95

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tailings.tsf. Business justification: Slurry measurements at the plant tailings outlet (density, flow rate, pH, solids content) are used for TSF deposition planning and tailings characterisation. Linking measurement points to the receivin

attributes.name: alarm_high_limit
attributes.description: The configured upper alarm threshold for this measurement point in the SCADA/DCS system. When the measured value exceeds this limit, an automated high alarm is generated for operator response. Expressed in the same engineering unit as the measurement. Used for automated alarm generation and process safety management.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-18.2 Alarm Management; IEC 62682 Alarm Systems

attributes.name: alarm_low_limit
attributes.description: The configured lower alarm threshold for this measurement point in the SCADA/DCS system. When the measured value falls below this limit, an automated low alarm is generated for operator response. Expressed in the same engineering unit as the measurement. Used for automated alarm generation and process safety management.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-18.2 Alarm Management; IEC 62682 Alarm Systems

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent calibration performed on the instrument or sensor that generated this measurement, in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used to assess measurement reliability, identify instruments due for recalibration, and support data quality investigations. Instruments with expired calibration may have their measurements flagged as 'suspect' in the data quality flag.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; ISO 9001 Quality Management; OIML International Measurement Standards

attributes.name: conductivity_ms_cm
attributes.description: Electrical conductivity of the slurry at the measurement point, expressed in millisiemens per centimetre (mS/cm). Indicator of dissolved ion concentration, relevant for process water quality management, reagent dosing control in flotation, and environmental monitoring of process water circuits.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISO 7888 Water Conductivity; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI System data quality status flag for this measurement record, indicating the reliability of the captured value. 'good' = valid measurement within instrument range; 'suspect' = value outside expected range or instrument drift detected; 'bad' = sensor fault or communication failure; 'substituted' = value replaced by manual entry or interpolation. Critical for downstream metallurgical mass balance calculations and automated alarm generation. Aligns with OPC-UA quality codes.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OPC-UA Standard IEC 62541; ISA-95

attributes.name: deviation_from_setpoint
attributes.description: The arithmetic difference between the actual measured value and the configured process setpoint value (measured_value minus setpoint_value), expressed in the same engineering unit. A non-derived operational field captured directly from the PI System control deviation tag. Positive values indicate measurement above setpoint; negative values indicate below setpoint. Used for process control performance monitoring and alarm root cause analysis.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-95; Process Control Engineering Standards

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measurement associated with the primary measurement value for this PI tag (e.g., t/m³, %w/w, m³/hr, pH, °C, cP, mS/cm, µm). Sourced from the PI tag engineering unit configuration. Supports dynamic unit-aware analytics and cross-tag comparisons in the metallurgical historian.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SI Units (International System of Units); ISA-95

attributes.name: flow_rate_m3_hr
attributes.description: Volumetric flow rate of the slurry stream at the measurement point, expressed in cubic metres per hour (m³/hr). Measured by electromagnetic or Coriolis flow meter. Used in metallurgical mass balance, throughput calculations, and pump performance monitoring. Fundamental input for recovery rate and concentrate production calculations.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-5.1 Instrumentation Symbols; Metallurgical Accounting Standards

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) at which this measurement record was ingested into the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer from the OSIsoft PI System source. Distinct from the measurement_timestamp (when the physical measurement occurred). Used for data pipeline latency monitoring, SLA tracking, and identifying late-arriving data in streaming ingestion pipelines.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: is_alarm_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether an active process alarm condition existed at this measurement point at the time of measurement (True = alarm active; False = no alarm). Sourced from the SCADA/DCS alarm management system via OSIsoft PI System event frames. Enables alarm frequency analysis, process stability assessment, and operator response time reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-18.2 Alarm Management; IEC 62682 Alarm Systems

attributes.name: is_in_control
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the measurement value was within the defined process control limits (alarm_low_limit to alarm_high_limit) at the time of measurement (True = in control; False = out of control). Supports Statistical Process Control (SPC) analysis, process stability KPIs, and automated metallurgical mass balance quality gates.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-95; Statistical Process Control (SPC) Standards; JORC Code

attributes.name: mass_flow_rate_t_hr
attributes.description: Mass flow rate of dry solids in the slurry stream, expressed in dry metric tonnes per hour (t/hr). Calculated from volumetric flow rate and slurry density adjusted for percent solids. Primary throughput metric for metallurgical accounting, LOM (Life of Mine) plan tracking, and production reporting against targets.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code; Metallurgical Accounting Standards; LOM Plan

attributes.name: measurement_point_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the physical location and purpose of the measurement point within the processing circuit (e.g., 'SAG Mill 01 Discharge Slurry', 'Flotation Feed Box', 'CIL Tank 3 Overflow'). Supports operator interpretation and alarm investigation.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) at which the slurry parameter observation was recorded by the OSIsoft PI System historian. This is the principal event time for the measurement, distinct from record ingestion timestamps. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Critical for time-series trending, process control, and metallurgical mass balance calculations.

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical parameter being measured at this process point. Identifies which slurry property this record represents, enabling filtering and aggregation by parameter type across the processing circuit. Aligns with PI tag attribute classification in the OSIsoft PI System. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: density|percent_solids|flow_rate|ph|temperature|viscosity|conductivity|particle_size|mass_flow — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-95; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next calibration of the instrument or sensor, in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used to proactively manage instrument maintenance schedules via Infor EAM and to flag measurements from instruments approaching or past their calibration due date. Supports data quality governance and regulatory compliance for measurement traceability.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; ISO 9001 Quality Management; OIML International Measurement Standards

attributes.name: opc_ua_node_reference
attributes.description: The OPC-UA (OPC Unified Architecture) node identifier for the data source that feeds this measurement into the OSIsoft PI System. Provides the source system address for data lineage, integration troubleshooting, and SCADA connectivity management. Format follows OPC-UA NodeId specification (e.g., ns=2;s=SITE.AREA.UNIT.TAG).
attributes.references: OPC-UA Standard IEC 62541; OSIsoft PI System; SCADA Integration Standards

attributes.name: particle_size_p80_um
attributes.description: The 80th percentile passing particle size of the solid fraction in the slurry, expressed in micrometres (µm). Key comminution performance indicator for SAG mill and HPGR circuits. P80 is the industry-standard metric for grind size control, directly impacting downstream flotation and leaching recovery rates.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SME Mineral Processing Handbook; JORC Code; Comminution Circuit Design Standards

attributes.name: percent_solids
attributes.description: Weight percentage of solid material in the slurry, expressed as percent weight-by-weight (%w/w). Derived from slurry density and known ore specific gravity. A key process control parameter for comminution (SAG, HPGR), flotation, and leaching circuits. Typical operating range: 20–75 %w/w depending on circuit type.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SME Mineral Processing Handbook; JORC Code

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: Measured pH of the slurry at the measurement point on the standard pH scale (0–14). Critical process control parameter for flotation (reagent effectiveness), leaching (acid/alkaline conditions), and cyanide destruction circuits. Monitored continuously to ensure optimal mineral recovery and environmental compliance. Typical operating range varies by circuit: flotation 8–11, acid leach 1.5–2.5.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISO 10523 Water Quality pH Measurement; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI System tag identifier (instrument tag name) associated with this measurement point. Serves as the source system natural key enabling traceability back to the PI historian tag configuration and SCADA/OPC-UA data source. Format follows site-specific PI tag naming conventions (e.g., SITE.AREA.UNIT.PARAMETER).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OPC-UA Standard IEC 62541

attributes.name: process_area_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the functional process area within the mineral processing plant where the measurement was taken (e.g., COMM for comminution, FLOT for flotation, LEACH for leaching, SXEW for SX-EW, THCK for thickening). Supports area-level operational reporting and alarm management.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Equipment Hierarchy; P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) Standards

attributes.name: raw_value
attributes.description: The unprocessed, unvalidated measurement value as received directly from the OSIsoft PI System historian before any quality filtering, engineering unit conversion, or substitution is applied. Preserved for audit, instrument calibration verification, and data quality investigation. Enables comparison between raw and processed values to detect instrument drift.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OPC-UA Standard IEC 62541; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: sample_interval_seconds
attributes.description: The configured sampling or scan interval for this PI tag in seconds, indicating how frequently the OSIsoft PI System captures a new measurement value (e.g., 1, 5, 10, 30, 60 seconds). Used to assess data density, identify gaps in time-series data, and configure alarm thresholds appropriately.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-95; OPC-UA Standard IEC 62541

attributes.name: sensor_status_code
attributes.description: Instrument or sensor status code as reported by the SCADA/OPC-UA system at the time of measurement. Provides granular diagnostic information beyond the data quality flag, including specific fault codes (e.g., COMM_FAIL, RANGE_HI, RANGE_LO, CAL_DUE, OFFLINE, NORMAL). Used for instrument maintenance scheduling via Infor EAM and sensor fault detection analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NORMAL|COMM_FAIL|RANGE_HI|RANGE_LO|CAL_DUE|OFFLINE|FROZEN|DRIFT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OPC-UA Standard IEC 62541; Infor EAM; ISA-5.1

attributes.name: setpoint_value
attributes.description: The target or desired setpoint value for this measurement parameter as configured in the DCS/SCADA process control system. Expressed in the same engineering unit as the measurement. Enables deviation analysis between actual measured values and process control targets, supporting process optimisation and LOM plan performance tracking.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-95; DCS/SCADA Process Control Standards

attributes.name: slurry_density_t_m3
attributes.description: Measured density of the slurry (water and ore mixture) at the measurement point, expressed in tonnes per cubic metre (t/m³). Captured from nuclear density gauge or Coriolis flow meter via OPC-UA. Critical parameter for metallurgical mass balance calculations, pump sizing, and process control. Typical range for mineral processing slurries: 1.0–2.2 t/m³.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code; Metallurgical Accounting Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The natural key or record identifier from the OSIsoft PI System historian for this specific measurement event (e.g., PI event frame ID or compressed archive record reference). Enables exact traceability back to the source historian record for data lineage, audit, and reconciliation purposes in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: substitution_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a measurement value was substituted when data_quality_flag = 'substituted'. Values: 'manual_entry' = operator manually entered value; 'interpolated' = value interpolated from adjacent timestamps; 'last_known_good' = previous valid value carried forward; 'calculated' = derived from related measurements; 'not_applicable' = no substitution occurred. Required for metallurgical mass balance audit trail and data governance compliance.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Metallurgical Accounting Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Measured temperature of the slurry at the measurement point, expressed in degrees Celsius (°C). Relevant for leaching kinetics (heap leach, pressure oxidation), reagent reaction rates, and viscosity calculations. Monitored for process optimisation and equipment protection (e.g., pump seal integrity).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISA-95; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: viscosity_cp
attributes.description: Dynamic viscosity of the slurry at the measurement point, expressed in centipoise (cP). Affects pump performance, pipeline transport efficiency, and flotation cell hydrodynamics. Elevated viscosity can indicate high clay content or incorrect percent solids, impacting comminution and separation efficiency.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SME Mineral Processing Handbook; ASTM D2196 Viscosity Measurement

SSOT for concentrate production output linked to sales and product domains.

attributes.name: commodity_type

attributes.name: concentrate_grade_pct
attributes.description: The grade of the primary commodity in the final concentrate product for this batch, expressed as a percentage (% Cu, % Fe, % Li, % Ni). The key product quality metric used in sales contracts and customer specifications. Sourced from LabWare LIMS assay results.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; ISO 11536 (Iron Ore Analysis)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this concentrate batch record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and governance compliance.

attributes.name: dispatch_mode
attributes.description: The primary transport mode used to dispatch this concentrate batch from the processing plant to the port or customer (e.g., rail, road, ship, pipeline, conveyor). Determines logistics cost allocation and supply chain planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Supply Chain Management Standards

attributes.name: dry_weight_dmt
attributes.description: Dry weight of the concentrate batch in dry metric tonnes (DMT), calculated after moisture correction. The primary commercial weight measure used for sales contracts, invoicing, and production reporting. Key SSOT field for concentrate production output.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh_t

attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISO 50001 (Energy Management); ICMM

attributes.name: feed_tonnes
attributes.description: Total dry metric tonnes of Run of Mine (ROM) ore fed into the processing circuit to produce this concentrate batch. Used as the denominator in recovery rate and yield calculations.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: head_grade_pct
attributes.description: The grade of the primary commodity in the feed ore (Run of Mine (ROM)) entering the processing circuit for this batch, expressed as a percentage (%). Represents the input quality before beneficiation. Used for recovery rate calculation and reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: impurity_silica_pct
attributes.description: Silica (SiO2) content in the concentrate batch expressed as a percentage (%). A key gangue impurity that affects product quality, smelter penalties, and customer acceptance. Sourced from LabWare LIMS assay results.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; ISO 11536; Customer Product Specifications

attributes.name: impurity_sulfur_pct
attributes.description: Sulfur (S) content in the concentrate batch expressed as a percentage (%). A critical impurity for smelter operations and environmental compliance. High sulfur levels may attract penalties or rejection. Sourced from LabWare LIMS.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; ISO 11536; Environmental Protection Regulations

attributes.name: is_quality_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this concentrate batch has passed quality control review and been formally approved for sale or dispatch. True = approved; False = pending or rejected. Set by the metallurgist or quality manager in LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the concentrate batch expressed as a percentage (%) of wet weight. Determined by laboratory analysis per ISO 3087. Critical for DMT calculation and product quality compliance.

attributes.name: particle_size_p80_um
attributes.description: The P80 particle size of the concentrate batch in micrometres (µm), representing the sieve size through which 80% of the material passes. Critical comminution (size reduction) quality parameter affecting downstream processing efficiency and product specification compliance.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; LabWare LIMS; ISO 4701 (Size Distribution)

attributes.name: process_route
attributes.description: The mineral processing route used to produce this concentrate batch (e.g., flotation, leaching, Dense Media Separation (DMS), Solvent Extraction Electrowinning (SX-EW), High Pressure Grinding Rolls (HPGR), Semi-Autogenous Grinding (SAG)). attributes.name: production_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the concentrate batch production was completed and the batch was sealed/finalised at the processing plant. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System historian.

attributes.name: provisional_price_usd_dmt
attributes.description: The provisional sale price per dry metric tonne (DMT) in US dollars (USD) agreed at the time of dispatch, subject to final price adjustment based on quotation period commodity prices. Used for initial revenue recognition under IFRS 15.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IFRS 15; LME (London Metal Exchange)

attributes.name: quality_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the concentrate batch was formally approved for sale following quality control review. Represents a key lifecycle milestone in the batch workflow. Sourced from LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: The quality classification assigned to this concentrate batch based on assay results and product specification compliance. Grade A = premium specification met; Grade B = standard specification met; Grade C = marginal specification; off_spec = outside specification but saleable; rejected = failed quality control and cannot be sold.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Customer Product Specifications; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: reagent_consumption_kg_t
attributes.description: Total reagent consumption per tonne of ore processed for this concentrate batch, expressed in kilograms per tonne (kg/t). Aggregates all flotation, leaching, or other process reagents. Used for operating expenditure (OPEX) tracking and process efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SAP S/4HANA CO; ICMM

attributes.name: recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the valuable mineral in the feed ore that is successfully recovered into the concentrate product for this batch. Calculated as (concentrate grade × DMT) / (head grade × feed tonnes) × 100. Key processing efficiency KPI tracked against LOM plan targets.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: sample_date
attributes.description: The date on which the representative sample was taken from this concentrate batch for laboratory assay analysis. Used for sample chain-of-custody tracking and quality control compliance.

attributes.name: slurry_density_gcm3
attributes.description: The density of the concentrate slurry (water and ore mixture) in grams per cubic centimetre (g/cm³) at the point of batch finalisation. Monitored via OSIsoft PI System SCADA. Used for process control and dewatering circuit optimisation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SCADA; Internal Process Standards

attributes.name: throughput_tph
attributes.description: The average ore processing throughput rate in tonnes per hour (tph) achieved during the production of this concentrate batch. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian. Used for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and capacity utilisation analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: water_consumption_m3_t

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this metallurgical balance record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ICMM Reporting Framework; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of waste rock (gangue) dilution in the feed material, representing the proportion of non-ore material included during mining and haulage. Impacts feed grade and recovery.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Hexagon MinePlan Grade Control; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Total electrical energy consumed by the processing circuit during the accounting period in kilowatt hours. Key OPEX component and sustainability metric reported under GRI and ICMM frameworks.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; ICMM Reporting

attributes.name: feed_grade
attributes.description: Assayed head grade of the feed material expressed as percentage (%) for base metals or grams per tonne (g/t) for precious metals. Determined by LabWare LIMS assay results on feed samples.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; LabWare LIMS Assay Module; SAMREC Code 2016

attributes.name: feed_grade_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the feed head grade value: pct (percentage), g_per_t (grams per tonne), kg_per_t (kilograms per tonne), or ppm (parts per million). Varies by commodity.

attributes.name: feed_moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the feed material as a percentage of wet weight. Used to convert wet tonnes to dry tonnes for metallurgical accounting purposes.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Sample Management; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_tonnes_dry
attributes.description: Total dry metric tonnes of Run of Mine (ROM) ore fed to the processing circuit during the accounting period. Dry weight basis is the standard for metallurgical accounting.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; ICMM Reporting Framework; SAP S/4HANA CO Production Order

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record is the current (latest approved) version of the metallurgical balance for the given period and circuit. True = current version; False = superseded version retained for audit trail.

attributes.name: mass_balance_closure_pct
attributes.description: Mass balance closure expressed as a percentage: (concentrate_tonnes_dry + tailings_tonnes_dry) / feed_tonnes_dry × 100. Values outside 98–102% typically trigger investigation and adjustment.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: measured_recovery_pct
attributes.description: Actual metallurgical recovery percentage calculated from assayed feed, concentrate, and tailings grades and tonnes using the standard two-product formula. Represents the proportion of valuable mineral recovered into concentrate.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; SAMREC Code 2016; CIM Definition Standards 2014

attributes.name: metal_units_feed
attributes.description: Total contained metal units in the feed stream for the period, calculated as feed_tonnes_dry × feed_grade. Expressed in tonnes of metal or troy ounces depending on commodity. Key input to JORC resource-to-reserve reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; SEC S-K 1300; CIM Definition Standards 2014

attributes.name: metal_units_recovered
attributes.description: Total contained metal units recovered into concentrate for the period, calculated as concentrate_tonnes_dry × concentrate_grade. Used in LOM plan tracking and sales reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; SEC S-K 1300; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: ore_type
attributes.description: Geological ore type classification of the feed material processed during the period (e.g., oxide, sulphide, transitional, fresh, weathered). Ore type significantly influences metallurgical recovery and reagent consumption.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Geological Model; JORC Code 2012; Hexagon MinePlan Geology

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the metallurgical accounting period: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual. Determines the reporting frequency and aggregation level for LOM plan tracking.

attributes.name: plant_availability_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the accounting period during which the processing plant was available for production (scheduled hours minus planned and unplanned downtime). Component of Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: reagent_consumption_kg_per_t
attributes.description: Total reagent consumption per dry metric tonne of feed processed during the period, aggregated across all reagents (collectors, frothers, pH modifiers, leach reagents). Key OPEX driver for processing cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Materials Management; OSIsoft PI System; ICMM Reporting

attributes.name: recovery_variance_pct
attributes.description: Difference between measured_recovery_pct and theoretical_recovery_pct (measured minus theoretical). Positive value indicates outperformance; negative indicates underperformance against LOM plan.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework; Deswik LOM Plan

attributes.name: tailings_grade
attributes.description: Assayed grade of the tailings stream expressed in the same unit as feed_grade_unit. Indicates the residual valuable mineral content lost to tailings; key input to recovery calculation and environmental reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; LabWare LIMS Assay Module; ISO 14001

attributes.name: tailings_tonnes_dry
attributes.description: Total dry metric tonnes of tailings (gangue and process waste) discharged to the Tailings Storage Facility (TSF) during the accounting period. Used in mass balance closure and TSF capacity planning.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; ICMM Tailings Management

attributes.name: theoretical_recovery_pct
attributes.description: Theoretical or planned recovery percentage for the period based on LOM plan targets, ore type characterisation, and process design parameters. Used as the benchmark for variance analysis.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Deswik LOM Plan; Hexagon MinePlan Scheduling

attributes.name: throughput_rate_tph
attributes.description: Average processing throughput rate in dry metric tonnes per hour during the accounting period. Key operational KPI for plant performance against design capacity and LOM plan.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Process Historian; Caterpillar MineStar Productivity; ICMM Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this metallurgical balance record was last modified. Updated on every version increment, adjustment, or status change. Supports audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICMM Reporting Framework; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this metallurgical balance record for the given period and circuit. Increments with each adjustment or restatement, supporting full audit trail and competent person sign-off requirements.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; SEC S-K 1300 Mineral Resource Disclosure

attributes.name: water_consumption_m3
attributes.description: Total fresh water consumed by the processing circuit during the accounting period in cubic metres. Reported for environmental compliance under ISO 14001 and GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; IsoMetrix Environmental Monitoring

products.name: recovery_target
products.description: LOM plan-derived recovery rate targets per processing circuit, commodity, and ore type. Captures target period (month/quarter/year), circuit ID, ore type, target recovery (%), target throughput (tph), target head grade, target concentrate grade, and basis (LOM plan version, feasibility study reference). Enables variance analysis between actual and planned recovery performance.

attributes.name: recovery_target_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each recovery target record in the LOM plan-derived processing circuit performance baseline.

attributes.name: block_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.block_model. Business justification: Recovery targets are derived from block model grade distributions and metallurgical domain assignments during LOM planning. Mine planners use block model data to set target_recovery_pct and target_hea

attributes.name: circuit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral processing circuit (e.g., SAG mill circuit, flotation circuit, SX-EW circuit, DMS circuit) for which this recovery target applies.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Asset Framework; Internal Processing Circuit Register

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Recovery targets are set per commodity in LOM plans and feasibility studies. Core to mine planning, economic modeling, and performance tracking. Replaces denormalized commodity text field with proper

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: Recovery targets are set per geological domain because oxide, sulphide, and transitional domains have fundamentally different metallurgical recovery characteristics. Mine planners set target_recovery_

attributes.name: grade_parameter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grade_parameter. Business justification: Recovery targets are set per grade parameter — Cu recovery target differs from Au recovery target even in the same circuit. LOM planning requires recovery targets to reference the specific grade param

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Life of Mine (LOM) plan version from which this recovery target is derived. Enables traceability of targets back to the authorised planning document.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; Hexagon MinePlan LOM Scheduling Module

attributes.name: metallurgical_test_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.metallurgical_test. Business justification: Recovery targets are derived from and must be traceable to specific metallurgical test results (flotation kinetics, leach extraction curves, grind-recovery relationships). The feasibility_study_ref pl

attributes.name: mining_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mining_block. Business justification: Recovery targets vary by mining block ore type, grade, and metallurgical domain for domain-based planning, ore type scheduling, and metallurgical performance forecasting. Critical for LOM planning wit

attributes.name: ore_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.ore_reserve. Business justification: Recovery targets are modifying factors applied to ore reserves under JORC/NI43-101 reporting standards. Metallurgists set recovery targets directly from ore reserve grade and mineralogy assumptions. C

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Recovery targets are set per orebody based on geological characteristics, mineralogy, and metallurgical testwork. Life-of-mine planning requires orebody-specific recovery assumptions to accurately for

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral processing plant or facility where the circuit operates. Supports multi-site recovery target management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Functional Location; Infor EAM Asset Register

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Processing recovery targets are set during budget and LOM planning at profit centre level. Linking enables variance reporting between budgeted recovery targets and actual metallurgical balance results

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: Recovery targets are set per ore source/prospect because different prospects have distinct metallurgical characteristics (mineralogy, hardness, grade variability). Plants processing ore from multiple

attributes.name: regulatory_condition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.regulatory_condition. Business justification: Mining licences frequently impose minimum metallurgical recovery conditions on tenement holders. Processing recovery targets are set to comply with these regulatory conditions. Compliance reporting re

attributes.name: resource_estimate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.resource_estimate. Business justification: Recovery targets are derived from resource estimate metallurgical assumptions. Critical for LOM planning, economic modeling, and feasibility study validation. Real business need: linking processing ta

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Recovery targets are set per saleable product — copper cathode recovery targets differ from copper concentrate targets even from the same ore. LOM planning and feasibility studies set recovery targets

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Recovery targets are set in the context of a specific product specification — the target grade and impurity limits define the required recovery percentage. LOM planning and feasibility studies explici

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Recovery targets are set per tenement because ore characteristics and LOM economics are tenement-specific. Feasibility studies and LOM planning require recovery targets attributed to the tenement from

attributes.name: volume_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.volume_plan. Business justification: Production-to-sales volume planning alignment is a core mining commercial process: the sales volume plan is built directly from processing recovery targets (planned throughput, recovery rate, concentr

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Competent Person or authorised technical authority who approved this recovery target for use in LOM planning and variance reporting. Required for JORC/NI 43-101 traceability.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Section 1; NI 43-101 Section 1.1; SEC S-K 1300 Qualified Person

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this recovery target was formally approved by the authorised Competent Person or planning authority. Provides audit trail for regulatory and governance compliance.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: basis_type
attributes.description: Classification of the technical study or planning document type that forms the basis for this recovery target (e.g., LOM plan, definitive feasibility study, pre-feasibility study, scoping study, annual budget). Indicates the confidence level and authority of the target.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; CIM Definition Standards; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: concentrate_grade_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target concentrate grade value (e.g., pct for percentage, g_per_t for grams per tonne). Ensures correct interpretation of the concentrate quality specification.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; SAMREC Code; NI 43-101

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this recovery target record was first created in the data platform. Provides audit trail for data lineage and governance.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this recovery target version becomes the active baseline for variance analysis and performance reporting. Supports Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Type 2 versioning of LOM plan targets.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard; Deswik Schedule Version Management

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this recovery target version ceases to be the active baseline, typically when superseded by a revised LOM plan. Null indicates the record is currently active. Supports SCD Type 2 versioning.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard; Deswik Schedule Version Management

attributes.name: feasibility_study_ref
attributes.description: Document reference number or title of the feasibility study, pre-feasibility study (PFS), or definitive feasibility study (DFS) from which this recovery target is derived. Provides audit traceability to the authorised technical study.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Section 49; NI 43-101 Section 13; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: head_grade_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target head grade value (e.g., pct for percentage, g_per_t for grams per tonne, ppm for parts per million). Ensures correct interpretation of the grade figure across different commodities.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; SAMREC Code; NI 43-101

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the current active version of the recovery target for the given circuit, commodity, ore type, and period. Supports efficient querying of the latest approved targets without filtering on version history.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard; Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2 Pattern

attributes.name: lom_plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the LOM plan from which this target is derived (e.g., LOM-2024-v3.1). Enables tracking of target changes across successive LOM plan revisions and supports variance analysis against the correct plan baseline.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Version Control; Deswik Schedule Version Management

attributes.name: metal_units_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target contained metal units (e.g., t for metric tonnes, oz for troy ounces, lb for pounds). Ensures correct interpretation across different commodity reporting conventions.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; London Metal Exchange (LME) Reporting Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording planning assumptions, metallurgical test work caveats, ore type blending assumptions, or other contextual information relevant to the interpretation of this recovery target.

attributes.name: ore_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ore type or metallurgical domain for which this target applies (e.g., oxide, sulphide, transitional, mixed, fresh). Ore type significantly influences achievable recovery rates and processing parameters.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; Geovia GEMS Geological Domain Classification

attributes.name: processing_route
attributes.description: The primary mineral processing method or beneficiation route for which this target applies (e.g., flotation, Dense Media Separation (DMS), leaching, Solvent Extraction Electrowinning (SX-EW), High Pressure Grinding Rolls (HPGR), Semi-Autogenous Grinding (SAG)). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flotation|leaching|dms|sxew|gravity|magnetic_separation|hpgr|sag|cil|cip|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; Feasibility Study Process Design Criteria

attributes.name: target_concentrate_grade
attributes.description: Planned grade of the final concentrate or product output from the processing circuit during the target period, expressed in the unit defined by concentrate_grade_unit. Represents the quality specification for the saleable product.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 13; Sales Contract Specifications

attributes.name: target_concentrate_kt
attributes.description: Planned total dry metric tonnes of concentrate (in kilotonnes) to be produced during the target period. Supports sales planning, logistics scheduling, and LOM revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan LOM Schedule; SAP S/4HANA CO Production Planning

attributes.name: target_energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Planned total electrical energy consumption in kilowatt-hours for the processing circuit during the target period. Used for energy cost budgeting, carbon footprint reporting, and OPEX modelling.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; GRI Mining and Metals Supplement; SAP S/4HANA CO Energy Management

attributes.name: target_feed_moisture_pct
attributes.description: Planned moisture content of the Run of Mine (ROM) feed entering the processing circuit, expressed as a percentage. Affects dry tonne calculations, throughput, and reagent dosing. Derived from ore characterisation in the feasibility study.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Sample Moisture Analysis; Feasibility Study Ore Characterisation

attributes.name: target_head_grade
attributes.description: Planned feed grade (head grade) of the ore entering the processing circuit during the target period, expressed in the unit defined by head_grade_unit. Derived from the mine plan and geological resource model.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; Geovia GEMS Resource Model; NI 43-101 Section 14

attributes.name: target_mass_pull_pct
attributes.description: Planned mass pull percentage — the proportion of feed mass reporting to the concentrate stream. A key flotation circuit design parameter that balances recovery against concentrate grade. Derived from metallurgical test work in the feasibility study.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; Feasibility Study Metallurgical Test Work

attributes.name: target_metal_units
attributes.description: Planned quantity of contained metal units to be recovered during the target period, expressed in the unit defined by metal_units_unit (e.g., tonnes of copper, ounces of gold). Core metric for LOM production target and revenue planning.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101 Section 14; SAMREC Code Section 9

attributes.name: target_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the planning period to which this recovery target applies. Defines the upper boundary of the target window for performance measurement and LOM plan variance reporting.
attributes.references: Deswik Scheduling; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: target_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the planning period to which this recovery target applies. Combined with target_period_end to define the exact window for variance analysis against actual metallurgical balance results.
attributes.references: Deswik Scheduling; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: target_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the planning period for which this recovery target is defined: monthly, quarterly, annual, or full Life of Mine (LOM). Determines the temporal resolution of variance analysis.
attributes.references: Deswik Mine Scheduling; Hexagon MinePlan LOM Plan

attributes.name: target_plant_availability_pct
attributes.description: Planned plant availability percentage for the processing circuit during the target period, representing the proportion of scheduled time the plant is available for production. Used in conjunction with throughput targets to derive planned production volumes.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Availability Calculation; OSIsoft PI System OEE Module; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: target_reagent_consumption
attributes.description: Planned total reagent consumption rate in kilograms per dry metric tonne of ore processed. Aggregated across all reagents for the circuit. Used for OPEX budgeting and reagent procurement planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Procurement; Feasibility Study Process Design Criteria; OPEX Model

attributes.name: target_recovery_pct
attributes.description: Planned metallurgical recovery rate expressed as a percentage of valuable mineral recovered from feed to final product (concentrate or cathode). Derived from LOM plan or feasibility study metallurgical test work. Core KPI for processing performance variance analysis.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 13; SAMREC Code Section 9

attributes.name: target_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this recovery target record, used in planning documents, feasibility studies, and variance reporting (e.g., RT-CU-FL-202401).
attributes.references: Internal Planning Document Naming Convention; Deswik Scheduling Reference

attributes.name: target_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this recovery target record: draft (under preparation), approved (authorised for use in variance reporting), superseded (replaced by a newer version), or archived (no longer active).
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; SAP S/4HANA CO Planning Status

attributes.name: target_throughput_kt
attributes.description: Total planned dry metric tonnes (in kilotonnes) to be processed through the circuit during the target period. Complements the rate-based tph target for period-level production planning and LOM schedule adherence.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan LOM Schedule; Deswik Production Schedule

attributes.name: target_throughput_tph
attributes.description: Planned processing throughput rate in dry metric tonnes per hour (tph) for the circuit during the target period. Used to assess whether actual mill throughput meets LOM plan expectations.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Production Schedule; OSIsoft PI System Throughput Historian

attributes.name: target_utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Planned plant utilisation percentage — the proportion of available time the plant is actually operating and processing ore. Distinct from availability; utilisation reflects operational efficiency within available time.
attributes.references: Infor EAM OEE Calculation; OSIsoft PI System; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: target_water_consumption_m3
attributes.description: Planned total water consumption in cubic metres for the processing circuit during the target period. Supports water balance management, environmental licence compliance, and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; IsoMetrix Environmental Monitoring; GRI Mining and Metals Supplement

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this recovery target record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

products.name: operational_exception
products.description: Transactional record of operational exceptions within the processing plant including unplanned/planned downtime events and process parameter deviations from set-point targets. Captures event type (downtime, parameter_deviation, alarm), start/end timestamps, duration, affected circuit, category (mechanical, electrical, process, planned maintenance, feed shortage, parameter exceedance), severity, set-point vs actual values for deviations, root cause description, corrective action taken, responsible operator, and production loss (tonnes). Feeds OEE calculation, process control quality analysis, root cause investigation, and maintenance domain work order linkage.

attributes.name: operational_exception_id
attributes.description: Primary key for operational_exception

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary piece of equipment directly involved in or causing the operational exception. Links to the equipment asset register.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Register; SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: blast_execution_id

attributes.name: circuit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific processing circuit affected by the exception (e.g., SAG mill circuit, flotation circuit, leach circuit, SX-EW circuit, DMS circuit). Links to the circuit master.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Asset Framework; SAP PM Functional Location Hierarchy

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Operational exceptions (unplanned downtime, process upsets) cause production losses that must be costed and reported against cost centres for variance analysis, insurance claims, and OEE cost impact r

attributes.name: downtime_event_id
