attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Processing plant downtime events that trigger HSE incidents must reference the formal incident record for compliance reporting and root cause analysis. The current hse_incident_reference (string) shou

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Life of Mine (LOM) plan version against which production loss from this exception is measured. Enables variance reporting between actual downtime impact and LOM plan targets.
attributes.references: Deswik LOM Schedule; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code Resource and Reserve Reporting

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the mineral processing plant where the operational exception occurred. Links to the plant master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Functional Location; OSIsoft PI System Asset Framework

attributes.name: regulatory_condition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.regulatory_condition. Business justification: Process upsets and environmental exceedances at a plant may constitute breaches of tenement regulatory conditions, triggering mandatory regulatory reporting. Regulators require that each notifiable op

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Operational exceptions (process upsets, control deviations) are reviewed against the governing risk assessment to determine if critical controls were breached. Mining process safety management require

attributes.name: shift_production_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.shift_production_run. Business justification: Operational exceptions occur during a production shift run. One exception belongs to one shift run; one shift run has many exceptions. This links the exception to the processing domain's shift entity.

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shift report during which this operational exception was recorded. Links to the mine or plant shift report.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Caterpillar MineStar Shift Report

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tailings.tsf. Business justification: Processing plant operational exceptions are frequently caused by TSF constraints — tailings line blockages, TSF freeboard limits forcing throughput curtailment, or TSF pump failures. Linking exception

attributes.name: unit_operation_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.unit_operation_event. Business justification: Operational exceptions (unplanned downtime, process upsets, alarm events) occur during specific unit operation events. Linking operational_exception to unit_operation_event provides direct traceabilit

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the maintenance work order raised in response to this operational exception. Enables linkage to the maintenance domain for corrective or emergency work orders.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order; SAP PM Work Order (PM Order)

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: The measured actual value of the process parameter at the time of the deviation or alarm event. Compared against setpoint_value to determine deviation magnitude and against alarm limits for threshold breach analysis.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Real-Time Data; SCADA Historian

attributes.name: alarm_limit_high
attributes.description: The configured high alarm threshold for the process parameter at the time of the event. Used to contextualise whether the actual_value breached the high alarm boundary and to support alarm rationalisation analysis.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; OSIsoft PI System Alarm Configuration

attributes.name: alarm_limit_low
attributes.description: The configured low alarm threshold for the process parameter at the time of the event. Used to contextualise whether the actual_value breached the low alarm boundary.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; OSIsoft PI System Alarm Configuration

attributes.name: corrective_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken by the operator or maintenance team to resolve the operational exception and restore normal plant operations. Feeds maintenance knowledge base and SOP review processes.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Resolution; SAP PM Notification Resolution Text; ISO 45001 Corrective Action

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this operational exception record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and record provenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standard; IFRS Data Audit Requirements

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method by which the operational exception was first detected: scada_alarm (automated SCADA/PLC alarm), operator_observation (manual observation by plant operator), dcs_alert (Distributed Control System alert), lab_result (assay or process sample result), inspection (physical inspection finding), predictive_alert (predictive maintenance or process analytics alert).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Alarm Management; ISA-18.2; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: deviation_magnitude
attributes.description: Absolute difference between actual_value and setpoint_value at the time of the exception. Stored as a business field to support process control quality analysis and trend reporting without requiring arithmetic on raw values.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Performance Monitoring; ISA-18.2 Alarm Management

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed duration of the operational exception in minutes, calculated from event_start_timestamp to event_end_timestamp. Stored as a business field to support OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) availability loss reporting without requiring real-time timestamp arithmetic.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 OEE KPI Standard; Caterpillar MineStar Downtime Reporting

attributes.name: event_category
attributes.description: Operational category of the exception cause: mechanical (equipment failure), electrical (power or instrumentation fault), process (reagent, slurry, or chemistry issue), planned_maintenance (scheduled shutdown), feed_shortage (insufficient ROM feed), or parameter_exceedance (process variable breach). Drives OEE loss categorisation and maintenance domain routing.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Failure Classification; SAP PM Notification Category

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the operational exception event was resolved and normal operations resumed. Null if the event is still active. Used with event_start_timestamp to calculate event duration.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Event Frames; ISA-95 Manufacturing Operations Management

attributes.name: event_reference
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the operational exception event, used for cross-referencing with maintenance work orders, shift reports, and process control logs. Format: OE-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Reference; SAP PM Notification Number

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the operational exception event commenced, as recorded by the SCADA/PLC system or operator. This is the principal real-world event time used for duration calculation and OEE loss attribution.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Event Frames; ISA-95 Manufacturing Operations Management

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the operational exception record: open (event active, investigation pending), in_progress (corrective action underway), resolved (root cause identified and corrective action completed), closed (verified and signed off), cancelled (duplicate or incorrectly raised).
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Status; SAP PM Notification Status

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operational exception by its fundamental nature: downtime (equipment or circuit stoppage), parameter_deviation (process variable outside set-point tolerance), alarm (SCADA/PLC alarm triggered), near_miss (safety or process near-miss), or process_upset (uncontrolled process condition). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: downtime|parameter_deviation|alarm|near_miss|process_upset — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Alarm Management; ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems

attributes.name: hse_incident_raised
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident Raised Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this operational exception also triggered a formal HSE incident report in the IsoMetrix system (True) or not (False). Enables cross-domain linkage between process exceptions and HSE incident management.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix HSE Incident Management; ISO 45001; MSHA Incident Reporting

attributes.name: immediate_action
attributes.description: Description of the immediate containment action taken at the time of the exception to prevent further production loss, equipment damage, or safety risk, prior to full corrective action. Distinct from corrective_action which addresses root cause.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix Incident Management; ISO 45001 Emergency Response; SAP PM Notification

attributes.name: is_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime or exception event was planned (True) or unplanned (False). Planned events include scheduled maintenance shutdowns and planned feed stoppages. Used to segregate planned vs unplanned downtime in OEE calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 OEE KPI Standard; ICMM Operational Performance Reporting

attributes.name: oee_loss_category
attributes.description: OEE loss category to which this exception is attributed for OEE calculation purposes: availability (equipment or circuit not running), performance (running below rated throughput), or quality (product not meeting grade specification). Aligns with ISO 22400 OEE decomposition.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 OEE KPI Standard; ICMM Operational Performance Reporting

attributes.name: parameter_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the process parameter that deviated, providing context beyond the SCADA tag code. Examples: SAG Mill Feed Rate (tph), Flotation Cell Level (%), Leach Tank pH.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) Documentation

attributes.name: parameter_tag
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI System or SCADA tag identifier for the process parameter that deviated from its set-point. Applicable only for event_type = parameter_deviation or alarm. Examples: SAG_MILL_FEED_TPH, FLOTATION_CELL_LEVEL_PCT, LEACH_TANK_PH.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Tag Naming Convention; ISA-5.1 Instrumentation Symbols

attributes.name: parameter_unit
attributes.description: Engineering unit of measure for the process parameter set-point and actual values. Examples: tph (tonnes per hour), %, pH, m3/h, kPa, degC, g/L. Ensures correct interpretation of setpoint_value and actual_value.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units; OSIsoft PI System Engineering Units

attributes.name: production_loss_tonnes
attributes.description: Estimated ore or concentrate production lost in dry metric tonnes as a direct consequence of this operational exception. Used for OEE production loss attribution, LOM plan variance reporting, and OPEX impact quantification.
attributes.references: JORC Code Production Reporting; ISO 22400 OEE KPI Standard; ICMM Operational Performance

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardised code classifying the root cause of the exception per the plant's failure taxonomy (e.g., ISO 14224 cause codes). Enables structured root cause analysis and trend reporting across events.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Equipment Reliability and Maintenance Data; SAP PM Cause Code Catalogue

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified root cause of the operational exception, as determined through investigation. Supports root cause analysis (RCA), recurring failure identification, and process improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Root Cause Classification; Infor EAM Failure Analysis; SAP PM Cause Code

attributes.name: setpoint_value
attributes.description: The target or set-point value for the process parameter at the time of the deviation event. Used in conjunction with actual_value to quantify the magnitude of the deviation. Applicable for event_type = parameter_deviation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Set-Point Management; ISA-88 Batch Control Standard

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity rating of the operational exception indicating its impact on plant throughput, safety, and production targets. Critical: full circuit or plant stoppage; High: significant throughput reduction; Medium: partial degradation; Low: minor deviation with negligible production impact.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix Risk Matrix; ISO 45001 Risk Assessment; ICMM Critical Control Management

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the shift during which the operational exception commenced. Used for daily and shift-level production reporting and exception trend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Production Reporting; ISA-95 Manufacturing Operations

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Type of shift during which the operational exception occurred: day, night, or afternoon. Supports shift-level performance analysis and identification of shift-specific exception patterns.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Shift Management; ISA-95 Personnel and Equipment Scheduling

attributes.name: throughput_loss_tph
attributes.description: Estimated reduction in processing throughput rate in tonnes per hour (tph) attributable to this exception event. Supports OEE rate loss analysis and process bottleneck identification.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 OEE KPI Standard; Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this operational exception record was most recently modified, such as when root cause, corrective action, or resolution details were updated. Supports audit trail and data currency tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standard; IFRS Data Audit Requirements

products.name: concentrate_stockpile
products.description: Inventory record of concentrate stockpiles at processing plant pad and port storage facilities — the processing-domain view of physical inventory. Captures stockpile ID, location (plant pad, port shed, rail siding), commodity type, current inventory (dmt), grade (%), moisture (%), date of last survey (drone/LIDAR/manual), maximum capacity (dmt), and stockpile movement history (additions from production, removals for shipment). Supports logistics scheduling, sales nomination, blend optimisation, and inventory reconciliation. Note: this product owns the physical/operational stockpile state; commercial inventory positions, title transfer, and financial valuation are managed in the product and sales domains.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Stockpiles contain specific saleable products awaiting dispatch. Essential for sales order fulfillment, inventory valuation, and linking physical inventory to sales contracts. Standard in mining logis

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.shipment_nomination. Business justification: Shipment nominations allocate specific stockpile inventory to customer orders and vessel schedules. Logistics planning, inventory management, and customer delivery commitments depend on linking nomina

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.warehouse_location. Business justification: Concentrate stockpiles are physical storage locations requiring warehouse management for inventory reconciliation, site access control, environmental compliance, and security. Links processing output

attributes.name: additions_dmt
attributes.description: Cumulative dry metric tonnes of concentrate added to this stockpile from production since the last inventory reconciliation period. Represents inflows from the processing circuit (e.g., flotation, leaching, SX-EW). Used in mass balance and inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; OSIsoft PI System; ICMM Reporting

attributes.name: concentrate_type
attributes.description: Mineralogical classification of the concentrate product in this stockpile. Determines applicable processing routes, smelter penalty elements, and sales contract terms. E.g., sulphide concentrate from flotation vs oxide concentrate from leaching/SX-EW.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; CIM Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this concentrate stockpile record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for record provenance and data lineage.

attributes.name: dust_suppression_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether dust suppression measures (e.g., water sprays, chemical binders, covers) are currently applied to this stockpile. Relevant for environmental compliance, HSE reporting, and community impact management.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix HSE; ISO 14001; MSHA Dust Control Standards

attributes.name: grade_element
attributes.description: Chemical element or compound symbol for which the product_grade is reported (e.g., 'Cu' for copper, 'Fe' for iron, 'Li2O' for lithium oxide, 'Ni' for nickel). Ensures unambiguous interpretation of the grade value across commodities.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; CIM Standards

attributes.name: inventory_dmt
attributes.description: Current physical inventory of concentrate in the stockpile expressed as dry metric tonnes (DMT), adjusted for moisture content. This is the primary inventory quantity used for sales nominations, shipping calculations, and inventory reconciliation. Updated after each survey event.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; ICMM Reporting; FOB/CIF contract terms

attributes.name: inventory_wmt
attributes.description: Current physical inventory of concentrate in the stockpile expressed as wet metric tonnes (WMT), inclusive of moisture. Used for physical handling, transport weight calculations, and logistics planning. Distinct from DMT which is the commercial quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Pronto Xi Inventory

attributes.name: is_shipment_nominated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stockpile inventory has been nominated against an active shipment or vessel loading schedule. True = nominated for an upcoming shipment; False = available for future nomination. Supports logistics scheduling and sales operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Pronto Xi; FOB/CIF Contract Terms

attributes.name: is_under_environmental_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stockpile is subject to an environmental hold that restricts movement or shipment of material (e.g., pending EIS review, acid rock drainage concern, or regulatory compliance investigation). True = hold in place; False = no environmental restriction.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix HSE; ISO 14001; EIS Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: last_assay_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent laboratory assay used to determine the current product grade and moisture content of the stockpile. Used to assess grade data currency for sales nominations and blend optimisation.

attributes.name: last_survey_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical survey or measurement used to determine the current stockpile inventory volume and tonnage. Critical for assessing inventory data currency and triggering re-survey workflows when data is stale.
attributes.references: Internal Survey SOP; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: lom_inventory_target_dmt
attributes.description: Target concentrate inventory level in dry metric tonnes as specified in the Life of Mine (LOM) plan for the current period. Used to assess inventory performance against plan and trigger production rate adjustments.

attributes.name: max_capacity_dmt
attributes.description: Engineered maximum storage capacity of the stockpile expressed in dry metric tonnes (DMT). Used for capacity planning, logistics scheduling, and triggering production rate adjustments when inventory approaches capacity limits.
attributes.references: Mine Planning SOP; SAP S/4HANA MM; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Current moisture content of the concentrate stockpile expressed as a percentage of wet weight. Used to convert between WMT and DMT, assess handleability, and ensure compliance with shipping moisture limits (e.g., transportable moisture limit for bulk cargo under IMSBC Code).
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; IMSBC Code (IMO); ISO 3087 (Coal Moisture)

attributes.name: nominated_shipment_dmt
attributes.description: Quantity of concentrate in dry metric tonnes nominated against an active shipment or vessel loading schedule from this stockpile. Enables available-to-nominate calculation (inventory_dmt minus nominated_shipment_dmt) for logistics planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Pronto Xi; FOB/CIF Contract Terms

attributes.name: opening_inventory_dmt
attributes.description: Dry metric tonne inventory at the start of the current reconciliation period. Together with additions_dmt and removals_dmt, enables closing inventory calculation and mass balance closure verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; ICMM Reporting; IFRS 6

attributes.name: penalty_element_flags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of penalty elements detected in the concentrate above contractual threshold levels (e.g., 'As,Pb,Bi'). Penalty elements attract price deductions in smelter contracts and may trigger quarantine or blending requirements. Sourced from LabWare LIMS assay results.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Sales Contract Terms; ICMM Reporting

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Current assay-derived grade of the valuable mineral in the concentrate stockpile, expressed as a percentage (%). Represents the weighted average grade of all material currently in the stockpile based on the most recent survey or assay. Critical for sales nomination and blend optimisation.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; ISO 11536 (Iron Ore Assay)

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the current inventory reconciliation period for which additions_dmt and removals_dmt are accumulated. Nullable if the period is still open.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; ICMM Reporting; IFRS 6

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the current inventory reconciliation period for which additions_dmt and removals_dmt are accumulated. Aligns with metallurgical balance accounting periods for mass balance closure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; ICMM Reporting; IFRS 6

attributes.name: removals_dmt
attributes.description: Cumulative dry metric tonnes of concentrate removed from this stockpile for shipment, blending, or transfer since the last inventory reconciliation period. Represents outflows to logistics, port, or downstream processing. Used in mass balance and inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Pronto Xi; ICMM Reporting

attributes.name: stockpile_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this stockpile location, used in logistics scheduling, sales nominations, and inventory reconciliation reports. Sourced from SAP MM material document or plant layout register.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Pronto Xi Inventory

attributes.name: stockpile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the concentrate stockpile (e.g., 'Plant Pad A — Copper Concentrate', 'Port Shed 3 — Iron Ore Fines'). Used in operational dashboards and logistics communications.

attributes.name: stockpile_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by the metallurgist or inventory controller regarding this stockpile, such as quality observations, blending instructions, survey anomalies, or logistics constraints. Supports operational decision-making and audit trail.

attributes.name: stockpile_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the stockpile. 'active' = receiving or dispatching material; 'inactive' = temporarily not in use; 'full' = at maximum capacity; 'quarantine' = material held pending quality resolution; 'closed' = permanently decommissioned.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Internal Inventory Management SOP

attributes.name: survey_method
attributes.description: Method used to measure the current stockpile volume and derive inventory tonnage. Determines accuracy and frequency of inventory updates. Values: drone_lidar (aerial LiDAR scan), drone_photogrammetry (aerial photogrammetric survey), manual_survey (ground-based manual measurement), belt_scale (continuous belt weigher), weightometer (in-line weightometer), laser_scan (fixed laser scanner).
attributes.references: Internal Survey SOP; ISO 12745 (Copper Concentrate Sampling)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this concentrate stockpile record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver layer.

products.name: process_sample

Links to laboratory domain for assay results via sample ID. Supports JORC-compliant metallurgical accounting and process control.

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the process sample was physically collected at the sampling point. This is the principal real-world event time used for time-series analysis and metallurgical accounting period assignment.

attributes.name: composite_end_timestamp
attributes.description: End time of the compositing period for composite samples, defining the close of the time window over which increments were collected. Null for grab or incremental samples.

attributes.name: composite_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Start time of the compositing period for composite samples, defining the beginning of the time window over which increments were collected. Null for grab or incremental samples.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this process sample record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: dispatch_status
attributes.description: Current dispatch status of the prepared sample to the analytical laboratory, tracking the chain of custody from plant to laboratory.

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the prepared sample was physically dispatched to the analytical laboratory. Null if not yet dispatched.

attributes.name: head_grade
attributes.description: Assayed grade of the primary element in the sample, expressed in the unit defined by head_grade_unit. For feed samples this is the head grade; for concentrate or tailings samples this is the stream grade. Populated after laboratory analysis.

attributes.name: head_grade_unit

attributes.name: increment_count
attributes.description: Number of individual increments combined to form a composite sample. Used to assess sampling representativeness per Theory of Sampling (TOS). Null for grab samples.

attributes.name: is_representative
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample has been assessed as representative of the process stream for metallurgical accounting purposes. False samples are excluded from mass balance calculations.

attributes.name: mass_dry_g
attributes.description: Dry mass of the sample in grams after moisture removal during preparation. Used for dry-basis grade calculations and metallurgical accounting.

attributes.name: mass_wet_g
attributes.description: Total wet mass of the collected sample in grams as weighed at the sampling point prior to preparation. Used for mass balance calculations and sample representativeness assessment.

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the sample expressed as a percentage of wet mass, determined during sample preparation. Critical for converting wet-basis to dry-basis metallurgical accounting figures.

attributes.name: ore_type
attributes.description: Mineralogical classification of the ore represented by the sample, used for metallurgical performance benchmarking and LOM plan reconciliation. Oxide, sulphide, mixed, transitional, and fresh rock types exhibit different processing behaviour.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; CIM Definition Standards

attributes.name: particle_size_p80_um
attributes.description: 80th percentile passing particle size of the sample in micrometres (P80), characterising the grind size at the sampling point. Key comminution performance indicator for SAG and ball mill circuit control.

attributes.name: preparation_method

attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; ISO/IEC 17025; JORC Code 2012 Table 1

attributes.name: preparation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which sample preparation was completed in the sample preparation facility, marking readiness for dispatch to the laboratory.

attributes.name: pulp_density_pct_solids
attributes.description: Percentage solids by mass of the slurry at the sampling point, measured at time of collection. Relevant for slurry and pulp samples; null for dry ore samples.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: qaqc_flag
attributes.description: Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QAQC) classification of the sample: routine = standard production sample; blank = contamination check; standard = certified reference material for accuracy check; duplicate = laboratory duplicate for precision check; field_duplicate = field duplicate for sampling precision.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; ISO/IEC 17025; CIM Best Practice Guidelines

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason a sample was rejected or flagged as non-representative, such as contamination, insufficient mass, sampler malfunction, or chain of custody breach. Null if sample is valid.

attributes.name: sample_medium
attributes.description: Physical state or medium of the sample at the point of collection, distinguishing between slurry (wet ore/water mixture), dry ore, concentrate, leach solution (PLS), or pulp.

attributes.name: sample_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations recorded by the sampler or metallurgist at the time of collection or preparation, such as unusual process conditions, equipment anomalies, or visual observations.

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique sample identifier assigned at collection, used for tracking through preparation, dispatch, and laboratory assay. Corresponds to the sample barcode or label number in LabWare LIMS.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Sample Management; JORC Code 2012 Table 1

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the process sample tracking its workflow from collection through laboratory analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: collected|prepared|dispatched|received|analysed|rejected — promote to reference product if additional statuses required]

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Method by which the sample was collected: Composite = time or mass-proportional blend of multiple increments; Grab = single point-in-time collection; Incremental = single cut from a cross-stream sampler; Automatic = collected by automated sampler; Manual = collected by operator.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; WCSB (World Conference on Sampling and Blending) TOS; ISO 17034

attributes.name: sampler_type
attributes.description: Type of sampling device or method used to collect the sample: manual (operator-collected), automatic (automated cross-stream sampler), cross_belt, vezin (rotary cutter), or pipe_cross_cut. Affects representativeness assessment per TOS.
attributes.references: WCSB TOS; JORC Code 2012 Table 1; ISO 17034

attributes.name: sampling_point_code
attributes.description: Standardised code identifying the defined sampling point within the processing plant where the sample was collected (e.g., SAG_FEED, FLOAT_CONC, FLOAT_TAIL, CIL_FEED, LEACH_PLS). Corresponds to OSIsoft PI tag location.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Tag Naming; JORC Code 2012; ISO 17034

attributes.name: sampling_point_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the sampling point location within the processing circuit (e.g., 'SAG Mill Discharge Screen Oversize', 'Rougher Flotation Concentrate Launder').

attributes.name: stream_type
attributes.description: Classification of the process stream from which the sample was collected, indicating its position in the beneficiation flowsheet. Feed = ROM or circuit input; Concentrate = upgraded product stream; Tailings = waste stream; Intermediate = mid-circuit stream; Product = final saleable product; Recycle = recirculating load.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this process sample record was last modified, supporting data lineage, audit trail, and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; IFRS 6

products.name: plant_utility_consumption
products.description: Transactional record of utility resource consumption per processing circuit per shift or accounting period. Covers electrical energy (kWh, kW peak demand, power factor, specific energy kWh/t), water balance (fresh water intake m³, recycled water m³, process water consumption m³/t, evaporation losses), compressed air, and other plant utilities. Captures circuit ID, shift date, consumption volumes, unit costs, and compliance metrics against water licence limits and carbon budgets. Supports OPEX tracking, environmental reporting (water stewardship, carbon footprint), energy efficiency benchmarking, and regulatory compliance against LOM plan targets.

attributes.description: Identifier of the production shift during which this utility consumption was recorded. Links to the shift production run record for operational context.

attributes.name: shutdown_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.shutdown_plan. Business justification: Plant utility consumption (electricity, water, compressed air) during planned shutdowns must be attributed to the shutdown plan for AISC cost reporting and energy benchmarking. Mining finance and oper

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tailings.tsf. Business justification: Plant utility consumption records track water drawn from and returned to the TSF. Water licence compliance requires reconciling plant water use (fresh_water_intake_m3, recycled_water_m3) against the T

attributes.name: water_balance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tailings.water_balance. Business justification: Plant water consumption records must be reconciled against the TSF water balance for water licence compliance reporting. A direct FK enables automated reconciliation of plant-side water use (process_w

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the utility consumption record was approved by the authorised employee. Marks the record as locked for OPEX cost posting and environmental compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 14001

attributes.name: carbon_budget_target_co2e_t
attributes.description: Approved carbon budget allocation for this circuit and period in tonnes of CO₂ equivalent (tCO₂e), derived from the LOM plan carbon budget. Used to calculate emissions variance and compliance status.
attributes.references: ICMM Climate Change Position Statement; NGER Act; Internal LOM Plan Carbon Budget

attributes.name: compressed_air_consumption_m3
attributes.description: Volume of compressed air consumed by the circuit during the period in standard cubic metres (Sm³). Used for flotation cell aeration, instrumentation, and pneumatic equipment. Contributes to energy OPEX.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Internal OPEX Reporting Standard

attributes.name: consumption_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number for this utility consumption record, used for cross-referencing with SAP S/4HANA CO cost postings and OPEX reporting. Format: UC-YYYY-MM-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Internal OPEX Reporting Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this utility consumption record was first created in the system, sourced from OSIsoft PI System historian ingestion or manual entry. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 14001 Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary cost fields in this record (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Ensures consistent currency context for OPEX reporting and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin system or method by which utility consumption data was captured. PI System and SCADA sources are automated and high-confidence; manual_entry and estimated records require additional validation before use in regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SCADA Integration Standard; Internal Data Quality Framework

attributes.name: electricity_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Total electrical energy consumed by the circuit during the period in kilowatt-hours (kWh), sourced from OSIsoft PI System metering data. Primary input for energy OPEX calculation and carbon footprint reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; GRI 302-1 Energy Consumption; ISO 14001

attributes.name: electricity_cost_total
attributes.description: Total monetary cost of electricity consumed during the period in the reporting currency, calculated as electricity_consumption_kwh multiplied by electricity_unit_cost plus applicable demand charges. Posted to SAP S/4HANA CO cost centre.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS; Internal OPEX Reporting Standard

attributes.name: electricity_unit_cost
attributes.description: Contracted or metered unit cost of electricity per kilowatt-hour ($/kWh) applicable to this period. Confidential commercial rate used for OPEX cost allocation and energy cost benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element; Utility Supply Contract; IFRS

attributes.name: energy_target_kwh
attributes.description: Planned electrical energy consumption target for this circuit and period in kilowatt-hours (kWh), derived from the LOM plan energy budget. Used to calculate energy consumption variance for OPEX performance reporting.
attributes.references: Internal LOM Plan; AISC Reporting Standard; ICMM Energy and GHG Protocol

attributes.name: evaporation_loss_m3
attributes.description: Estimated volume of water lost to evaporation from open process vessels, ponds, and the TSF during the period in cubic metres (m³). Required for water balance closure and environmental reporting.
attributes.references: GRI 303-5 Water Consumption; ISO 14001; Water Licence Conditions

attributes.name: fresh_water_intake_m3
attributes.description: Volume of fresh water drawn from licensed water sources (rivers, bores, municipal supply) into the processing plant during the period in cubic metres (m³). Reported against water licence limits for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; GRI 303-3 Water Withdrawal; Water Licence Conditions

attributes.name: meter_reading_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the physical or virtual meter reading(s) underpinning this consumption record, as recorded in OSIsoft PI System or the utility provider invoice. Supports audit trail and data lineage for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Utility Invoice; Internal Metering Standard

attributes.name: natural_gas_consumption_gj
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas consumed by the circuit during the period in gigajoules (GJ), used for drying, heating, or on-site power generation. Input for Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions calculation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; GRI 302-1; NGER Act (Australia); ISO 14064

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording operational context, anomalies, meter faults, estimation methodology, or adjustment reasons relevant to this utility consumption record. Supports audit review and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: peak_demand_kw
attributes.description: Maximum instantaneous electrical power demand recorded during the period in kilowatts (kW). Used for utility tariff management, demand charge optimisation, and grid capacity planning.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Utility Tariff Agreement

attributes.name: period_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world end date and time of the utility consumption measurement period. Used with period_start_timestamp to calculate duration and validate completeness of the consumption record.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SAP S/4HANA CO Accounting Period

attributes.name: period_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world start date and time of the utility consumption measurement period. For shift records this aligns with shift start; for monthly records this is the first instant of the accounting month.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SAP S/4HANA CO Accounting Period

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the consumption accounting period. Shift-level records are sourced from OSIsoft PI System historian; monthly records align with SAP S/4HANA CO accounting periods for OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: power_factor
attributes.description: Average power factor (ratio of real power to apparent power, dimensionless 0–1) for the circuit during the period. Low power factor incurs utility penalty charges and indicates reactive power inefficiency.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Utility Tariff Agreement; IEC 60038

attributes.name: process_water_consumption_m3
attributes.description: Total process water consumed within the circuit during the period (fresh intake plus recycled, minus discharge) in cubic metres (m³). Net water balance input for environmental reporting and water licence compliance.
attributes.references: GRI 303-5 Water Consumption; ISO 14001; Water Licence Conditions

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle status of the utility consumption record. Draft records are pending submission; approved records are locked for OPEX and environmental reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: recycled_water_m3
attributes.description: Volume of process water recycled from the Tailings Storage Facility (TSF) and other internal sources back into the processing circuit during the period in cubic metres (m³). Supports water stewardship reporting and licence compliance.
attributes.references: GRI 303-3 Water Withdrawal; ISO 14001; Water Licence Conditions; ICMM Water Stewardship Protocol

attributes.name: scope1_emissions_co2e_t
attributes.description: Direct greenhouse gas emissions from on-site combustion of natural gas or other fuels during the period in tonnes of CO₂ equivalent (tCO₂e). Supports carbon budget compliance and NGER/GRI reporting.
attributes.references: GRI 305-1 Direct GHG Emissions; NGER Act (Australia); ISO 14064; ICMM Climate Change Position Statement

attributes.name: scope2_emissions_co2e_t
attributes.description: Indirect greenhouse gas emissions from purchased electricity consumption during the period in tonnes of CO₂ equivalent (tCO₂e), calculated using applicable grid emission factors. Supports carbon budget compliance and GRI/NGER reporting.
attributes.references: GRI 305-2 Indirect GHG Emissions; NGER Act (Australia); ISO 14064; ICMM Climate Change Position Statement

attributes.name: specific_energy_kwh_per_t
attributes.description: Electrical energy consumed per dry metric tonne of ore processed (kWh/t), calculated as electricity_consumption_kwh divided by tonnes_processed. Key comminution efficiency KPI benchmarked against LOM plan and AISC targets.
attributes.references: ICMM Energy and GHG Protocol; Internal LOM Plan; AISC Reporting Standard

attributes.name: specific_water_m3_per_t
attributes.description: Process water consumed per dry metric tonne of ore processed (m³/t). Key water efficiency metric benchmarked against LOM plan targets and water licence conditions.
attributes.references: GRI 303-5; ICMM Water Stewardship Protocol; Internal LOM Plan

attributes.name: tonnes_processed
attributes.description: Dry metric tonnes of ore processed through the circuit during the period. Used as the denominator for calculating specific consumption rates (e.g., kWh/t, m³/t) for benchmarking and LOM plan variance.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Internal Metallurgical Accounting Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this utility consumption record was last modified. Tracks corrections, adjustments, and re-submissions for data lineage and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 14001 Audit Trail

attributes.name: water_cost_total
attributes.description: Total monetary cost of fresh water intake during the period in the reporting currency, including licence fees and supply charges. Posted to SAP S/4HANA CO cost centre for OPEX tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS; Water Licence Conditions

attributes.description: Specified accuracy or tolerance of the measurement instrument, typically expressed as a percentage of full scale or absolute value.

attributes.name: instrument_type

attributes.name: is_critical_control_point

attributes.name: is_kpi_input

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.description: Detailed description of the physical location of the measurement point within the plant, including building, floor, and proximity references.

attributes.name: manufacturer

attributes.name: measurement_point_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the measurement point indicating its location and purpose within the processing circuit.

attributes.name: measurement_range_max
attributes.description: Upper bound of the instruments calibrated measurement range.

attributes.name: measurement_range_min
attributes.description: Lower bound of the instruments calibrated measurement range.

attributes.name: measurement_type

attributes.name: model_number

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required calibration activity based on the calibration frequency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special considerations, or operational notes related to this measurement point.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the measurement point indicating whether it is actively collecting data, under maintenance, or out of service.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Department or functional group responsible for maintaining and monitoring this measurement point (e.g., Process Control, Instrumentation, Metallurgy).

attributes.name: sampling_frequency_seconds
attributes.description: Interval in seconds at which the measurement point captures and records data values.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to the specific instrument unit.

attributes.name: tag_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric tag identifier assigned to the measurement instrument following plant instrumentation standards (e.g., FT-SAG-001, PT-FLOT-205).

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Desired or optimal measurement value as defined by the process control strategy or Life of Mine (LOM) plan.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the measurement value is expressed (e.g., t/h, kPa, °C, %, g/L, µm, pH units).

domains.name: laboratory

Serves as the SSOT for all geochemical and metallurgical test data including fire assay, XRF, and leach test results that underpin resource estimation and process optimisation.

products.name: laboratory_sample
products.description: Master record for every physical sample submitted to the laboratory, covering drill core (HQ, NQ, PQ), RC chips, channel samples, process stream samples, and metallurgical test charges. Captures sample identity, origin (drill hole ID, bench, pit, process stream), sample type, weight, preparation method, chain-of-custody status, LIMS barcode, and spatial coordinates (from/to depth or location). This is the SSOT for all sample identity data in LabWare LIMS and underpins resource estimation, grade control, and process optimisation workflows.

attributes.name: accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Calculated accuracy of the assay result compared to the expected grade for standard reference materials, expressed as a percentage. Measures systematic bias in the analytical method.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: The date on which the assay analysis was performed. Critical for tracking sample turnaround time and ensuring results are used within appropriate timeframes for resource estimation and grade control.

attributes.name: analysis_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the assay analysis was completed. Provides granular traceability for quality control and audit purposes.

attributes.description: The date and time when this assay result was formally approved by a qualified person. Marks the transition from preliminary to certified status.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the qualified person or laboratory supervisor who reviewed and approved this assay result for release. Required for certified results used in resource estimation.

attributes.name: below_detection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assay result was below the detection limit of the analytical method. True if below detection, False otherwise. Results flagged as below detection are typically assigned half the detection limit value for statistical purposes.

attributes.name: certified_result_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assay result has been certified and approved for use in JORC/NI 43-101 resource estimation and public reporting. True if certified, False if preliminary or for internal use only.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for analyst or reviewer comments regarding the assay result, including notes on sample condition, analytical issues, QA/QC observations, or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this assay result record was first created in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: detection_limit
attributes.description: The minimum concentration of the analyte that can be reliably detected by the analytical method. Results below this threshold are typically reported as below detection limit (BDL) or less than (<) values.

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: The factor by which the sample was diluted prior to analysis, typically applied when initial results exceed the upper detection limit. A value of 1.0 indicates no dilution; values greater than 1.0 indicate the sample was diluted (e.g., 10.0 means 10x dilution).

attributes.name: expected_grade
attributes.description: The certified or expected grade value for a standard reference material. Used to calculate accuracy and bias in QA/QC analysis. Null for non-standard samples.

attributes.name: grade_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the reported grade. Common units include ppm (parts per million), percent (%), g/t (grams per tonne), oz/t (ounces per ton), mg/kg (milligrams per kilogram), ppb (parts per billion).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this assay result record was last modified in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Tracks changes for audit and quality control purposes.

attributes.name: over_limit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the initial assay result exceeded the upper detection limit of the analytical method, requiring dilution and re-analysis. True if over limit, False otherwise.

attributes.name: precision_percent
attributes.description: Calculated precision of the assay result based on duplicate sample analysis, expressed as a percentage. Measures random error and reproducibility of the analytical method.

attributes.name: qaqc_sample_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Assurance Quality Control (QA/QC) Sample Type
attributes.description: Identifies the type of QA/QC sample if this result is part of the quality control program. Original indicates a regular production sample; other values indicate QA/QC control samples inserted into the analytical stream.

attributes.name: qaqc_status
attributes.description: Status of quality assurance and quality control checks applied to this assay result. Indicates whether the result passed all QA/QC protocols including blank, duplicate, and standard reference material checks.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the assay result was officially reported and released from the laboratory to the requesting party. May differ from analysis date due to quality control review and approval workflows.

attributes.name: reported_grade
attributes.description: The final assay grade value reported for the analyte in the sample. This is the primary geochemical measurement used for resource estimation, grade control, and metallurgical balance calculations. May be expressed in various units depending on analyte (ppm, percent, g/t).

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assay result. Preliminary results are for internal use only; final results are certified for resource estimation; cancelled results have been invalidated; superseded results have been replaced by re-analysis.

attributes.name: upper_limit
attributes.description: The maximum concentration of the analyte that can be accurately measured by the analytical method without dilution. Results exceeding this threshold require sample dilution and re-analysis.

Captures test type, feed grade, product grade, recovery rate, reagent consumption, grind size (P80), test conditions (pH, Eh, temperature, duration), and time-series extraction data. Serves as SSOT for all metallurgical characterisation data underpinning process design, feasibility studies, and plant optimisation.

attributes.description: Quality assurance and quality control validation status for the test results. Indicates whether results meet laboratory QA/QC protocols.

attributes.name: reagent_consumption_g_per_tonne
attributes.description: Total reagent consumption for the test, measured in grams per tonne of ore processed. Critical for operating cost estimation.

attributes.name: recovery_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the target commodity recovered from the feed into the final product. Key performance metric for all metallurgical tests.

attributes.name: smc_test_parameter_a
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAG Mill Comminution (SMC) Test Parameter A
attributes.description: SAG Mill Comminution test parameter A, representing ore competence. Used in SAG mill design and modeling.

attributes.name: smc_test_parameter_b
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAG Mill Comminution (SMC) Test Parameter B
attributes.description: SAG Mill Comminution test parameter B, representing ore abrasion. Used in SAG mill design and modeling.

attributes.name: tailings_grade_percent
attributes.description: Assayed grade of the target commodity remaining in the tailings or waste stream, expressed as percentage. Indicates losses.

attributes.name: test_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the metallurgical test program was completed and results finalized.

attributes.name: test_conditions_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing additional test conditions, parameters, or observations not covered by structured fields. Examples: agitation speed, solid-liquid ratio, oxygen partial pressure, multi-stage configurations.

attributes.name: test_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or work order number for the metallurgical test program, used for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: test_objective
attributes.description: Business purpose and goals of the metallurgical test program. Examples: process design, feasibility study, plant optimization, ore variability characterization, flowsheet development.

attributes.name: test_report_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or file path to the detailed metallurgical test report containing full methodology, results, and interpretation.

attributes.name: test_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the metallurgical test program commenced.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the metallurgical test program.

attributes.name: test_subtype
attributes.description: Specific test method or procedure within the test type category. Examples: Bond Ball Mill Work Index (BWi), Bond Rod Mill Work Index (RWi), SAG Mill Comminution (SMC) test, JK Drop Weight test, batch flotation, locked cycle flotation, bottle roll leach, column leach, heap leach, agitation leach, Carbon-In-Leach (CIL), Carbon-In-Pulp (CIP), High Pressure Grinding Rolls (HPGR), Dense Media Separation (DMS), Solvent Extraction Electrowinning (SX-EW).

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: High-level category of metallurgical test conducted. Comminution includes Bond Work Index, SAG Mill Comminution, JK Drop Weight, HPGR, Abrasion Index. Flotation includes batch and locked cycle tests. Leach includes bottle roll, column, heap, agitation, CIL/CIP, SX-EW.

products.name: sample_preparation
products.description: Tracks the physical preparation steps applied to each sample prior to analysis, including crushing, pulverising, splitting, drying, and sieving. Records preparation method code, equipment used, preparation date, operator, reject weight, pulp weight, moisture content, and preparation laboratory. Supports chain-of-custody integrity and contamination investigation.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sample preparation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific equipment used for preparation (e.g., crusher ID, pulverizer ID, splitter ID). Enables contamination investigation and equipment performance tracking.

attributes.name: chemical_register_id

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
