products.description: Master record for all commodity buyers, offtake counterparties, and trading partners including steel mills, smelters, energy companies, and commodity traders. Single source of truth for counterparty identity, legal entity details (ABN/ACN, DUNS number), country of incorporation, registered address, credit rating, KYC status, commercial classification, and operational preferences (preferred commodity grades, vessel sizes, loading ports, communication language, reporting format, invoice delivery method, relationship manager assignment). Includes counterparty-specific commercial and logistics preferences that drive tailored account management. Primary anchor entity for the customer domain in mining commodity sales.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commodity buyer, offtake counterparty, or trading partner. Primary key for the counterparty master record.

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.business_unit. Business justification: Mining companies assign counterparties to business units (e.g., Iron Ore BU, Copper BU) for commercial P&L reporting, relationship ownership, and sales volume tracking by commodity division. A mining

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Revenue recognition, tax reporting, and intercompany accounting in mining require knowing which legal entity (e.g., Australian subsidiary vs. Singapore trading entity) owns the counterparty relationsh

attributes.name: parent_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent or ultimate holding company if this counterparty is part of a corporate group. Enables consolidated credit management and group-level reporting.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_term. Business justification: counterparty has a payment_terms_days INT field representing the default payment terms for the counterparty. The payment_term table is the authoritative reference for payment term definitions. Normali

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Revenue attribution and segment profitability reporting require linking customers to profit centres. Mining companies must track which customers drive profit centre performance for strategic account m

attributes.name: abn
attributes.description: 11-digit Australian Business Number issued by the Australian Taxation Office for entities registered in Australia.

attributes.name: acn
attributes.description: 9-digit Australian Company Number issued by ASIC to companies registered under the Corporations Act 2001.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Business classification of the counterparty based on their primary industry and role in the commodity supply chain. Determines applicable commercial terms and risk profiles.

attributes.name: communication_language
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code representing the counterparty's preferred language for contracts, invoices, and commercial correspondence.

attributes.name: counterparty_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the counterparty relationship. Active counterparties are eligible for new transactions; suspended or blacklisted counterparties are restricted.

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the jurisdiction where the counterparty is legally incorporated or registered.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the counterparty master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum credit exposure limit approved for the counterparty, expressed in United States Dollars. Governs the total value of outstanding receivables and open orders.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Current credit rating assigned to the counterparty by the specified rating agency. Influences credit limits, payment terms, and security requirements.

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the credit rating agency that issued the counterparty's credit rating. Used for credit risk assessment and exposure management.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: 9-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for global business entity identification and credit assessment.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the counterparty relationship became active and eligible for commodity transactions. Marks the start of the commercial relationship lifecycle.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date when the counterparty relationship was terminated or suspended. Null for active relationships. Used for historical analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: incoterm_preference
attributes.description: Preferred Incoterm for commodity sales contracts. FOB (Free on Board) and CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight) are most common in mining. Defines responsibility for freight, insurance, and risk transfer.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for delivering invoices to the counterparty. EDI and portal integrations enable automated accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: is_sanctioned_entity
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the counterparty appears on any international sanctions lists (OFAC, UN, EU). True indicates the entity is sanctioned and transactions are prohibited.

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent KYC due diligence process was successfully completed. Used to track KYC refresh requirements.

attributes.name: kyc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current KYC certification expires and requires renewal. Typically 12-24 months from completion date depending on risk classification.

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Know Your Customer due diligence process. Completed KYC is mandatory before executing commodity sales contracts.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the counterparty master record was most recently updated. Tracks data currency and supports change data capture processes.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the counterparty as it appears on incorporation documents and contracts. Used for legal agreements and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: 20-character alphanumeric Legal Entity Identifier code used for financial transaction reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: preferred_commodity_grades
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of preferred mineral grades or product specifications that the counterparty typically purchases. Examples: 62% Fe iron ore fines, 99.99% copper cathode, premium coking coal.

attributes.name: preferred_discharge_ports
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of preferred destination ports where the counterparty receives commodity deliveries. Aligns with their processing facilities and distribution networks.

attributes.name: preferred_loading_ports
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of preferred mine or port loading locations for commodity shipments. Reflects counterparty's logistics network and freight optimization preferences.

attributes.name: preferred_vessel_size_dwt
attributes.description: Preferred shipping vessel size category for bulk commodity deliveries, based on port infrastructure and logistics capabilities. Influences freight terms and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for commercial communications with the counterparty. Used for contract correspondence, invoices, and operational notifications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the counterparty, including country code. Used for urgent commercial and operational communications.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the official registered address of the counterparty as recorded with the incorporation authority.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the official registered address, typically containing building, suite, or floor information.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City or locality component of the counterparty's registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the country component of the counterparty's registered address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code component of the counterparty's registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region component of the counterparty's registered address.

attributes.name: reporting_format_preference
attributes.description: Preferred format for delivery of commercial reports, certificates of analysis, and shipping documentation. Supports integration with counterparty's procurement systems.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number or VAT registration number issued by the counterparty's tax authority. Required for tax reporting and withholding compliance.

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: Commercial trading name or brand name used by the counterparty in day-to-day business operations. May differ from legal name.

products.name: counterparty_contact
products.description: Individual contact persons associated with a counterparty organisation, including commercial representatives, technical liaisons, logistics coordinators, and finance contacts. Tracks name, role, department, communication preferences, and active status for each contact at a buyer or trading partner entity.

attributes.name: counterparty_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the counterparty contact person. Primary key for the counterparty contact entity.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent counterparty organisation (customer, offtake partner, trading entity) to which this contact belongs.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact person by their primary functional role within the counterparty organisation.

attributes.name: counterparty_contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact person within the counterparty relationship. Active contacts are available for business communications; inactive contacts have left the organisation or role.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contact record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_approval_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact person has authority to approve credit terms, payment schedules, or financial arrangements.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organisational department or division to which the contact person belongs (e.g., Procurement, Trading, Operations, Finance).

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this contact person became active in their role with the counterparty organisation.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact person ceased to be active in their role, if applicable. Null for currently active contacts.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the contact person. Used for commercial correspondence, contract negotiations, and operational communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, RFC 5322 Internet Message Format

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Facsimile number for the contact person, if applicable for formal document transmission.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the contact person.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Complete name of the contact person as it should appear in formal correspondence and documentation.

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact person has authority to make binding commercial decisions on behalf of the counterparty organisation.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact person is the primary or main point of contact for the counterparty organisation.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official position or role title of the contact person within their organisation.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent business communication or interaction with this contact person.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who most recently modified this contact record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contact record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the contact person.

attributes.name: logistics_coordinator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact person coordinates shipping, delivery schedules, and logistics arrangements.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the contact person, if applicable.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile or cellular telephone number for the contact person, used for urgent communications and field coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording additional information about the contact person, including communication preferences, relationship history, or special considerations.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business telephone number for the contact person, including country and area codes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: preferred_communication_method
attributes.description: The contact person's preferred channel for business communications and correspondence.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code representing the contact person's preferred language for business communications (e.g., EN, ZH, ES, PT, JA).

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal title or honorific used when addressing the contact person.

attributes.name: signing_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact person has legal authority to sign contracts, purchase orders, or other binding commercial documents.

attributes.name: technical_liaison
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact person serves as the technical liaison for product specifications, quality requirements, and technical compliance matters.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the contact person's primary business location, used for scheduling meetings and coordinating communications across global operations.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this contact record.

products.name: delivery_destination
products.description: Master register of all approved delivery destinations for commodity shipments, including port terminals, smelter intake points, power station stockyards, and warehouse locations. Captures destination name, port code, country, Incoterms applicability (FOB, CIF, CFR), berth specifications, draft restrictions, and logistics constraints relevant to iron ore, coal, copper concentrate, and lithium product deliveries.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Ship-To Party / Delivery Address

attributes.name: delivery_destination_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery destination record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Delivery destinations (ports, customer facilities) incur specific logistics costs (stevedoring, demurrage, handling) that must be allocated to cost centres for accurate delivered cost calculation, AIS

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the customer entity that owns or operates this delivery destination.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Mining operations track which vendors operate/own discharge ports and loading facilities for inbound materials (explosives, fuel, consumables). Required for vendor performance tracking by location, fr

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address or location descriptor for the delivery destination facility.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building, terminal, or berth number.

attributes.name: berth_name
attributes.description: Specific berth or wharf name within the port terminal where vessels dock for loading or unloading. Null for non-maritime destinations.

attributes.name: berth_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric identifier for the specific berth position. Null for non-maritime destinations.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the delivery destination is located.

attributes.name: commodity_types_accepted
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of commodity types that this destination is approved to receive (e.g., iron_ore, coal, copper_concentrate, lithium_spodumene, nickel_ore). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron_ore|coal|copper_concentrate|lithium_spodumene|lithium_hydroxide|nickel_ore|bauxite|manganese — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: conveyor_system_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination has conveyor belt infrastructure for direct commodity transfer.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the delivery destination is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery destination record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether customs clearance services are available at this destination for international shipments.

attributes.name: delivery_destination_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the delivery destination indicating whether it is available for commodity shipments.

attributes.name: destination_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the delivery destination, typically a port code, terminal code, or facility identifier used in shipping documentation and logistics systems.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: destination_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the delivery destination (e.g., Port of Qingdao Terminal 3, Rio Tinto Smelter Intake Point, Baosteel Stockyard).

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery destination based on facility type and operational purpose.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this delivery destination became active and approved for commodity shipments.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this delivery destination remains active. Null for indefinite destinations.

attributes.name: environmental_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any environmental restrictions, dust control requirements, or operational constraints applicable to this destination.

attributes.name: incoterms_applicable
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) applicable to this destination (e.g., FOB, CIF, CFR, DAP, DDP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|CFR|DAP|DDP|EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAT|DPU — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery destination record was last updated.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the delivery destination in decimal degrees for logistics planning and vessel routing.

attributes.name: loading_rate_tph
attributes.description: Typical or maximum loading rate in tonnes per hour for commodity discharge or loading operations at this destination.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the delivery destination in decimal degrees for logistics planning and vessel routing.

attributes.name: maximum_vessel_beam_m
attributes.description: Maximum vessel beam (width) in meters that the berth can accommodate.

attributes.name: maximum_vessel_draft_m
attributes.description: Maximum allowable vessel draft in meters that the berth or port can accommodate, critical for vessel selection and cargo planning.

attributes.name: maximum_vessel_loa_m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Vessel Length Overall (LOA) in Meters
attributes.description: Maximum vessel length overall (LOA) in meters that the berth can accommodate.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or logistics constraints specific to this destination.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours or schedule for the destination (e.g., 24/7, business_hours_only, daylight_only).

attributes.name: port_code
attributes.description: Five-letter UN/LOCODE port identifier for maritime destinations (e.g., CNQIN for Qingdao, AUHED for Port Hedland). Null for non-port destinations.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the delivery destination address.

attributes.name: rail_access_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination has direct rail access for commodity delivery.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Geographic region or state/province where the destination is located (e.g., Western Australia, Shandong Province, Queensland).

attributes.name: road_access_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination has road access for truck-based commodity delivery.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_tonnes
attributes.description: Total storage or stockpile capacity in tonnes available at the destination for commodity inventory.

products.name: credit_limit
products.description: Manages approved credit exposure limits and payment terms assigned to each counterparty, including total credit limit amount, currency, effective/expiry dates, credit rating basis, collateral arrangements (parent company guarantees, standby LCs), approval authority, payment days from B/L date, payment method (TT, LC, documentary collection), discount terms, and late payment penalties. Tracks real-time utilisation against limit and supports credit risk management for commodity trading and offtake agreements. Aligned with SAP S/4HANA credit management module.

attributes.name: credit_limit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit limit record. Primary key for the credit limit entity.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commodity buyer, offtake counterparty, or trading partner to whom this credit limit is assigned. Links to the customer master data.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Credit limits in mining are granted by a specific legal entity — the entity whose balance sheet carries the credit exposure. Consolidated credit risk reporting, IFRS 9 expected credit loss calculation

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_term. Business justification: credit_limit contains payment_terms_days, discount_days, discount_percentage, late_payment_penalty_rate, and payment_method — all of which are fully defined in the payment_term reference table (paymen

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the individual, committee, or governance body that approved this credit limit. Examples include Chief Financial Officer (CFO), Credit Committee, Board of Directors, or Regional Credit Manager. Provides audit trail for credit limit authorization.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit limit was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Establishes the authorization date for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: available_credit
attributes.description: Remaining credit capacity available for new transactions. Calculated as limit_amount minus utilisation_amount. Negative values indicate over-limit exposure requiring management intervention.

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Value of the collateral or credit enhancement securing this credit limit. Typically expressed in the same currency as the credit limit. For parent guarantees this may be the guaranteed amount, for standby LCs this is the LC face value.

attributes.name: collateral_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the collateral instrument securing this credit limit. For standby LCs this is the LC number, for guarantees this is the guarantee reference, for cash deposits this is the deposit account reference.

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of credit enhancement or collateral arrangement securing the credit limit. Parent guarantees are common for subsidiary buyers, standby letters of credit (LC) provide bank-backed security, cash deposits are held as security, bank guarantees are issued by financial institutions, insurance bonds are provided by credit insurers, and asset pledges involve physical or financial assets as security. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|parent_guarantee|standby_lc|cash_deposit|bank_guarantee|insurance_bond|asset_pledge — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this credit limit record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: credit_limit_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the credit limit agreement. Externally visible reference number used in credit management communications and approvals.

attributes.name: credit_limit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit limit. Draft limits are being prepared, pending approval limits await credit committee authorization, active limits are in force, suspended limits are temporarily blocked due to payment issues or risk concerns, expired limits have passed their validity date, cancelled limits have been terminated, and under review limits are being reassessed due to changed circumstances. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|expired|cancelled|under_review — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: credit_limit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit limit based on its purpose and duration. Master limits are ongoing, temporary limits are short-term extensions, project-specific limits are tied to individual mining projects or shipments, seasonal limits accommodate cyclical demand, spot trade limits cover one-off transactions, and offtake agreement limits are tied to long-term supply contracts.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External or internal credit rating assigned to the counterparty that forms the basis for the credit limit determination. Ratings follow standard agency notation (AAA highest, D default, NR not rated). May be sourced from agencies like Moody's, S&P, Fitch, or internal credit risk models. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D|NR — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the credit rating agency or internal risk assessment team that provided the credit rating. Examples include Moody's, Standard & Poor's, Fitch Ratings, or Internal Credit Risk Committee.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the credit limit is denominated. Common currencies for mining commodity trading include USD, EUR, CNY, JPY, and AUD.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the credit limit becomes active and enforceable. Shipments and invoices on or after this date are subject to this credit limit.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit limit ceases to be valid. Nullable for open-ended master limits that remain in force until explicitly revised or cancelled.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the credit limit covered by credit insurance. Typically ranges from 80% to 95%, with the mining company retaining a deductible or co-insurance portion to align incentives for credit risk management.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the credit insurance policy covering this counterparty exposure, if applicable. Credit insurance protects against non-payment risk and is common for high-value or high-risk commodity trading relationships.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of this credit limit. Updated each time the credit limit undergoes scheduled or ad-hoc reassessment by the credit risk team.

attributes.name: limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure amount that the counterparty is authorized to utilize. Represents the total outstanding receivables (invoiced but unpaid) that the customer may accumulate before further shipments are blocked.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this credit limit record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute of the credit limit is changed, supporting change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this credit limit. Calculated based on the last review date plus the review frequency. Triggers workflow notifications to credit risk analysts.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or commentary related to this credit limit. May include details on negotiation history, special approval conditions, temporary adjustments, or risk mitigation measures.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between scheduled reviews of this credit limit. High-risk counterparties may be reviewed quarterly (3 months), standard counterparties semi-annually (6 months), and low-risk counterparties annually (12 months). Ensures credit limits remain aligned with counterparty creditworthiness.

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Internal risk category assigned to the counterparty based on credit assessment, payment history, financial health, and market conditions. Low risk counterparties have strong financials and payment track record, medium risk have acceptable credit profiles, high risk require enhanced monitoring, watch list indicates deteriorating conditions, and default indicates payment failure or insolvency.

attributes.name: utilisation_amount
attributes.description: Current outstanding receivables balance against this credit limit. Calculated in real-time as the sum of all unpaid invoices and open deliveries. When utilisation approaches or exceeds the limit amount, shipment blocks are triggered.

products.name: credit_review
products.description: Records periodic and event-driven credit reviews conducted for counterparties, capturing review date, reviewer, credit rating assigned, financial analysis inputs (leverage ratios, liquidity), external agency ratings (Moody's, S&P), recommended limit changes, and approval outcome. Provides an audit trail of credit decisions supporting IFRS and internal risk governance.

attributes.name: credit_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit review record. Primary key.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the counterparty (steel mill, smelter, energy company, commodity trader) being reviewed.

attributes.name: credit_limit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.credit_limit. Business justification: A credit review is conducted against a specific credit limit record. The credit_review table captures approved_credit_limit_usd, recommended_credit_limit_usd, and current_credit_limit_usd — all of whi

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_term. Business justification: credit_review has a payment_terms STRING field capturing the payment terms recommended or approved during the review. Normalizing this to a FK against the payment_term reference table ensures consiste

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit review was formally approved by the credit committee or authorized approver.

attributes.name: approval_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or conditions recorded by the credit committee or approver at the time of approval, including any modifications to the recommendation or special conditions.

attributes.name: approval_outcome
attributes.description: The final decision by the credit committee: approved as recommended (no changes), approved with modifications (limit or terms adjusted), rejected (recommendation not accepted), or deferred (requires additional information).

attributes.name: approved_credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: The final approved credit limit for this counterparty in United States Dollars (USD) following credit committee approval. This becomes the new active limit upon approval.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the credit committee member or senior risk officer who approved the review outcome.

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether collateral or security is required for transactions with this counterparty (True) or not (False), based on the credit review outcome.

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: The type of collateral or security required if collateral_required_flag is True: letter of credit, bank guarantee, parent company guarantee, cash deposit, none, or other.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credit review record was first created in the system, for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: current_credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: The existing approved credit limit for this counterparty in United States Dollars (USD), representing the maximum exposure the company is willing to accept prior to this review.

attributes.name: current_ratio
attributes.description: The counterparty's current assets divided by current liabilities, a liquidity metric indicating short-term financial health.

attributes.name: external_credit_rating
attributes.description: The credit rating assigned by the external rating agency (e.g., Aaa, Baa2 for Moody's; AAA, BBB+ for S&P/Fitch). Free text to accommodate different agency scales.
attributes.references: Basel III Standardised Approach for Credit Risk

attributes.name: external_rating_agency
attributes.description: The primary external credit rating agency whose rating is referenced in this review (Moody's, Standard & Poor's, Fitch, DBRS, Japan Credit Rating, or Other).
attributes.references: Basel III Standardised Approach for Credit Risk

attributes.name: external_rating_date
attributes.description: The date on which the external credit rating was issued or last updated by the rating agency.
attributes.references: Basel III Standardised Approach for Credit Risk

attributes.name: financial_statement_date
attributes.description: The as-of date of the counterparty's financial statements used as the basis for the financial analysis in this credit review.

attributes.name: interest_coverage_ratio
attributes.description: The counterparty's EBIT (Earnings Before Interest and Tax) divided by interest expense, indicating ability to service debt obligations.

attributes.name: internal_credit_rating
attributes.description: The internal credit rating assigned to the counterparty by the mining company's credit risk team, using a scale aligned with external agency methodologies (AAA highest quality, D default). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: internal_rating_outlook
attributes.description: The outlook for the internal credit rating: positive (potential upgrade), stable (no change expected), negative (potential downgrade), developing (uncertain direction).

attributes.name: leverage_ratio
attributes.description: The counterparty's total debt to equity ratio or net debt to EBITDA ratio, a key financial metric analyzed during the credit review to assess financial risk.

attributes.name: limit_change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for any recommended change to the credit limit, including references to financial performance, market conditions, or strategic relationship considerations.

attributes.name: loss_given_default_pct
attributes.description: The estimated loss severity in the event of default, expressed as a percentage of exposure at default (0.00 to 100.00), used for IFRS 9 ECL calculation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credit review record was last modified in the system, for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic credit review of this counterparty, typically 12 months from current review for investment grade, 6 months for sub-investment grade.

attributes.name: probability_of_default_pct
attributes.description: The estimated probability of default over a 12-month horizon, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00), used for IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) calculation.

attributes.name: recommended_credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: The credit limit recommended by the credit analyst based on this review, in United States Dollars (USD). May be higher, lower, or equal to the current limit.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit review was conducted or completed. Principal business event timestamp for this review.

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the credit review, typically formatted as CR-YYYYNNNNNN for external reference and audit trail.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit review: draft (initial preparation), in_progress (under analysis), pending_approval (submitted to credit committee), approved (finalized and active), rejected (not accepted), superseded (replaced by newer review).

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the review trigger: periodic (scheduled), event-driven (material change in counterparty financials), ad-hoc (management request), annual (mandatory yearly), pre-contract (new customer onboarding), limit increase (customer requests higher exposure), or downgrade trigger (external rating agency downgrade). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: periodic|event_driven|ad_hoc|annual|pre_contract|limit_increase|downgrade_trigger — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the credit analyst or risk officer who conducted the review.

attributes.name: risk_commentary
attributes.description: Detailed qualitative assessment of the counterparty's credit risk, including analysis of financial position, industry outlook, management quality, and any material risk factors identified during the review.

products.name: segment
products.description: Classification of counterparties into commercial segments for strategic account management, pricing strategy, and relationship prioritisation. Segments include tier classifications (Tier 1 strategic, Tier 2 preferred, Tier 3 spot), end-use industry (steel, energy, battery materials, smelting), geographic region, and volume band. Enables differentiated commercial treatment and portfolio analysis.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer segment classification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Customer segments in mining are defined by commodity (e.g., 'Iron Ore Tier 1', 'Copper Mid-Market'). Segment reporting, pricing strategy, and relationship management decisions are all commodity-driven

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer entity being classified into this segment. Links to the customer master data.

attributes.name: annual_volume_maximum_tonnes
attributes.description: Maximum annual offtake volume in metric tonnes that defines the upper bound of this segments volume band. Null indicates no upper limit.

attributes.name: annual_volume_minimum_tonnes
attributes.description: Minimum annual offtake volume in metric tonnes that defines the lower bound of this segments volume band.

attributes.name: contract_type_preference
attributes.description: Typical contract structure preference for customers in this segment. Long-Term Offtake for multi-year commitments, Annual Framework for yearly agreements, Quarterly for short-term contracts, Spot for transactional purchases, Mixed for diversified approach.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the customers primary country of operation or delivery destination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customer segment classification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_risk_rating
attributes.description: Internal credit risk assessment rating for this customer segment. AAA represents lowest risk, D represents default or highest risk. Used for credit limit determination and commercial terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: diversification_target_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this customer segment is targeted for portfolio diversification efforts to reduce concentration risk. True indicates diversification target.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this customer segment classification becomes effective and applicable for commercial treatment and reporting.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this customer segment classification remains effective. Null indicates the segment is currently active with no defined end date.

attributes.name: end_use_industry
attributes.description: Primary industry sector in which the customer operates and consumes the mineral commodities. Critical for understanding demand drivers and market positioning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Steel|Energy|Battery Materials|Smelting|Manufacturing|Construction|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region where the customer operates or takes delivery. Used for regional portfolio analysis and logistics planning.

attributes.name: incoterm_preference
attributes.description: Preferred Incoterms delivery basis for this customer segment. FOB (Free on Board) for port delivery, CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight) for delivered pricing, CFR (Cost and Freight), DAP (Delivered at Place), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), EXW (Ex Works) for mine gate pickup.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this customer segment classification record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customer segment classification record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this customer segment classification was last reviewed and validated by the commercial team.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this customer segment classification.

attributes.name: payment_terms_category
attributes.description: Standard payment terms category applicable to this customer segment. Defines credit period and payment security requirements.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: Commercial pricing approach applied to this customer segment. Premium for strategic long-term partners, Standard for preferred customers, Competitive for market-rate buyers, Spot Market for transactional pricing, and Negotiated for bespoke arrangements.

attributes.name: quality_specification_tier
attributes.description: Product quality specification tier typically required by customers in this segment. Premium Grade for highest purity/lowest impurities, Standard Grade for typical commercial specifications, Commercial Grade for broader tolerance ranges, Spot Grade for variable quality spot market material.

attributes.name: relationship_manager
attributes.description: Name of the commercial relationship manager or account executive responsible for managing customers in this segment.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between scheduled reviews of this customer segment classification. Typically 6 or 12 months for strategic segments, longer for stable spot segments.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the segment classification for system processing and reporting.

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the customer segment, including defining characteristics, strategic rationale, and commercial treatment guidelines.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the customer segment classification.

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this customer segment classification. Active indicates current use, Under Review for segments being reassessed, Suspended for temporarily inactive segments, Archived for historical segments no longer in use.

attributes.name: service_level_tier
attributes.description: Service level commitment tier for this customer segment. Platinum receives highest priority for supply allocation, logistics coordination, and technical support. Standard receives baseline service.

attributes.name: strategic_priority_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this customer segment is designated as a strategic priority for business development and relationship investment. True indicates strategic priority status.

attributes.name: tier_classification
attributes.description: Strategic tier classification indicating the commercial importance and relationship depth. Tier 1 Strategic represents highest-value long-term partnerships, Tier 2 Preferred for regular preferred customers, Tier 3 Spot for transactional buyers, and Tier 4 Inactive for dormant relationships.

attributes.name: volume_band
attributes.description: Classification of customer based on annual offtake volume ranges. Very High represents multi-million tonne buyers, High for significant volume, Medium for regular buyers, Low for small-scale, and Minimal for occasional spot purchases.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this customer segment classification record.

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Master record of counterparty bank account details used for payment processing, letter of credit (LC) issuance, and financial settlement of commodity sales. Captures bank name, SWIFT/BIC code, IBAN or account number, currency, country, account holder name, and verification status. Supports secure payment routing for FOB and CIF commodity transactions.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank account record. Primary key.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or counterparty who owns this bank account. Links to steel mills, smelters, energy companies, commodity traders, and other offtake partners.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the account holder as registered with the bank. Must match customer legal name for payment reconciliation and anti-money laundering compliance.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The bank account number used for payment processing and financial settlement. May be domestic account number or IBAN depending on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the bank account record. Only active accounts can be used for payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) Master Data Standards

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account type. Corporate and current accounts are most common for commodity trading settlements.

attributes.name: bank_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the bank branch physical address. Required for letter of credit documentation and compliance verification.

attributes.name: bank_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the bank branch physical address for additional location details.

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific bank branch where the account is held.

attributes.name: bank_city
attributes.description: City where the bank branch is located.

attributes.name: bank_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the bank location. Critical for compliance with international trade finance regulations and sanctions screening.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the financial institution holding the account.

attributes.name: bank_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the bank branch address.

attributes.name: bank_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the bank branch location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the account. Common currencies include USD, EUR, CNY, JPY for commodity sales settlements.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this bank account becomes valid for payment processing. Supports time-bound account changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) Master Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this bank account remains valid. Null indicates no expiration. Used for account closure or replacement scenarios.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) Master Data Standards

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number for cross-border payments. Used primarily for European and international commodity transactions under CIF and FOB terms.

attributes.name: intermediary_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of intermediary or correspondent bank used for routing international payments when direct settlement is not available.

attributes.name: intermediary_swift_bic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intermediary Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Business Identifier Code (BIC)
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC code of the intermediary bank for multi-hop international wire transfers.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary bank account for the customer. Used as default for payment routing in ERP systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) Master Data Standards

attributes.name: is_sanctions_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bank and account holder have been screened against international sanctions lists (OFAC, UN, EU). Mandatory for international commodity trading compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this bank account record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this bank account record. Critical for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: payment_method_supported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Method Supported [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wire_transfer|ach|sepa|rtgs|swift|letter_of_credit|documentary_collection|telegraphic_transfer — promote to reference product]
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of payment methods supported by this account. Critical for FOB and CIF transaction settlement routing.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Domestic routing number for bank transfers. Format varies by country (ABA routing number in USA, sort code in UK, BSB in Australia).

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Date of most recent sanctions screening. Must be refreshed periodically per compliance policy.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special payment routing instructions, reference codes, or beneficiary notifications required by the customer or bank.

attributes.name: swift_bic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Business Identifier Code (BIC)
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC code identifying the bank and branch for international wire transfers and letter of credit processing in commodity sales.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the bank account was successfully verified. Required for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the bank account authenticity and ownership.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of bank account verification process. Verified accounts have passed validation checks including test deposits or third-party verification services.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this bank account record.

products.name: payment_term
products.description: Reference data defining the payment terms applicable to counterparties and offtake agreements, including payment days (e.g., 30 days from B/L date), payment method (telegraphic transfer, letter of credit, documentary collection), currency, discount terms, and late payment penalty rates. Provides standardised payment term codes referenced across offtake agreements and invoicing.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment term record. Primary key.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Payment terms in mining are defined per legal entity because different entities operate under different jurisdictions with distinct payment norms, statutory payment period requirements, and AR managem

attributes.name: applicable_commodity_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of commodity types to which this payment term applies (e.g., iron_ore, copper_concentrate, coal, lithium, nickel). Null if applicable to all commodities.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Organizational authority level required to approve the use of this payment term in a new offtake agreement. Higher-risk terms (e.g., extended payment days, open account) require senior approval.

attributes.name: bank_guarantee_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a bank guarantee or performance bond is required from the counterparty when this payment term is used. True if guarantee is mandatory.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Internal Audit and Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: credit_insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether credit insurance or trade finance insurance must be in place for transactions using this payment term. True if insurance is mandatory.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which payment must be made (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY, AUD). Most mining commodity contracts are denominated in USD.

attributes.name: discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the payment basis date within which early payment qualifies for a discount (e.g., 10 days in a 2/10 Net 30 term). Null if no early payment discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the invoice amount if payment is made within the discount days period (e.g., 2.00 for a 2% discount). Null if no discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: documentary_requirements
attributes.description: List of documents required to be presented for payment under this term (e.g., Bill of Lading, Commercial Invoice, Certificate of Origin, Quality Certificate, Weight Certificate). Particularly relevant for LC and documentary collection terms.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this payment term becomes valid and available for use in offtake agreements and invoicing. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this payment term remains valid. Null for open-ended terms. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the payment due date before late payment penalties are applied. Provides a buffer period for payment processing delays. Null if no grace period applies.

attributes.name: installment_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment may be made in multiple installments rather than a single lump sum. True if installment payments are permitted under this term.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: installment_count
attributes.description: Number of installments into which payment may be divided if installment_allowed_flag is true. Null if installments are not allowed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this payment term record.
attributes.references: Internal Audit and Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Internal Audit and Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate (percentage) applied to overdue amounts for late payment. Typically expressed as a percentage per annum (e.g., 8.00 for 8% p.a.). Null if no penalty applies.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy, Offtake Agreement Terms

attributes.name: letter_of_credit_type
attributes.description: Specific type of Letter of Credit if payment_method is letter_of_credit. Irrevocable and confirmed LCs are preferred for high-value commodity transactions. Null if payment method is not LC. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: irrevocable|revocable|confirmed|unconfirmed|sight|deferred|transferable|standby — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: maximum_transaction_value
attributes.description: Maximum invoice or shipment value (in the currency specified by currency_code) for which this payment term may be applied without additional credit approval. Null if no maximum applies.

attributes.name: minimum_transaction_value
attributes.description: Minimum invoice or shipment value (in the currency specified by currency_code) for which this payment term may be applied. Used to enforce stricter terms for smaller transactions. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or exceptions applicable to this payment term. May include references to specific customer segments or regional requirements.

attributes.name: payment_basis
attributes.description: The reference event from which payment days are calculated. Common bases in mining commodity sales include Bill of Lading (B/L) date for FOB (Free on Board) terms and delivery date for CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight) terms.

attributes.name: payment_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the reference event (e.g., Bill of Lading date, invoice date, shipment date) until payment is due. Standard terms in mining include 30, 60, 90, or 120 days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism by which payment is executed. Telegraphic Transfer (TT) and Letter of Credit (LC) are most common in international commodity trading. Documentary Collection (D/C) used for established relationships.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits), SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: payment_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this payment term for cash flow planning and treasury operations. High priority terms (e.g., cash in advance, short-dated LCs) receive expedited processing.

attributes.name: payment_term_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code identifying the payment term (e.g., NET30, NET60, LC90, COD). Used as the business key across offtake agreements and invoicing systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: payment_term_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the payment term including conditions, calculation basis, and any special clauses applicable to commodity trading.

attributes.name: payment_term_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the payment term (e.g., Net 30 Days from Bill of Lading Date, 90 Days Letter of Credit).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: payment_term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment term. Active terms are available for use in new agreements. Deprecated terms are retained for historical reference but not available for new contracts.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Credit and counterparty risk rating associated with this payment term. Cash in advance and confirmed LCs are low risk; extended open account terms are high risk.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this payment term record in the system.
attributes.references: Internal Audit and Data Governance Standard

products.name: letter_of_credit
products.description: Manages letters of credit (LC) issued by buyers as payment security for commodity shipments, capturing LC number, issuing bank, advising bank, LC amount, currency, expiry date, shipment period, document requirements (bill of lading, certificate of origin, assay certificate), amendment history, and utilisation status. Critical for managing payment risk in international commodity trade.

attributes.name: letter_of_credit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the letter of credit record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Mining LCs are issued for specific commodity shipments (iron ore, copper, coal). Trade finance reporting, LC issuance workflows, and regulatory compliance all require structured commodity identificati

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commodity buyer or offtake counterparty who arranged this letter of credit as payment security.

attributes.name: issuing_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.bank_account. Business justification: Letters of credit are issued by the buyer's bank against a specific bank account. The counterparty (buyer) has one or more bank accounts registered in the bank_account table. Linking the LC to the spe

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Letters of credit in mining trade finance are issued in favour of a specific legal entity (the beneficiary/seller). The legal entity determines which entity's banking facilities are used, which books

attributes.name: loading_port_delivery_destination_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Loading Port Delivery Destination Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.delivery_destination. Business justification: Letters of credit specify loading and discharge ports for commodity shipments. Currently stored as text fields, these should reference delivery_destination master data. Loading port is the origin port

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.payment_term. Business justification: letter_of_credit has a payment_terms STRING field. An LC is issued under specific payment terms (e.g., at sight, 90 days after bill of lading). Linking to the payment_term reference table normalizes t

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Mining regulators require letters of credit as security bonds (rehabilitation bonds, expenditure security) tied to specific tenements. Treasury and compliance teams must link each LC to the tenement i

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Mining operations issue LCs to vendors for high-value procurement: capital equipment purchases, bulk explosives, long-lead mining equipment, imported consumables. Required for procurement payment secu

attributes.name: advising_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution that advises or confirms the letter of credit to the beneficiary (seller).
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: advising_bank_swift_code
attributes.description: SWIFT/BIC code of the advising bank for international payment routing.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of amendments that have been made to this letter of credit since its original issuance.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: applicant_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the applicant (the buyer or importer) who requested the issuing bank to open this letter of credit.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: available_amount
attributes.description: Remaining monetary amount available for drawing under this letter of credit (LC amount minus utilised amount).
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the beneficiary (the mining company or seller) entitled to draw payment under this letter of credit.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this letter of credit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the letter of credit amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: discharge_port
attributes.description: Name of the destination port or location where the commodity shipment must be discharged as specified in the letter of credit.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: document_requirements
attributes.description: Comprehensive list of documents required for presentation to the bank to draw payment under this letter of credit (e.g., bill of lading, commercial invoice, certificate of origin, assay certificate, packing list, insurance certificate).
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the letter of credit expires and can no longer be drawn upon by the beneficiary.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: governing_rules
attributes.description: International rules and practices governing this letter of credit (e.g., UCP 600, ISP98 for standby letters of credit, eUCP for electronic presentation).

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the delivery terms and risk transfer point for the commodity shipment (e.g., FOB, CIF, CFR). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the letter of credit was issued by the issuing bank.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: issuing_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution that issued the letter of credit on behalf of the buyer.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: issuing_bank_swift_code
attributes.description: SWIFT/BIC code of the issuing bank for international payment routing.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment made to this letter of credit.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: latest_shipment_date
attributes.description: The last permissible date by which the commodity shipment must be dispatched as stipulated in the letter of credit terms.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: lc_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the letter of credit available for drawing by the beneficiary.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: lc_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned by the issuing bank to this letter of credit instrument.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: lc_type
attributes.description: Classification of the letter of credit instrument based on its terms and conditions (irrevocable, revocable, confirmed, unconfirmed, transferable, standby).

attributes.name: letter_of_credit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the letter of credit (draft, active, partially utilised, fully utilised, expired, cancelled).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this letter of credit record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: partial_shipment_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether partial shipments of the commodity are permitted under the terms of this letter of credit.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms specified in the letter of credit defining when payment is due (sight payment, deferred payment, usance, acceptance).

attributes.name: presentation_period_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days after the shipment date within which documents must be presented to the bank for payment.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the commodity to be shipped under this letter of credit.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the commodity quantity (e.g., MT for metric tonnes, DMT for dry metric tonnes, WMT for wet metric tonnes).

attributes.name: shipment_period_from
attributes.description: Start date of the permissible shipment period window specified in the letter of credit.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: shipment_period_to
attributes.description: End date of the permissible shipment period window specified in the letter of credit.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: tenor_days

products.name: kyc_record
products.description: Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance record for each counterparty, capturing KYC status, verification date, due diligence level (standard, enhanced), sanctions screening result, beneficial ownership documentation, politically exposed person (PEP) flag, anti-money laundering (AML) risk rating, and next review date. Supports regulatory compliance obligations under FATF, OFAC, and applicable national AML legislation for international commodity trading.

attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding the KYC verification process, risk factors, or special considerations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.description: Indicates whether all required KYC documentation has been collected and is complete.

attributes.name: due_diligence_level
attributes.description: Level of customer due diligence applied based on risk assessment: standard for normal risk, enhanced for high-risk counterparties, simplified for low-risk entities.

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: identity_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the identity of the counterparty: document review, in-person verification, electronic verification, or third-party verification service.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic KYC review, determined by the due diligence level and risk rating.

attributes.name: ongoing_monitoring_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty is subject to ongoing transaction monitoring and periodic review as part of continuous KYC compliance.

attributes.name: pep_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the PEP status: domestic PEP, foreign PEP, international organization official, family member of PEP, close associate of PEP, or not applicable.

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty or its beneficial owners are identified as Politically Exposed Persons, requiring enhanced due diligence.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KYC record requires reporting to regulatory authorities due to suspicious activity or high-risk classification.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Frequency in months for periodic KYC reviews based on risk rating: typically 12 months for standard, 6 months for enhanced due diligence.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the AML risk assessment was last performed or updated.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent sanctions screening was performed.
attributes.references: OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control), UN Security Council Sanctions

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_result
attributes.description: Result of screening against international sanctions lists including OFAC, UN, EU, and other jurisdictional sanctions databases.
attributes.references: OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control), UN Security Council Sanctions, EU Sanctions

attributes.name: source_of_funds_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source of funds for the counterparty has been verified as part of enhanced due diligence.

attributes.name: source_of_wealth_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source of wealth for the counterparty has been verified, typically required for high-risk or PEP counterparties.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KYC record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the KYC verification was completed and approved.

attributes.name: tenure_years

Core transactional record driving the order-to-cash lifecycle from commitment through to invoicing. SSOT for all confirmed sales commitments regardless of term or spot origin.

products.name: benchmark_price
products.description: Reference master and daily price repository for commodity benchmark indices used in offtake agreement pricing formulas. Captures both the index definition catalog (index code, index name, publishing agency — Platts, TSI, LME, Fastmarkets — commodity, unit of measure, quotational period convention, active status) and the associated daily/periodic price values (price date, price value, currency). Serves as the single source of truth for all benchmark pricing reference data and price history used in index-linked sales contracts, provisional pricing settlement, and quotational period calculations. Subsumes the price index definition catalog — index metadata and price values are co-located in this product.

attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used by the publishing agency to assess or calculate this benchmark price (e.g., survey-based, transaction-based, bid-offer spread, volume-weighted average). Important for understanding price reliability and contract applicability.

attributes.name: contract_specification
attributes.description: Detailed specification of the underlying contract or assessment criteria, including quality parameters, delivery terms, and any adjustments or premiums/discounts applied by the publishing agency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: delivery_basis
