attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: The geographic location or port associated with the delivery basis (e.g., China, Qingdao Port, Rotterdam, Newcastle). Used in conjunction with delivery_basis to define the pricing point.

attributes.name: index_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this benchmark price index became active and available for use in offtake contracts. Defines the start of the index's lifecycle.

attributes.name: index_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this benchmark price index was discontinued or became inactive. Null for currently active indices.

attributes.name: index_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benchmark price index. Active indices are currently published and used in contracts; Inactive or Discontinued indices are no longer published but historical data is retained.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, commentary, or context provided by the publishing agency regarding this price value or index (e.g., market conditions, supply disruptions, data quality caveats).

attributes.name: price_close
attributes.description: The closing or settlement price value for the price_date, applicable for exchange-traded indices (e.g., LME). Often used as the official settlement price in contracts.

attributes.name: price_date
attributes.description: The date for which this benchmark price value is published. This is the business event date representing the pricing period or assessment date, not the publication timestamp.

attributes.name: price_high
attributes.description: The highest price value published for the price_date, if the publishing agency provides a price range or intraday high. Used for volatility analysis and risk assessment.

attributes.name: price_low
attributes.description: The lowest price value published for the price_date, if the publishing agency provides a price range or intraday low. Used for volatility analysis and risk assessment.

attributes.name: price_open
attributes.description: The opening price value for the price_date, applicable for exchange-traded indices (e.g., LME). Used for intraday price movement analysis.

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: The type of price represented by this index (e.g., Spot - immediate delivery, Forward - future delivery, Futures - exchange-traded contract, Assessment - agency-assessed price, Settlement - official settlement price).

attributes.name: price_value
attributes.description: The published benchmark price value for the given price_date, expressed in the unit_of_measure and currency_code. This is the core pricing data used in provisional pricing calculations and final settlement adjustments.

attributes.name: publication_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently the publishing agency releases new price values for this index (e.g., Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Real-time).

attributes.name: publication_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the publishing agency released this price value. Used to track data freshness and ensure timely price updates for provisional pricing calculations.

attributes.name: quotational_period_convention
attributes.description: The time period convention used for price quotation and settlement in offtake contracts (e.g., Monthly Average of Daily Prices, Spot, Forward Month+1, Forward Month+2, Quarterly Average). Defines how prices are averaged or selected for provisional and final invoicing.

attributes.name: revision_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this price value has been revised or corrected by the publishing agency after initial publication. True if revised, False if original publication.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the publishing agency for why this price value was revised (e.g., data correction, methodology adjustment, late transaction inclusion).

attributes.name: revision_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price value was revised by the publishing agency, if applicable. Null if no revision has occurred.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the benchmark price (e.g., USD/DMT - US Dollars per Dry Metric Tonne, USD/WMT - US Dollars per Wet Metric Tonne, USD/lb - US Dollars per Pound, USD/oz - US Dollars per Troy Ounce).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benchmark price record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: volume_traded
attributes.description: The total volume of commodity traded at this benchmark price on the price_date, if reported by the publishing agency (e.g., for exchange-traded indices). Expressed in the commodity's standard unit (tonnes, pounds, ounces).

products.name: invoice
products.description: Commercial invoice issued to commodity buyers upon shipment or delivery of a cargo, serving as the SSOT for the full pricing lifecycle from provisional through final settlement including all price adjustments. Captures invoice number, buyer reference, commodity, invoiced quantity, provisional price, final benchmark-settled price, adjustment quantity, adjustment value, total invoice value, currency, payment terms, due date, invoice status, quotational period reference, settlement date, and adjustment status. Tracks the complete provisional-to-final price adjustment lifecycle — provisional adjustments are modelled as state transitions within the invoice record, not as separate entities. SSOT for revenue recognition and final settled price.

attributes.name: strategic_importance_level
attributes.description: Internal strategic importance rating of the commodity to the business based on revenue contribution, market position, and long-term value.

attributes.name: trading_currency
attributes.description: The standard currency in which this commodity is priced and traded internationally. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

attributes.name: typical_grade_range
attributes.description: The typical range of mineral grade or purity for this commodity as produced (e.g., 62-65% Fe for iron ore, 25-30% Cu for copper concentrate). Expressed as a text range for flexibility.
attributes.references: JORC Resource Reporting, Internal Quality Standards

attributes.name: typical_recovery_rate_percent
attributes.description: The typical percentage of valuable mineral extracted during processing for this commodity. Used for production planning and resource estimation.

products.name: saleable_product
products.description: Each distinct saleable mineral product variant within a commodity, representing a unique commercial product with its own market identity. Examples: iron ore fines (62% Fe), iron ore lump (62.5% Fe), copper concentrate (25% Cu), thermal coal (6000 kcal NAR), lithium hydroxide monohydrate (battery grade), nickel matte (70% Ni). Captures product code, product form (fines/lump/concentrate/hydroxide/matte/cathode), processing route origin, target market segment, commercial lifecycle status (development, qualified, active, sunset, discontinued), and product availability flags. This is the SSOT for product identity — the entity that sales contracts, shipment nominations, and quality certificates reference. Lifecycle status governs whether the product can be offered commercially.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Material Master / JORC Product Classification

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each distinct saleable mineral product variant. Primary key. This is the system of record identifier that sales contracts, shipment nominations, quality certificates, and pricing schedules reference.

attributes.name: certifying_laboratory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.laboratory. Business justification: Export products require quality certificates from specific accredited laboratories for market access and customer acceptance. Tracks the approved certifying laboratory relationship for regulatory comp

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Establishes the fundamental product hierarchy: each saleable product is a variant of a commodity type (e.g., iron ore fines, lump, pellets are all variants of the iron ore commodity). The existing com

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Mining operations track which cost centre (processing plant, mine site) produces each saleable product for AISC/C1 cost reporting, product profitability analysis, and cost allocation. Essential for ma

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.counterparty. Business justification: Mining companies create customer-specific product grades (e.g., iron ore fines to exact Fe% for a steel mill, coal blends for specific power plants). Enables customer-specific product catalog manageme

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Revenue recognition and inventory valuation require linking products to specific GL accounts (finished goods inventory accounts). Essential for automated inventory postings, month-end close, and IAS 2

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Saleable products are sourced from specific orebodies, establishing product traceability and provenance. Critical for quality variance analysis, customer provenance requirements, mine-to-market chain

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Required for IFRS 8 segment reporting, commodity-level P&L, and product line profitability tracking. Mining companies report financial performance by commodity/product segment; this link enables produ

attributes.name: royalty_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.royalty_obligation. Business justification: Royalty accrual and payment process: each saleable product is subject to specific royalty obligations (state/federal mineral royalties on iron ore, coal, copper). Linking saleable_product to its appli

attributes.name: source_tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Saleable products must be traceable to source tenement for royalty obligations, regulatory compliance, and responsible sourcing certification. Required for statutory production reporting and ESG prove

attributes.name: available_for_sale_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is currently available for inclusion in new sales contracts and shipment nominations. False when product is temporarily unavailable due to plant maintenance, feedstock constraints, or quality holds.

attributes.name: benchmark_index
attributes.description: Name of the published commodity price index or assessment used as the reference for contract pricing. Examples: 'Platts IODEX 62% Fe CFR China', 'LME Nickel 3-month', 'IHS McCloskey Newcastle Coal', 'Fastmarkets MB Lithium Hydroxide CIF Asia'. Empty for products with purely negotiated pricing.
attributes.references: Platts Methodology and Specifications Guide, LME Rulebook

attributes.name: carbon_footprint_kg_co2e_per_tonne
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Footprint Kilograms Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) per Tonne
attributes.description: Estimated greenhouse gas emissions intensity for producing one tonne of this saleable product, expressed as kilograms of CO2 equivalent. Includes Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions from mining, processing, and on-site logistics. Used for customer carbon accounting and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Product Life Cycle Standard, ISO 14067 Carbon Footprint of Products

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the mineral was mined and processed. Required for customs declarations, trade compliance, and country-of-origin certifications. Examples: AUS (Australia), CAN (Canada), CHL (Chile), ZAF (South Africa).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, WCO Harmonized System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this saleable product record was first created in the system. Represents when the product was formally added to the commercial product catalog.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this product definition and specifications are valid and can be referenced in new sales contracts. Supports versioning when product specifications are updated.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this product definition is valid. Null for currently active products. Populated when product is superseded by a new specification version or discontinued. Existing contracts referencing this product remain valid through their term.

attributes.name: environmental_certification
attributes.description: Environmental or sustainability certification(s) held for this product, if any. Examples: 'ResponsibleSteel', 'Copper Mark', 'Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance (IRMA)', 'ISO 14001 Certified Site'. Increasingly required by customers for ESG compliance and supply chain transparency.
attributes.references: ICMM Sustainable Development Framework, GRI Standards

attributes.name: export_license_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an export license or permit is required from the country of origin government to ship this product internationally. True for strategic minerals, rare earths, or products subject to export controls or quotas.

attributes.name: grade_specification
attributes.description: Target grade or concentration of the valuable mineral component expressed as percentage or parts per million. Examples: '62.0% Fe', '25% Cu', '70% Ni', '99.5% LiOH·H2O'. This is the headline specification that drives product pricing and customer acceptance.

attributes.name: hazmat_classification
attributes.description: International hazardous materials classification code if the product is regulated for transport. Examples: UN 3077 (Environmentally Hazardous Substance, Solid), UN 3264 (Corrosive Liquid, Acidic, Inorganic). Empty if product is non-hazardous. Governs shipping documentation, vessel requirements, and emergency response procedures.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods, ADR/RID

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: International Harmonized System tariff classification code used for customs declarations and trade statistics. 6-digit HS code is internationally standardized; additional digits may be country-specific. Examples: 260111 (Iron ore and concentrates, non-agglomerated), 260300 (Copper ores and concentrates), 283691 (Lithium carbonates).
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System

attributes.name: impurity_limits
attributes.description: Specification of maximum allowable concentrations for deleterious impurity elements that negatively impact customer processing or final product quality. Expressed as comma-separated element:limit pairs. Examples: 'P:0.08%, S:0.05%, As:0.01%' for iron ore; 'Hg:1ppm, Cd:5ppm' for copper concentrate. Penalties may apply if limits are exceeded.
attributes.references: ISO 10251 Copper, Lead and Zinc Sulfide Concentrates, JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: incoterm_default
attributes.description: Default Incoterm used for pricing and risk transfer in sales contracts for this product. FOB (Free on Board) and CIF (Cost, Insurance and Freight) are most common for bulk mineral commodities. Defines seller and buyer responsibilities for logistics, insurance, and customs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in calendar days from order confirmation to product availability for shipment. Includes production scheduling, processing, quality testing, and stockpile accumulation time. Does not include shipping transit time.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the product's commercial lifecycle. Development: under testing, not yet offered. Qualified: approved for sale, customer trials ongoing. Active: fully commercialized and available. Sunset: being phased out, existing contracts honored. Discontinued: no longer offered or produced. Governs whether product can be included in new sales contracts.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity_tonnes
attributes.description: Minimum commercial order quantity in metric tonnes. Driven by production batch sizes, shipping economics (vessel parcel sizes), and inventory management. Typical values: 50,000-170,000 tonnes for bulk iron ore/coal shipments, 500-2,000 tonnes for concentrates, 20-100 tonnes for specialty chemicals.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in this saleable product record. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: moisture_content_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable moisture content as percentage of total mass. Critical specification for shipping weight calculations, pricing adjustments, and customer process efficiency. Typical ranges: iron ore 8-10%, coal 10-15%, concentrates 8-12%.
attributes.references: ISO 3087 Iron Ores Determination of Moisture Content, ISO 11722 Coal Sampling

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional product information, special handling instructions, customer preferences, or internal comments not captured in structured fields. Used for operational context and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: packaging_standard
attributes.description: Standard packaging or shipping format for the product. Bulk options for high-volume commodities (iron ore, coal), containerized or bagged options for specialty products (lithium chemicals, precious metal concentrates). Determines logistics costs and handling requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk_vessel|bulk_rail|bulk_truck|ibc_tote|drum|bag_1mt|bag_25kg|container_20ft|container_40ft — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 668 Series 1 Freight Containers, IMDG Code

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the product price is determined in sales contracts. Spot: current market price at time of shipment. Monthly/Quarterly Average: average of published index over period. Annual Contract: negotiated fixed or formula price for calendar/fiscal year. Determines revenue predictability and exposure to commodity price volatility.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: processing_route
attributes.business_glossary_term: Processing Route (Run of Mine to Product)
attributes.description: Description of the mineral processing pathway from Run of Mine (ROM) ore to final saleable product. Examples: 'Crushing-Screening-DMS', 'SAG-Ball Mill-Flotation', 'HPGR-Magnetic Separation', 'Leach-SX-EW', 'Roast-Leach-Crystallization'. Provides traceability to processing plant and technology used.
attributes.references: ISO 12743 Copper, Lead, Zinc and Nickel Concentrates

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the saleable product used in commercial documentation, contracts, and customer communications. Typically follows company-specific coding standards combining commodity type, grade, and form.

attributes.name: product_form
attributes.description: Physical form or state of the processed mineral product. Determines handling requirements, shipping methods, and customer application suitability. Examples: fines (fine particles <6.3mm), lump (coarse particles 6.3-31.5mm), concentrate (beneficiated high-grade product), hydroxide (chemical compound), matte (intermediate smelting product). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fines|lump|concentrate|hydroxide|matte|cathode|pellets|briquettes|powder|ingot — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 3082 Iron Ores Sampling and Sample Preparation Procedures

attributes.name: product_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the commercial product manager or marketing manager responsible for this product's market positioning, pricing strategy, and customer relationships. Business reference, not classified as PII.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the saleable product as it appears on invoices, contracts, and marketing materials. Examples: 'Iron Ore Fines 62% Fe', 'Copper Concentrate 25% Cu', 'Thermal Coal 6000 kcal NAR', 'Lithium Hydroxide Monohydrate Battery Grade'.

attributes.name: product_specification_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the authoritative product specification document that defines all technical parameters, test methods, sampling protocols, and acceptance criteria. Typically a controlled document in the company document management system.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, ISO 10005 Quality Plans

attributes.name: quality_certificate_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a third-party or company-issued quality certificate (assay certificate, certificate of analysis) must accompany each shipment. True for most mineral concentrates and specialty products where grade and impurity verification is contractually required.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Testing and Calibration Laboratories, JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum storage duration in days before product quality may degrade below specification. Relevant for moisture-sensitive products (lithium chemicals, some concentrates) or products subject to oxidation. Null for stable bulk commodities with indefinite shelf life.

attributes.name: sizing_specification
attributes.description: Particle size distribution specification defining the acceptable range of particle sizes, typically expressed as percentage passing through standard mesh screens. Example: '90% passing 6.3mm, 10% max passing 150 micron'. Critical for customer handling systems and process performance.
attributes.references: ISO 3310 Test Sieves, ISO 4701 Iron Ore Pellets Determination of Size Distribution

attributes.name: target_market_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer industry segment or end-use application for which this product variant is designed and marketed. Influences specification tolerances, packaging, and logistics requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steel_mills|smelters|refineries|battery_manufacturers|chemical_plants|power_generation|construction|automotive|electronics — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

products.name: specification
products.description: Defines the complete technical and commercial specification for each saleable product as the single specification SSOT across ALL quality dimensions. Encompasses: chemical grade parameters (Fe%, Cu%, Al2O3%, SiO2%, S%, P%), moisture parameters (maximum contractual moisture, TML for Group A cargoes, free vs inherent moisture, measurement method, sampling frequency, moisture penalty/rejection thresholds), particle size distribution (P80, top size, bottom size, oversize/undersize limits, lump/fines ranges, measurement method — wet/dry screening, laser diffraction), physical properties (bulk density, lump-to-fines ratio, HGI), and thermal parameters (CV, ash, VM, FC for coal). Captures both typical and guaranteed specification values. Individual parameter limits are expressed through linked product_grade_limit records referencing the grade_parameter catalog — this is the ONLY path for specifying quality boundaries (no separate moisture or size entities). Serves as the contractual specification reference used in offtake agreements and sales contracts.
products.reference: JORC / ISO 3082 Iron Ore Sampling / ASTM D388 Coal Classification

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: A specification defines the complete technical and commercial requirements for a specific saleable product. This is a core 1:N relationship (one saleable_product has many specification versions over t

attributes.description: Date on which this product specification was formally approved for use in sales contracts and quality assurance processes.

attributes.name: ash_percent

attributes.name: calorific_value_kcal_per_kg

attributes.description: Reference to the master offtake agreement, sales contract, or commercial framework under which this specification is defined and enforced.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this product specification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: guaranteed_cu_percent_min

attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this specification is tailored for a specific customer (true) or represents a standard product offering (false).

attributes.name: is_export_specification
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this specification is used for export sales (true) or domestic sales (false), affecting regulatory compliance and documentation requirements.

attributes.name: p80_microns
attributes.description: Particle size in microns at which 80% of the material by weight passes through, a key comminution and processing parameter.

attributes.name: packaging_requirement
attributes.description: Required packaging method for the product (bulk, bagged, containerized, intermediate bulk container, drums, supersacks) as specified in the sales contract.

attributes.name: quality_standard_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the international or industry quality standard (ISO, ASTM, JORC, CIM) that this specification complies with or is based upon.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, JORC Code, CIM Definition Standards

attributes.name: size_measurement_method
attributes.description: Standard method used for particle size distribution determination (wet screening, dry screening, laser diffraction, sieve analysis).

attributes.name: specification_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the product specification used in contracts, quality certificates, and commercial documentation.

attributes.name: specification_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the product specification including any special conditions, handling requirements, or customer-specific modifications.

attributes.name: specification_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the product specification (e.g., Premium Fines 62% Fe, Copper Concentrate Standard Grade, Thermal Coal 6000 kcal/kg).

attributes.name: specification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product specification indicating whether it is in draft, actively used in contracts, superseded by a newer version, obsolete, suspended, or under review.

attributes.name: specification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specification indicating whether it represents typical values, guaranteed minimums/maximums, contractual commitments, internal quality targets, or export standards.

attributes.name: tml_percent
attributes.description: Transportable Moisture Limit for Group A cargoes under IMSBC Code, representing the maximum moisture content at which the cargo can be safely shipped without liquefaction risk.

attributes.name: top_size_mm
attributes.description: Maximum particle size in millimeters, representing the largest particles present in the product after screening or crushing.

attributes.name: typical_al2o3_percent
attributes.description: Typical alumina content percentage, a key impurity parameter for iron ore and other mineral products affecting downstream processing efficiency.

attributes.name: typical_cu_percent
attributes.description: Typical copper content percentage for copper concentrate products, representing the average Cu grade expected under normal production conditions.

attributes.name: typical_fe_percent
attributes.description: Typical iron content percentage for iron ore products, representing the average Fe grade expected under normal production conditions.

attributes.name: typical_moisture_percent
attributes.description: Typical moisture content percentage representing the average moisture level expected under normal production and storage conditions.

attributes.name: typical_sio2_percent
attributes.description: Typical silica content percentage, a key gangue mineral parameter affecting product quality and downstream processing requirements.

attributes.name: typical_sulfur_percent
attributes.description: Typical sulfur content percentage, a critical impurity parameter for iron ore, coal, and copper products affecting environmental compliance and processing.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the specification following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1) to track revisions and updates over time.

attributes.name: volatile_matter_percent
attributes.description: Volatile matter content percentage for coal products, indicating the proportion of gaseous products released during heating, affecting combustion characteristics.

products.name: grade_parameter
products.description: Controlled reference catalog of all measurable quality parameters used to specify and assess mineral product quality across all dimensions: chemical (Fe, Cu, Al2O3, SiO2, S, P, Mn, TiO2, LOI, LCE), moisture (H2O total, free moisture, inherent moisture, TML), particle size (P80, top size, undersize, oversize, lump fraction), thermal (CV, ash, VM, FC), and physical (bulk density, HGI, abrasion index). Each parameter has a unique code, parameter type classification (chemical/moisture/size/thermal/physical), standard unit of measure (%, ppm, mm, kcal/kg, MJ/kg, t/m³), primary measurement method, and applicable commodity scope. Provides the controlled vocabulary referenced by product_grade_limit for setting specification boundaries across all quality dimensions.
products.reference: ISO 9516 / ASTM E1621 / JORC Table 1 Reporting Parameters

attributes.name: grade_parameter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the grade parameter. Primary key for the grade parameter reference catalog.

attributes.name: alternative_names
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of alternative names, synonyms, or abbreviations used for this parameter across different systems, regions, or customer specifications (e.g., 'Fe' may also be known as 'Iron', 'Fe Total', 'Fe%'; 'CV' as 'Calorific Value', 'Heating Value', 'Energy Content'). Supports data integration and customer communication.
attributes.references: Industry Terminology Standards, Customer Specification Documents

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parameter record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit and Compliance Policy

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Primary operational system from which parameter definitions and measurement results originate (e.g., LabWare LIMS, SAP QM, Geovia GEMS, MinePlan). Supports data lineage tracking and system integration mapping.
attributes.references: Enterprise Architecture Standards, System Integration Documentation

attributes.name: decimal_precision
attributes.description: Number of decimal places to which parameter values should be reported and rounded (e.g., 2 for percentages like 62.35%, 0 for whole numbers, 4 for trace elements in ppm). Ensures consistency in assay reporting and contract specifications.
attributes.references: ISO 17025, Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Standards

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this parameter definition became active and available for use in product specifications and quality assessments. Supports temporal tracking of parameter catalog changes and ensures historical accuracy of product specifications.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Master Data Management Policy

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this parameter definition was retired or superseded. Null for currently active parameters. Supports historical analysis and ensures that legacy product specifications can be accurately reconstructed.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Master Data Management Policy

attributes.name: grade_parameter_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the parameter definition: active (in use), inactive (temporarily not used), deprecated (being phased out), under_review (pending validation or approval). Controls which parameters are available for new product specifications.
attributes.references: Master Data Management Policy, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: is_bonus_element
attributes.description: Indicates whether exceeding specified thresholds for this parameter results in commercial bonuses or price premiums (True). Typically applies to valuable elements or quality characteristics that enhance product value (e.g., high Fe content in iron ore, high CV in coal).
attributes.references: Commercial Contract Standards, Industry Best Practice

attributes.name: is_contractual_parameter
attributes.description: Indicates whether this parameter is typically included in sales contracts and commercial specifications (True) or is used only for internal quality control and process optimization (False). Contractual parameters drive pricing adjustments, penalties, and bonuses.
attributes.references: Commercial Contract Standards, Sales and Marketing Guidelines

attributes.name: is_penalty_element
attributes.description: Indicates whether exceeding specified limits for this parameter results in commercial penalties or price deductions (True). Typically applies to deleterious elements like sulfur, phosphorus, arsenic, and excess moisture that negatively impact downstream processing.
attributes.references: Commercial Contract Standards, Industry Best Practice

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parameter record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit and Compliance Policy

attributes.name: lims_parameter_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Parameter Code
attributes.description: The parameter code used in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) for sample tracking and assay result recording. Enables integration between the product catalog and laboratory systems. May differ from the standard parameter_code due to legacy system conventions.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Standard analytical or testing method used to determine the parameter value (e.g., XRF - X-Ray Fluorescence, ICP-OES - Inductively Coupled Plasma Optical Emission Spectrometry, gravimetric analysis, sieve analysis, bomb calorimetry, proximate analysis). References the laboratory procedure code or industry standard method.
attributes.references: ISO 17025, ASTM Standards, AS Standards (Australian Standards)

attributes.name: parameter_category
attributes.description: Business classification grouping parameters by commercial significance: major_element (primary value drivers like Fe, Cu), minor_element (secondary constituents), trace_element (low-concentration elements), deleterious_element (penalty elements like S, P, As), moisture_content (H2O measures), size_distribution (particle sizing), energy_property (CV, calorific measures), physical_property (density, hardness). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: major_element|minor_element|trace_element|deleterious_element|moisture_content|size_distribution|energy_property|physical_property — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the quality parameter (e.g., FE, CU, AL2O3, SIO2, S, P, MN, TIO2, LOI, LCE, H2O, P80, CV, ASH, VM, FC). Used as the standard reference key across product specifications, assay results, and quality control systems.

attributes.name: parameter_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of what the parameter measures, its significance for product quality and downstream processing, and any special considerations for interpretation. Provides context for laboratory staff, quality control teams, and commercial personnel.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the quality parameter (e.g., Iron Content, Copper Content, Alumina, Silica, Sulfur, Phosphorus, Manganese, Titanium Dioxide, Loss on Ignition, Lithium Carbonate Equivalent, Total Moisture, Particle Size P80, Calorific Value, Ash Content, Volatile Matter, Fixed Carbon).

attributes.name: parameter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the parameter by measurement dimension: chemical (elemental composition and compounds), moisture (water content measures), particle_size (size distribution metrics), thermal (energy and combustion properties), physical (density, hardness, abrasion characteristics).
attributes.references: ISO 11323 Iron Ore Sampling, ASTM D388 Coal Classification

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this parameter must be reported to regulatory authorities for environmental compliance, resource reporting, or trade documentation (True). Examples include hazardous elements, radioactive materials, or parameters required for JORC/NI 43-101 resource disclosures.
attributes.references: JORC Code, SEC S-K 1300, Environmental Protection Regulations

attributes.name: reporting_basis
attributes.description: Moisture basis on which the parameter value is reported: as_received (natural state including moisture), dry_basis (moisture removed), air_dried (equilibrated with ambient air), moisture_free (completely dried), daf (dry ash-free basis for coal). Critical for accurate comparison of assay results and contract specifications.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

Supports contractual guarantee limits, typical operating limits, and loading/shipping limits (e.g., TML for moisture). Enables automated quality compliance checking against assay results and real-time blend quality monitoring.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The role, position, or individual who has the authority to approve or modify this grade limit. Typically includes Chief Metallurgist, Technical Services Manager, Commercial Manager, or Competent Person under JORC Code. Ensures accountability and governance over specification changes that impact product quality and commercial commitments.
attributes.references: JORC Code (Competent Person Requirements), Internal Authority Matrix, Quality Management Standard

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this grade limit was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Provides audit trail for specification governance and change control. Used to track when limits were authorized and to support compliance audits.

attributes.name: bonus_rate
attributes.description: The financial bonus rate applied per unit improvement beyond the bonus threshold. Typically expressed as currency per percentage point or currency per ppm. Used to calculate provisional pricing adjustments and commercial premiums when grade parameters exceed target specifications. Confidential commercial term from sales contracts.
attributes.references: Sales Contract Bonus Schedule, Commodity Trading Agreement

attributes.name: bonus_threshold
attributes.description: The value at which financial bonuses or price premiums begin to apply. For beneficial elements, bonuses typically apply when the value exceeds this threshold. For deleterious elements, bonuses may apply when the value falls below this threshold. Triggers provisional pricing adjustments and commercial premiums.
attributes.references: Sales Contract Bonus Schedule, Commodity Trading Agreement

attributes.name: compliance_tolerance
attributes.description: The acceptable measurement uncertainty or tolerance band around the limit value within which minor excursions are considered acceptable due to analytical variability. Accounts for sampling error, analytical precision, and measurement repeatability. Used to avoid false rejections due to normal measurement variation. Expressed in the same unit as the grade parameter.
attributes.references: ISO 5725 (Accuracy and Precision of Measurement Methods), Internal Quality Control Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this grade limit record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and supports compliance with data governance requirements. Automatically populated by the system upon record insertion.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard, Audit Trail Standard

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this grade limit becomes active and enforceable. Supports temporal validity and enables historical tracking of specification changes. Used to determine which limits apply to a given shipment or production batch based on the transaction date.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard, Temporal Data Model Standard

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this grade limit remains active and enforceable. Null value indicates the limit is currently active with no planned end date. Supports temporal validity and enables historical tracking of specification changes. Used to determine which limits apply to a given shipment or production batch based on the transaction date.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard, Temporal Data Model Standard

attributes.name: guaranteed_value
attributes.description: The contractually guaranteed value for this grade parameter committed to the customer. Failure to meet this guarantee may trigger price adjustments, penalties, or cargo rejection. More conservative than typical value to account for operational variability. Used in sales contracts and letters of credit.
attributes.references: Sales Contract Terms, Letter of Credit (LC) Specification, INCOTERMS 2020

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this grade limit record was most recently updated. Provides audit trail for change tracking and supports compliance with data governance requirements. Automatically updated by the system upon any record modification.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard, Audit Trail Standard

attributes.name: limit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the grade limit record. Active: currently in force and used for quality compliance checking. Superseded: replaced by a newer version. Draft: proposed limit pending approval. Under_review: existing limit being evaluated for revision. Suspended: temporarily not enforced due to operational or commercial reasons.
attributes.references: Internal Quality Management Standard, Change Management Standard

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grade limit based on its source and enforcement authority. Contractual: limits specified in customer sales contracts. Operational: limits defined by internal process capabilities and equipment constraints. Regulatory: limits mandated by environmental or safety regulations. Shipping: limits required for safe maritime transport (e.g., TML). Internal: limits set for quality control and process optimization purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Quality Management Standard, Contract Management Standard

attributes.name: maximum_limit
attributes.description: The absolute maximum acceptable value for this grade parameter. Values above this threshold may trigger cargo rejection or require remediation. For deleterious elements (e.g., silica, alumina, phosphorus, sulfur in iron ore), represents the ceiling specification. For beneficial elements, this field may be null as only minimum limits apply.
attributes.references: JORC Code, Customer Contract Specifications, Internal Product Standard

attributes.name: minimum_limit
attributes.description: The absolute minimum acceptable value for this grade parameter. Values below this threshold may trigger cargo rejection or require remediation. For beneficial elements (e.g., iron in iron ore), represents the floor specification. For deleterious elements (e.g., phosphorus, sulfur), this field may be null as only maximum limits apply.
attributes.references: JORC Code, Customer Contract Specifications, Internal Product Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, clarifications, or special conditions related to this grade limit. May include information about seasonal variations, customer-specific requirements, process constraints, or historical context for limit changes. Supports knowledge capture and operational decision-making.

attributes.name: parameter_category
attributes.description: Classification of the grade parameter into broad categories: chemical (elemental composition), physical (density, hardness), moisture (water content), thermal (calorific value, ash content), particle_size (size distribution), impurity (deleterious elements). Enables grouping of related parameters for quality control and reporting.

attributes.name: penalty_rate
attributes.description: The financial penalty rate applied per unit deviation beyond the penalty threshold. Typically expressed as currency per percentage point or currency per ppm. Used to calculate provisional pricing adjustments and commercial deductions when grade parameters fall outside acceptable ranges. Confidential commercial term from sales contracts.
attributes.references: Sales Contract Penalty Schedule, Commodity Trading Agreement

attributes.name: penalty_threshold
attributes.description: The value at which financial penalties or price deductions begin to apply. For deleterious elements, penalties typically apply when the value exceeds this threshold. For beneficial elements, penalties may apply when the value falls below this threshold. Triggers provisional pricing adjustments and commercial deductions.
attributes.references: Sales Contract Penalty Schedule, Commodity Trading Agreement

attributes.name: rejection_limit
attributes.description: The absolute value at which the cargo or shipment will be rejected by the customer or deemed non-compliant with contractual specifications. Represents the hard boundary beyond which the product is considered off-specification and unsaleable. More extreme than penalty thresholds. Triggers cargo hold, rework, or disposal decisions.
attributes.references: Sales Contract Rejection Clause, Quality Assurance Standard, Customer Specification

attributes.name: sampling_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency at which samples must be collected and tested to verify compliance with this grade limit. Per_batch: one sample per production batch. Per_shift: one sample per operating shift. Per_day: daily composite sample. Per_shipment: one sample per cargo shipment. Per_railcar: one sample per rail wagon. Continuous: real-time online analyzer. Drives sampling plan design and quality control resource allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 3081 (Iron Ores - Increment Sampling), ISO 13909 (Coal Sampling), Internal Sampling Standard

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The ideal or target value for this grade parameter that the mineral processing plant aims to achieve during beneficiation and blending operations. Represents the optimal specification point that maximizes product value and customer satisfaction. Used for process control setpoints and blend optimization.
attributes.references: Internal Process Control Standard, Manufacturing Execution System (MES) Specification

attributes.name: transportable_moisture_limit
attributes.description: The maximum moisture content at which the mineral concentrate or ore can be safely transported by sea without risk of liquefaction and cargo shift. Critical safety parameter for bulk carrier shipping of iron ore fines, nickel ore, and other fine concentrates. Compliance with TML is mandatory under International Maritime Solid Bulk Cargoes (IMSBC) Code. Only applicable to moisture-related grade parameters.
attributes.references: IMO IMSBC Code (International Maritime Solid Bulk Cargoes), SOLAS Convention, ISO 3087

attributes.name: typical_value
attributes.description: The typical or average value historically achieved for this grade parameter under normal operating conditions. Represents the expected value communicated to customers in product marketing materials and used for sales forecasting. Distinct from target (aspiration) and guaranteed (contractual commitment).
attributes.references: Internal Product Marketing Standard, Sales Contract Template

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the grade parameter is measured and expressed. Common units: percent (%), parts per million (ppm), kilocalories per kilogram (kcal/kg), megajoules per kilogram (MJ/kg), millimeters (mm), microns, kilograms per cubic meter (kg/m3). Must align with assay reporting units from LIMS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: percent|ppm|kcal_kg|mj_kg|mm|micron|kg_m3 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: hazard_classification

attributes.name: issue_date

attributes.name: issuing_authority

Examples: European Chemicals Agency (ECHA), Standardization Administration of China (SAC), Korean Agency for Technology and Standards (KATS), Japanese Standards Association (JSA), International Maritime Organization (IMO).
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) 1907/2006, GB Standards (China), KS Standards (Korea), JIS Standards (Japan)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: next_renewal_date

attributes.name: product_grade_covered

attributes.name: remarks

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag

attributes.name: responsible_party

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_reference

attributes.name: un_number

products.name: blend
products.description: Approved blending recipe that combines two or more source products to produce a target blended product meeting a defined specification. Captures blend identifier, target saleable product, target specification reference, blending location (ROM pad, train load-out, port stockpile, ship-loader feed), blend tolerance range, quality prediction model reference, and approval status. Critical for iron ore operations where multiple ore sources are blended to meet 62% Fe specification, and for coal operations blending energy and ash content. Supports mine-to-port blend optimisation and real-time blend tracking.
products.reference: Mine Planning Blend Optimisation / Deswik Scheduling

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Product blends target material from specific orebodies to achieve grade specifications. Blend recipes reference source orebodies for quality prediction, optimization algorithms, and production plannin

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Blended products must be traceable to their source tenement for royalty apportionment, tenement compliance reporting, and regulatory returns. A mining operations expert expects blend-to-tenement trace

attributes.name: optimization_objective
attributes.description: Primary business objective for this blend: maximize_grade (highest quality), minimize_cost (lowest production cost), meet_specification (exact customer requirement), maximize_recovery (best yield), balance_inventory (stockpile management).
attributes.references: Mine Planning Standard, Blend Optimization Framework

attributes.name: quality_assurance_protocol
attributes.description: Level of quality testing and validation required: standard (routine sampling), enhanced (increased sampling frequency), premium (continuous monitoring), customer_specific (per contract requirements).
attributes.references: Quality Management System, ISO 9001, Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Standard

attributes.name: quality_prediction_model_reference
attributes.description: Reference code to the predictive analytics model used to forecast blend quality outcomes based on source material properties. Supports real-time blend optimization.
attributes.references: Analytics Model Registry, Mine-to-Port Optimization Standard

attributes.name: sampling_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for quality sampling and assay testing: per_batch (every blend batch), per_shift (8-12 hour intervals), per_day (daily composite), continuous (real-time monitoring), per_shipment (before dispatch).
attributes.references: Quality Control Procedures, LIMS Standard, ISO 3081

attributes.name: target_alumina_percent
attributes.description: Target alumina content percentage for iron ore and mineral blends. Impacts smelting efficiency (typical range 1-4%).

attributes.name: target_ash_percent
attributes.description: Target ash content percentage for coal blends. Lower ash content increases energy value and reduces waste (typical range 8-25%).

attributes.name: target_energy_content_kcal_kg
attributes.description: Target calorific value for coal blends measured in kilocalories per kilogram. Critical for thermal coal pricing and power generation efficiency (typical range 4500-7000 kcal/kg).

attributes.name: target_fe_grade_percent
attributes.description: Target iron content percentage for iron ore blends, typically 58-67% Fe. Critical for meeting customer specifications and pricing.

attributes.name: target_moisture_percent
attributes.description: Target moisture content percentage for the blended product. Critical for shipping weight calculations and product quality (typical range 2-10%).

attributes.name: target_phosphorus_percent
attributes.description: Target phosphorus content percentage for iron ore blends. Low phosphorus is critical for high-grade steel production (typical range 0.02-0.10%).

attributes.name: target_silica_percent
attributes.description: Target silica content percentage for iron ore and mineral blends. Lower silica is preferred for steel-making (typical range 2-8%).

attributes.name: tolerance_range_percent
attributes.description: Allowable deviation from target specification expressed as percentage (e.g., ±2% for Fe grade). Defines acceptable quality variance for the blend.
attributes.references: Product Specification Standard, Quality Control Procedures

products.name: commodity_grade_scope
products.description: This association product represents the formally managed applicability contract between a commodity and a grade parameter. It captures which quality parameters govern each commodity type, along with the commodity-specific specification boundaries, contractual inclusion status, and commercial penalty/bonus flags that exist only in the context of a specific commodity-parameter combination. Each record defines one quality dimension of one commodity's specification envelope, actively maintained by metallurgists and commercial teams.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, each commodity type (iron ore, copper, coal) is governed by a formally managed set of quality parameters — metallurgists and commercial teams explicitly define which grade parameters apply to each commodity, along with commodity-specific ranges, contractual status, and penalty/bonus flags. This is not derivable from transactional data; it is a controlled reference catalog actively maintained by technical and commercial teams. A single grade parameter (e.g., moisture H2O) applies to multiple commodities, and a single commodity (e.g., iron ore) is governed by many grade parameters — making this a genuine operational M:N.

attributes.name: commodity_grade_scope_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Commodity Grade Scope - Commodity Grade Scope Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the commodity_grade_scope association

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the commodity whose quality specification this record contributes to.

attributes.name: grade_parameter_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Commodity Grade Scope - Grade Parameter Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the grade parameter that applies to this commodity.

attributes.name: applicable_commodity_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of mineral commodities to which this parameter applies (e.g., iron_ore, copper_concentrate, thermal_coal, metallurgical_coal, lithium_hydroxide, lithium_carbonate, nickel_matte, nickel_concentrate, gold_dore). Defines the product catalog scope where this parameter is relevant for quality specification. [Moved from grade_parameter: This comma-separated text field on grade_parameter is a denormalized encoding of the M:N relationship. It must be removed and replaced by proper FK records in commodity_grade_scope, which provides referential integrity, queryability, and the ability to store commodity-specific attributes (ranges, contractual flags, penalty/bonus flags) per combination.]
attributes.references: JORC Code, Internal Product Catalog Standards

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this grade parameter became applicable to this commodity. Supports versioning of the commodity quality specification over time.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this grade parameter ceased to apply to this commodity. Null indicates currently active applicability.

attributes.name: is_bonus_element
attributes.description: Indicates whether exceeding specified thresholds for this parameter results in commercial price bonuses for this specific commodity. Bonus applicability is commodity-specific.

attributes.name: is_contractual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade parameter is included in sales contracts and commercial specifications for this specific commodity. A parameter may be contractual for coal but informational-only for lithium.

attributes.name: is_penalty_element
attributes.description: Indicates whether exceeding specified limits for this parameter results in commercial price penalties for this specific commodity. Penalty applicability is commodity-specific.

attributes.name: scope_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this commodity-parameter applicability record. Allows parameters to be retired from a commodity's scope without deleting the historical record.

attributes.name: typical_range_maximum
attributes.description: Upper bound of the typical value range for this grade parameter as observed specifically for this commodity. Overrides the generic typical_range_maximum on grade_parameter with a commodity-specific value.

attributes.name: typical_range_minimum
attributes.description: Lower bound of the typical value range for this grade parameter as observed specifically for this commodity. Overrides the generic typical_range_minimum on grade_parameter with a commodity-specific value.

domains.name: tenement
domains.description: Manages the land access and mineral rights portfolio including exploration licences, mining leases, native title agreements, heritage clearances, surface rights, and royalty agreements. Tracks tenement boundaries via GIS, renewal obligations, expenditure commitments, and regulatory conditions.
domains.references: Local Mining Acts, GRI Mining Sector

products.name: tenement
products.description: Master register of all mineral tenements held or applied for by the company, including exploration licences, mining leases, prospecting licences, and retention licences. SSOT for tenement identity, licence type, status, jurisdiction, granted commodities, area (hectares), grant/expiry dates, and lifecycle status (application, granted, suspended, surrendered, expired, forfeited). Each record represents one tenement with its unique statutory identifier.

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the tenement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Tenements are primary cost objects in mining operations. Each tenement is assigned to a cost centre for operational cost tracking, AISC calculation, and unit cost reporting. Essential for monthly mana

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Tenements are held by specific legal entities — this is a fundamental regulatory requirement (mining licences are granted to legal entities). Finance teams need legal entity linkage for consolidation

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Tenements are evaluated as profit-generating assets. Assignment to profit centres enables segment P&L reporting, asset-level profitability analysis, and investment decision support. Required for IFRS

attributes.name: rehabilitation_provision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.rehabilitation_provision. Business justification: Rehabilitation provisions under IFRS/AASB 137 are calculated per tenement area under mining legislation. Finance teams must link each tenement to its rehabilitation provision for closure cost estimati

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Tenements are represented as WBS elements in mining ERP systems for IFRS 6 exploration expenditure capitalisation. Finance teams link tenements to WBS for exploration cost tracking, impairment testing

attributes.name: annual_expenditure_commitment
attributes.description: The minimum annual expenditure amount (in local currency) that must be spent on exploration or development activities to maintain the tenement in good standing. Failure to meet this commitment may result in forfeiture.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenement application was submitted to the regulatory authority. Establishes priority in jurisdictions with first-in-time rules.

attributes.name: area_hectares
attributes.description: The total surface area of the tenement measured in hectares. Defines the spatial extent of the mineral rights.

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: The latitude coordinate of the tenement centroid in decimal degrees. Used for approximate location reference and spatial queries.

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: The longitude coordinate of the tenement centroid in decimal degrees. Used for approximate location reference and spatial queries.

attributes.name: coordinate_system
attributes.description: The coordinate reference system (CRS) or projection used for the tenement boundary (e.g., 'GDA2020 MGA Zone 50', 'NAD83 UTM Zone 11N'). Critical for accurate spatial representation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the tenement is located (e.g., AUS, CAN, USA, ZAF).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tenement record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: environmental_conditions
attributes.description: Summary of key environmental conditions or restrictions imposed on the tenement by the regulatory authority (e.g., 'No clearing within 100m of watercourses', 'Seasonal access restrictions during breeding season'). Free-text field for recording compliance obligations.

attributes.name: expenditure_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the annual expenditure commitment (e.g., AUD, CAD, USD, ZAR).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenement licence term ends unless renewed. Critical for tracking renewal obligations and avoiding forfeiture.

attributes.name: gis_boundary_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the GIS spatial dataset defining the tenement boundary coordinates. Enables integration with GIS systems for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: grant_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenement was officially granted by the regulatory authority, marking the commencement of the licence term.

attributes.name: granted_commodities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of minerals or commodities for which the tenement grants exploration or extraction rights (e.g., 'Iron Ore, Gold, Copper', 'Lithium, Nickel'). Defines the scope of permitted mineral activities.

attributes.name: heritage_clearance_status
attributes.description: The status of cultural heritage clearance for the tenement. Not Required: no heritage survey needed; Cleared: heritage survey completed with no restrictions; Survey Required: heritage assessment not yet conducted; Restricted Areas Identified: heritage sites present requiring protection; Pending: clearance process underway.
attributes.references: Heritage Protection Act (jurisdiction-specific), ICMM Cultural Heritage Standard

attributes.name: holder_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage ownership interest held by the registered holder in this tenement. Relevant for joint ventures or partial interests. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: joint_venture_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenement is held under a joint venture arrangement with one or more partners. True if joint venture; False if sole ownership.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The state, province, or territory in which the tenement is registered and governed (e.g., 'Western Australia', 'Queensland', 'British Columbia'). Determines the applicable mining legislation and regulatory authority.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent physical or regulatory inspection of the tenement. Used to track compliance monitoring and site visit schedules.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tenement record was last updated in the system. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: licence_type
attributes.description: The category of mineral tenement defining the permitted activities and rights. Exploration Licence (EL) allows exploration activities; Mining Lease (ML) permits extraction; Prospecting Licence (PL) for small-scale exploration; Retention Licence (RL) to retain discovered resources not yet economically viable; Miscellaneous Licence for ancillary purposes.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the tenement in its regulatory lifecycle. Application: submitted but not yet granted; Granted: approved and active; Active: in good standing with all obligations met; Suspended: temporarily inactive due to regulatory or operational reasons; Surrendered: voluntarily relinquished by holder; Expired: lapsed due to term completion; Forfeited: revoked by authority for non-compliance; Renewal Pending: application for extension submitted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: application|granted|active|suspended|surrendered|expired|forfeited|renewal_pending — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: native_title_status
attributes.description: The status of native title considerations for the tenement. Not Applicable: jurisdiction does not recognize native title; Determined: native title has been legally determined; Registered Claim: a native title claim is registered over the area; Agreement in Place: native title agreement (e.g., ILUA) executed; Negotiation Required: consultation or agreement process underway.
attributes.references: Native Title Act (jurisdiction-specific), ICMM Indigenous Peoples Policy

attributes.name: next_reporting_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next statutory report (e.g., annual expenditure report, exploration report) must be submitted to the regulatory authority. Critical for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording additional information, special conditions, historical context, or operational notes relevant to the tenement management.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The name of the government department or agency responsible for administering the tenement (e.g., 'Department of Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety', 'Ministry of Energy and Mines').

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date by which a renewal application must be submitted to extend the tenement term. Nullable for tenements not yet requiring renewal.

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage royalty rate payable on production from the tenement, either to the government or to a third-party royalty holder. Nullable if no royalty applies.

attributes.name: royalty_type
attributes.description: The type of royalty obligation applicable to the tenement. Government: statutory royalty to state; Private: royalty to third party; Net Smelter Return (NSR): based on net proceeds after smelting; Gross Revenue: based on gross sales; Profit Based: based on net profit.

attributes.name: statutory_identifier
attributes.description: The official government-issued unique identifier for the tenement as registered with the mining authority (e.g., EL12345, ML67890, PL54321). This is the externally-known business identifier used in all regulatory correspondence and public registers.

attributes.name: strategic_priority
attributes.description: Internal classification of the tenement's strategic importance to the company's portfolio. Tier 1: highest priority, active development or production; Tier 2: medium priority, advanced exploration; Tier 3: early-stage or prospective; Non-Core: retained but not strategic; Divestment Candidate: targeted for sale or surrender.

attributes.name: surface_rights_status
attributes.description: The status of surface land access rights for the tenement. Owned: company owns the surface land; Leased: surface land leased from owner; Access Agreement: formal access agreement in place; Negotiation Required: access rights being negotiated; Restricted: surface access limited or denied.

attributes.name: tenement_name
attributes.description: The common or project name assigned to the tenement for internal reference and communication (e.g., 'Iron Ridge North', 'Copper Creek Prospect').

products.name: boundary
products.description: GIS spatial boundary definition for each tenement, storing polygon geometry (WKT/WKB), coordinate reference system (CRS), survey datum, area calculation method, and version history of boundary amendments. Supports GIS integration for overlap analysis, native title intersection, and regulatory mapping submissions. One tenement may have multiple boundary versions over its lifecycle.

attributes.name: boundary_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tenement boundary record. Primary key for the tenement boundary data product.

attributes.name: heritage_clearance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.heritage_clearance. Business justification: boundary.heritage_area_overlap_flag indicates that a boundary polygon overlaps with a heritage area requiring clearance. Adding heritage_clearance_id links the specific boundary version to the heritag

attributes.name: native_title_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.native_title_agreement. Business justification: boundary.native_title_overlap_flag indicates that a boundary polygon overlaps with a native title claim or determination area. Adding native_title_agreement_id links the specific boundary version to t

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent tenement for which this boundary is defined. Links to the tenement master record.

attributes.name: accuracy_class
attributes.description: Classification of the boundary accuracy. Survey accurate for professionally surveyed boundaries, cadastral for official land registry boundaries, digitized for boundaries traced from maps, approximate for estimated boundaries.

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Business or regulatory reason for the boundary change. Examples include partial relinquishment, area reduction, survey correction, native title agreement, or regulatory directive.

attributes.name: area_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the tenement area. Planar for flat-earth approximation, geodesic for spherical earth, ellipsoidal for precise WGS84 calculations, or surveyed for official cadastral measurements.

attributes.name: area_hectares
attributes.description: Total area of the tenement boundary in hectares. Calculated from the polygon geometry. Used for expenditure commitment calculations and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: area_square_kilometers
attributes.description: Total area of the tenement boundary in square kilometers. Alternative area measurement for reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: boundary_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the boundary definition. Indicates whether the boundary is in draft, under regulatory review, officially approved, or has been superseded by a newer version.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, clarifications, or context about the boundary definition. May include survey notes, regulatory correspondence references, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: coordinate_reference_system
attributes.description: The spatial reference system used for the boundary coordinates. Typically an EPSG code (e.g., EPSG:4326 for WGS84, EPSG:28350 for GDA94 MGA Zone 50). Critical for accurate spatial alignment and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this boundary record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or document from which the boundary geometry was obtained. Examples include regulatory portal, survey plan, GPS field capture, or digitized from historical maps.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this boundary definition becomes legally effective. Marks the start of the boundary version validity period.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this boundary definition remains valid. Null for the current active boundary. Populated when a new boundary version supersedes this one.

attributes.name: environmental_overlay_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the tenement boundary intersects with environmental protection zones, national parks, or conservation areas. Impacts permitting and operational constraints.

attributes.name: geometry_wkb
attributes.description: Spatial polygon geometry of the tenement boundary in Well-Known Binary format. Binary representation for efficient storage and processing in GIS systems.

attributes.name: geometry_wkt
attributes.description: Spatial polygon geometry of the tenement boundary in Well-Known Text format. Represents the precise geographic coordinates defining the tenement perimeter. Used for GIS integration and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: gis_layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the GIS layer or feature class where this boundary is stored in the corporate GIS system. Supports integration with spatial data platforms.

attributes.name: heritage_area_overlap_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the tenement boundary intersects with registered heritage sites or protected cultural areas. Triggers heritage clearance requirements.

attributes.name: is_current_boundary
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current active boundary for the tenement. True for the latest approved version, false for historical versions.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who last modified this boundary record. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this boundary record was last updated in the system. Tracks the most recent change for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: map_sheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the topographic map sheet or cadastral map on which the tenement boundary is depicted. Used for regulatory submissions and field operations.

attributes.name: native_title_overlap_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the tenement boundary intersects with registered native title claims or determinations. Used for heritage and consultation planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: monitoring_required

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_authority

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_reference

attributes.name: restricted_zone_description

attributes.name: restricted_zone_spatial_reference

attributes.name: survey_date

attributes.name: survey_report_document_path

attributes.name: survey_type

attributes.name: traditional_owner_consent_obtained
